jobs.title: Avaloq Tech BA
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are looking for a skilled
**Avaloq Technical Business Analyst**
who will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and implementation partners to translate business requirements into high-quality Avaloq solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong banking domain knowledge, hands-on experience with Avaloq modules, and the ability to bridge functional and technical aspects of the platform.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Mandatory 3–7 years of experience of delivering solutions a Business Analyst on Avaloq core platform.
* Well-rounded overall experience of 10+ years as a Business Analyst.
* Strong understanding of Avaloq Core Banking modules, parameterization, and customization.
* Hands‑on experience with Avaloq scripting, data structures, and workflows (preferred).
* Good knowledge of banking operations such as Accounts, Payments, Securities, Corporate Actions, Wealth Management, Finance and Credit etc.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, and integration concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact with cross‑functional teams.
* Certification in Avaloq (ACCP) will be an added advantage.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business users to gather, analyze, and document requirements for Avaloq Core Banking solutions.
* Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications for Avaloq customization.
* Work with Avaloq developers to design, configure, and implement system changes.
* Perform parameterization, testing, and validation of Avaloq modules.
* Conduct end-to-end impact analyses and propose optimal solutions aligned with system capabilities.
* Prepare and execute test cases, SIT, UAT, and regression cycles.
* Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve issues raised by stakeholders/users.
* Support release management, deployment activities, and post‑production checks.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance, risk, and quality standards.
* Maintain documentation including BRDs, FSDs, user guides, workflow diagrams, and test reports.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience working in agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Ability to handle multiple requirements and manage priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on solution quality.
* Proactive, self‑driven, and committed to continuous improvement.

**Job Benefits**
Insurance
  
  
Career Development
  
  
Flexible Work hours
  
  
Learning Opportunities
  
  
Inclusive and collaborative work culture

jobs.title: Associate Business Architect
jobs.description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To drive the successful development and launch of mobile applications by gathering and analyzing business requirements, providing actionable insights, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with stakeholder needs and business objectives. The Business Architect will play a critical role in shaping product decisions through data-driven analysis and stakeholder engagement, while also overseeing project tracking to ensure timely delivery and adherence to project timelines.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Facilitate / attend workshops and meetings to elicit and document detailed business requirements from stakeholders.
* Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, challenges, and recommend process improvements.
* Evaluate potential solutions, providing clear and actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to ensure alignment and successful product development.
* Participate in testing and quality assurance activities to validate that product requirements are met.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure their requirements and expectations are understood and fulfilled.
* Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify project risks in collaboration with the product team and assess the feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies to address identified risks.
* Track project progress in coordination with PMO Leads (TPMs) to ensure timely delivery of milestones and project objectives.
* Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring adherence to schedules.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
* Multiple Stakeholder management
* Multiple high priority requirements delivery in parallel

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**


* Analyze business problems using structured thinking and data insights.
* Make informed decisions that balance short-term execution with long-term strategic goals.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability in high-stakes situations.
* Influence stakeholders through clear communication and evidence-based recommendations.
* Apply design thinking and agile methodologies to drive innovation and speed.

**Major Challenges**


* Navigating ambiguity and complexity in fast-paced environments.
* Driving change management across diverse teams and legacy systems.
* Balancing innovation with compliance and risk in regulated domains.
* Managing cross-functional collaboration with limited authority.
* Delivering impactful outcomes under tight timelines and evolving priorities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
* Work Experience
* 5+ years of experience in business analysis, product management, or a related field.
* Prior & relevant experience in Mobile Apps and Website domain across multiple operating systems.
* Should understand different app types (PWA, native, HTML5, Hybrid etc.)
* Should understand different project management tools (Azure DevOps)
* Possess a strong understanding of database and API integration to support technical project needs
* Should have knowledge of system interfaces required for building apps & web.
* Demonstrated success & achievement orientation.
* Strong bias for action & driving results in a high-performance environment.
* Excellent relationship skills.
* Exceptionally high motivational levels and needs to be a self-starter.
* Proven experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and solution evaluation.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skill.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of mobile app, website development and industry trends.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Skills Keywords
* Proven experience in Business Analysis and Project Management (PMP, Prince2, PMI-ACP certified preferred).
* Strong understanding of mobile and web technologies, including app architectures and deployment models.
* Hands-on experience with API and database integration, and system interface design.
* Expertise in requirements gathering, solution evaluation, and stakeholder management.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps coordination.

Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Implementation Engineer

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
3-8 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Scope:**
Drive end-to-end implementation of our SaaS-based Reconciliation Platform by understanding customer requirements, configuring solutions, supporting testing, and ensuring successful go-lives. This customer-facing role requires strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own customer implementations from kickoff to go-live.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into product configurations.
* Configure workflows, rules, validations, and data mappings.
* Support SIT/UAT, troubleshoot issues, and ensure successful deployments.
* Conduct customer training and enablement sessions.
* Manage multiple implementation projects and timelines.
* Create implementation documents, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to resolve issues.
* Provide regular project updates to business and technical stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements in implementation and onboarding processes.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* 3+ years of experience in SaaS/Product Implementation, Solution Delivery, or Customer Onboarding.
* Understanding of Payments, FinTech, Banking, or Reconciliation domains.
* Experience in requirement gathering, product configuration, and customer-facing delivery.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and data handling (CSV, JSON); basic SQL knowledge preferred.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of APIs and system integrations is a plus.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, Finance, or a related field.

**Why Optimus?**

**Lead the future of intelligent financial operations with Optimus.**

At Optimus, we are transforming how businesses manage complex financial ecosystems through cutting-edge AI-powered payment and reconciliation platforms. Our solutions enable organizations to seamlessly process, validate, and reconcile high-volume transactions—delivering real-time insights, eliminating revenue leakages, and driving operational efficiency at scale.

With a strong focus on autonomous financial operations (FinOps), Optimus empowers global enterprises, fintech companies, and payment-driven businesses to modernize back-office processes, accelerate go-to-market timelines, and enhance decision-making through clean, unified financial data.

By combining AI, APIs, and no-code capabilities, we help organizations automate finance workflows, ensure accuracy, and gain complete visibility across payment channels—making Optimus a trusted partner for innovation in the fast-evolving digital payments landscape.

To know more about the organization, please visit: AI Powered Payment Reconciliation Platform | Optimus

jobs.title: Lead Product Manger - Technical
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manger - Technical
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly motivated Product Manager – Technical (PM-T) to join our Authentication and Digital Identity team. This role is responsible for translating customer, business, and market requirements into scalable technical product capabilities. The successful candidate will partner closely with engineering, architects, UX, security, and program management teams to define, prioritize, and deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing authentication solutions that power digital commerce experiences globally.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with technical acumen, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Requirements & Backlog Management
  
  
Gather, analyze, and document business, customer, and technical requirements.
  
  
Translate requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Maintain and prioritize the product backlog to support delivery objectives.
  
  
Technical Product Ownership
  
  
Serve as Product Owner for one or more agile scrum teams.
  
  
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define APIs, integrations, workflows, and data requirements.
  
  
Ensure delivered solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including security, scalability, and reliability.
  
  
Agile Delivery & Execution
  
  
Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and release activities.
  
  
Drive clarity on requirements, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Support successful deployment and adoption of product capabilities.
  
  
Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, operations, security, and customer-facing teams.
  
  
Facilitate alignment across teams and communicate progress, risks, and key decisions.
  
  
Act as the bridge between business needs and technical implementation.
  
  
Product Operations & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Monitor product performance, customer feedback, and operational metrics.
  
  
Support issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
Contribute to process improvements that enhance product quality and delivery efficiency.
  
  
**Preferred Domain Experience**
Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:
  
  
Card payments and payment processing ecosystems
  
  
Authentication and digital identity solutions
  
  
EMV 3DS, Passkeys, FIDO/WebAuthn
  
  
Tokenization and digital wallets
  
  
APIs, integrations, and cloud-based platforms
  
  
Fraud prevention and risk-based authentication
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Business Analyst — Avaloq Banking Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
As Business Analyst you are the bridge between business stakeholders and Avaloq delivery squads: you elicit and challenge requirements, shape them into Avaloq-executable functional designs, and stay accountable for them through build, SIT, UAT and go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role on large, multi-workstream Avaloq programmes. You will own the requirement thread end to end — from a business pain point in the front office to a signed-off UAT result in production.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of Business Analysis experience, of which at least 3 years in banking or financial services.
* Avaloq: Hands-on delivery experience on the Avaloq Banking Suite — a firm requirement for this role. You must be able to discuss Avaloq business objects, parameters and functional design decisions unaided.
* Demonstrated delivery on at least one large-scale core banking transformation programme, end to end.
* Greenfield: Proven exposure to a greenfield implementation, with end-to-end command of your workstream from initial design through to go-live.
* Cross-workstream: Track record of coordinating across parallel workstreams — engaging other workstream owners to surface cross-impacts, agree interface and data dependencies, and keep design decisions aligned programme-wide.
* Proven authorship of BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps and traceability matrices.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write specifications that a developer can build from without further explanation.

**TOOLS & TECHNICAL SKILLS**
Avaloq Banking Suite (functional)
  
  

* Requirements management
* BPMN / Visio process modelling
* JIRA & Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* SQL (preferred)
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation)
* Functional testing, SIT & UAT management
* Business process re-engineering

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
2. Process Analysis & Avaloq Solution Design3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance4. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management5. Delivery Assurance, Data Validation & Go-Live
  
  

* Requirements Engineering & Documentation
* Elicit requirements through workshops, stakeholder interviews and process observation across front, middle and back office.
* Translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Author Avaloq-specific functional designs covering impacted business objects, parameters, interfaces, reports and batch processing.
* Own and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) from business need through to test evidence.
* Lead a functional workstream end to end with the client and understand business scope, requirements in full detail and granularity to shape the BRD for development.
* Map "As-Is" processes, define the "To-Be" target state, and perform gap and impact analysis against standard Avaloq functionality.
* Distinguish standard Avaloq capability from customisation, and justify every deviation on cost, risk and upgrade impact.
* Work with Solution Architects, Product Owners and Avaloq technical consultants to select the optimal design option.
* Identify automation and simplification candidates in manual operations, and quantify the effort/benefit case for each.
* Act as the primary functional liaison between business users, operations, risk, compliance and the delivery squads.
* Constructively challenge senior stakeholders where requirements conflict, and drive them to a single agreed position.
* Secure formal sign-off on requirements and designs, and manage scope change through the agreed governance process.
* Report progress, risks, issues and dependencies clearly to programme management.
* Build, refine and prioritise the backlog in JIRA or Azure DevOps alongside the Product Owner.
* Write INVEST-compliant user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives; resolve requirement clarifications within the sprint.
* Design and review test scenarios and test cases; drive SIT, UAT and business validation to completion.
* Coordinate UAT execution with business users and lead defect triage, prioritisation and retesting.
* Support data migration and reconciliation: field mapping, data quality analysis, remediation rules and pre/post-migration validation.
* Support regulatory, MIS and reporting workstreams where in scope.
* Prepare training material and business readiness artefacts; support cutover, hypercare and post-go-live stabilisation.

**Job Benefits**
Insurance
  
  
Career Development
  
  
Flexible Work hours
  
  
Learning Opportunities
  
  
Inclusive and collaborative work culture

jobs.title: Product Manager - Principal
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

* Analyze the competition and the market to identify trends and opportunities.
* Evaluate client feedback to inform product enhancements.
* Assess ideas based on their business value and technical feasibility.
* Present and share product vision with customers, management, and stakeholders.
* Define product strategy and prioritize the roadmap according to value.
* Gather input from various stakeholders (sales, customers, strategy, partnerships, etc.) to inform product development.
* Create business initiatives based on market understanding and translate these into user stories for development teams.
* Support value streams/squads by providing relevant information about objectives and customer needs.
* Ensure timely delivery and functional quality of product releases.
* Develop and manage business cases for new features, overseeing internal processes for new initiatives and budget allocations.
* Support sales and implementation processes through effective communication and documentation, ensuring good product positioning.
* Coordinate pilot executions and collaborate with project teams to maintain timelines for sales readiness.
* Manage pricing strategy in collaboration with Marketing and Pricing teams.

**Who Are We Looking For**
We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude, and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
  
  

* In-depth knowledge of the payments industry and local payment methods, primarily in the APAC market.
* 10+ Years of Overall Exp
* Experience with integration types, financial flows, and back-office processes such as settlements and invoicing.
* Ability to combine strategic and operational tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Strong focus on delivering quality and a superior merchant experience.
* Excellent strategic thinking and marketing skills.
* Pragmatic, professional, and constructive approach with a solution-driven mindset.
* Strong analytical skills to understand and translate customer/market needs into actionable functionalities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage with both technical and non-technical staff at all levels.
* Natural leadership qualities to foster support and make informed decisions based on stakeholder input.

**Shape the evolution**
We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
  
  
Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
  
  
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Payments & Banking GTM and Business Growth
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking a market-facing Solution Architect with strong Payments and Banking expertise to drive new business, account growth, strategic consulting, and solution-led engagements. The role combines domain knowledge, enterprise architecture, client advisory, executive engagement, and business development.
  
  
**Software Requirements**
**Required:**

* Enterprise and solution architecture tools
* API, integration, and cloud platforms
* CRM and opportunity-management tools
* Proposal, estimation, presentation, and documentation tools
* Payment processing and banking technology platforms
* Architecture diagramming and business case tools

**Preferred:**

* Cloud platforms, API gateways, microservices, event streaming, containers, and observability tools
* Data analytics and reporting platforms
* Enterprise architecture frameworks

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Lead consulting and solution architecture engagements across Payments and Banking.
* Drive new-logo acquisition, account farming, opportunity identification, and revenue growth.
* Develop go-to-market strategies, client propositions, solution roadmaps, and business cases.
* Design enterprise solutions covering payments, cloud, APIs, integration, modernization, data, security, and operations.
* Lead executive discussions and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
* Support proposals, RFPs, estimates, commercial models, and solution governance.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, product, and domain teams.
* Track payment industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
* Develop thought leadership, reusable solution assets, and industry perspectives.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, resilience, compliance, cost, and sustainability.

**Technical Skills**

* Programming and Architecture: Essential: Understanding of APIs, integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, software lifecycles, and enterprise architecture. Preferred: Java, Python, SQL, and code-level design review experience.
* Payments and Banking: Essential: Issuing, acquiring, switching, processing, settlement, reconciliation, digital banking, and payment transformation. Preferred: Open banking, instant payments, digital wallets, embedded finance, and real-time payments.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: Essential: Cloud adoption, migration, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, security, and cost management. Preferred: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and infrastructure automation.
* Data Management: Essential: Data flows, transaction data, customer data, reporting, reconciliation, governance, privacy, and data quality. Preferred: Real-time processing, analytics, data modernization, and regulatory reporting.
* Tools and Methodologies: Essential: Agile, consulting, discovery workshops, architecture governance, estimation, proposal development, business cases, and executive presentations. Preferred: Account planning, competitive analysis, sales pursuits, and partner-led opportunities.
* Security and Compliance: Essential: Secure APIs, identity and access management, encryption, data protection, payment security, audit, and operational resilience. Preferred: Tokenization, fraud controls, customer authentication, and payment security standards.

**Experience Requirements**

* 12–15+ years of experience in Banking, Payments, Consulting, Solution Architecture, or related fields.
* Strong expertise in payment ecosystems and transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience in client-facing consulting, advisory, or architecture roles.
* Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition, account expansion, opportunity shaping, and revenue growth.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders and global banking and payments clients.
* Experience designing enterprise solutions involving cloud, APIs, integration, modernization, security, and data.
* Experience in regulated industries is preferred.
* Equivalent professional experience demonstrating domain, architecture, consulting, and commercial expertise may be considered.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Meet clients and senior stakeholders to understand business priorities and challenges.
* Lead discovery workshops and assess business and technology environments.
* Develop target architectures, solution roadmaps, proposals, and business cases.
* Identify and qualify new opportunities across target accounts.
* Support account planning, pipeline reviews, RFPs, and proposal governance.
* Prepare executive presentations, solution demonstrations, and industry points of view.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, finance, legal, and domain teams.
* Review estimates, risks, dependencies, scope, commercial assumptions, and delivery feasibility.
* Make recommendations on architecture, investment, solution scope, and delivery approach.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Enterprise architecture, cloud, payments, banking, security, or project management certifications are preferred.
* Completion of Synechron security, compliance, conduct, and role-specific training is required.
* Ongoing learning in payments, banking regulations, cloud, security, and financial technology is expected.

**Professional Competencies**

* Structured problem-solving and sound commercial judgment.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence decisions.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

* 4+ years of development and design experience on Sitecore
* Sitecore Certified Developer
* Strong skills in ASP.NET, C#, MVC and SQL
* Solid knowledge of Helix architecture and Sitecore development best practices
* Proven experience creating templates, pages and custom personalization rules
* Experience customizing Sitecore content APIs used by other applications
* Experience deploying and supporting Sitecore in a scaled enterprise environment
* Working experience in an Agile / Scrum team

* Experience integrating LLM services such as Azure Open AI into web platforms, with awareness of data privacy and responsible AI controls in a regulated environment
* Headless experience with Sitecore JSS, Next.js and GraphQL

* Wealth management product knowledge: investments, mutual funds, bonds, structured products, priority and private banking propositions

* Self motivated and self starting; owns tasks end to end with minimal supervision
* Eager to learn and quick to adapt when requirements change
* Strong team player with an agile mindset and a drive for continuous improvement
* Able to influence teams on technical decisions by sharing deep knowledge
* Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas to senior and executive management

* Work on high-visibility digital platforms for one of the region's leading banks
* Get hands-on with Sitecore's latest AI and composable capabilities
* Grow within a collaborative, Scrum-based engineering culture working with a UAE client team

**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Reconciliations
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: 102700

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.
  
CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

  

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

**Job Purpose:** Responsible for performing and monitoring reconciliations of contingent and off-balance sheet General Ledger accounts, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of balances between source systems and the General Ledger. The role supports effective financial control through the identification, investigation, escalation and resolution of reconciliation exceptions while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Perform daily reconciliations between source applications, sub-ledgers and the General Ledger for assigned contingent and off-balance sheet accounts.
* Review and analyse reconciliation reports covering Trade Finance, Collections, loan commitments, undisbursed facilities and other designated contingent accounts.
* Identify and investigate reconciliation differences, unmatched entries, aged items, abnormal balances and other exceptions.
* Review transaction details, accounting entries, interfaces and audit trails to determine root causes of reconciliation breaks.
* Engage with Operations, Product and Technology teams to facilitate timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Maintain exception trackers and monitor progress until all issues are appropriately resolved and closed.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue reconciliation exceptions to management.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation MIS, ageing analysis, trend reporting and management dashboards.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements to controls, data quality and automation.
* Ensure compliance with Bank policies, accounting controls, audit requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in banking operations, Trade Finance, reconciliation, financial control, business analysis or systems/change delivery.
* Hands-on experience in application-to-General Ledger reconciliation, exception investigation and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of contingent and off-balance sheet accounts and Trade Finance products is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with DCR (Data Control Reconciliation) or a similar automated reconciliation platform is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to investigate and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good understanding of General Ledger reconciliation, accounting controls, exception ageing and balance substantiation.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and data reconciliation techniques.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar analytics tools would be advantageous.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities within tight reporting deadlines.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Marketing & Product Content Specialist with 5 to 7 years of regional experience to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and market expansion across the Middle East and Africa (MEA).

This is a hybrid role. Half of the position covers core B2B marketing: market research, LinkedIn and digital marketing, event participation, and website and social media improvement. The other half is a product marketing and content function: working directly with product owners and innovation teams to understand the mobile banking and fintech products being developed for banks and financial institutions, and turning them into clear, compelling sales material that the Sales and Business Development teams can use in the field.

The ideal candidate blends creative storytelling with analytical rigor, can speak confidently with technical and product teams, and translates complex financial products into compelling market propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Marketing & Product Content Development**

* Meet regularly with product owners, solution architects, and innovation teams to learn about mobile banking and fintech products being developed, including their features, use cases, differentiators, and roadmap.

* Create and maintain a library of sales-ready product material: product profiles, product presentations, product flyers, one-pagers, solution briefs, and demo storylines.

* Translate technical product capabilities into clear business benefits for banks and financial institutions, tailored by segment and region.

* Partner with Sales and Business Development to understand customer objections and information needs, and update product material accordingly.

* Keep all product collateral accurate, version-controlled, and aligned with product releases and brand guidelines.

* Support proposals, RFP responses, and customer presentations with product messaging and supporting content.

**Lead Generation & Market Research**

* Run LinkedIn-based lead generation, including targeted outreach, content-led campaigns, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager activity, to build a qualified pipeline for the sales team.

* Use market research, AI tools, and other data and enrichment platforms to identify target banks, financial institutions, decision makers, and emerging opportunities across MEA.

* Conduct continuous competitor benchmarking and market analysis to identify regulatory updates, regional banking trends, and emerging customer demands.

**Strategy & Campaign Management**

* Plan, manage, and optimize multi-channel campaigns spanning digital, direct, email, and partner channels to meet pipeline targets.

* Manage and allocate the regional marketing budget, monitoring return on investment (ROI) and cost-per-acquisition across all channels.

**Events & Exhibitions**

* Support event marketing and physical presence at key regional fintech and banking expos (e.g., Dubai Fintech Summit, Seamless Middle East & Africa, GITEX Global).

* Manage event execution, including booth design, collateral production, speaker placements, pre-event outreach, and on-site lead-capture workflows.

* Coordinate with event organizers, stand builders, and regional suppliers, ensuring delivery against deadlines.

**Digital Marketing, SEO & Web**

* Own the company's regional digital footprint across display and social media platforms, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and Google marketing.

* Manage and improve website content, ensuring strong user experience, conversion-rate optimization, and mobile responsiveness, including dedicated product pages built from the new product material.

* Execute technical and on-page SEO strategies to maintain visibility for high-intent fintech search queries.

* Track, evaluate, and report channel performance using Google Analytics (GA4), HubSpot/CRM dashboards, and search consoles.

**Brand & Content**

* Safeguard brand identity and governance across all regional touchpoints, presentations, and product collateral.

* Produce tailored B2B content including whitepapers, case studies, press releases, newsletters, and executive thought-leadership articles.

**Candidate Qualifications**

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline from an accredited university (e.g., American University in Dubai, University of Wollongong in Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, Heriot-Watt University Dubai, or equivalent).

**Professional Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with a proven track record within fintech, banking, or financial software.

* Demonstrated experience in product marketing or product content creation, such as product profiles, presentations, and sales enablement material.

* Demonstrated experience managing regional campaigns and exhibitions across Middle East and African markets.

* Proven experience generating B2B leads through LinkedIn and research-driven outreach.

**Technical & Platform Skills**

* Hands-on mastery of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and SEO audit tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Moz).

* Proficient in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, search platforms, and email automation and CRM tools (HubSpot, Marketo, or similar).

* Practical experience using AI and research tools for market research, lead identification, and content drafting.

* Experience with website CMS platforms (WordPress, Webflow) and a basic understanding of HTML/CSS.

* Strong presentation and design skills (PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) for product decks, flyers, and social media creative.

**Competencies & Language**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic or French proficiency is an advantage for North and West African market coverage.

* Ability to understand technical banking and mobile banking products and explain them simply to business audiences.

* Strong stakeholder skills, with the confidence to work with product owners, innovation teams, and senior sales leaders.

* Strong numerical aptitude with experience tracking customer journey metrics, attribution models, and marketing budgets.

* Outstanding project management and vendor negotiation skills.

In the UAE, Yubi Mortgage operates as a premier digital mortgage marketplace connecting residents, UAE nationals, and non-resident homebuyers with 25+ leading retail, Islamic, commercial, and digital banks. By combining AI-driven underwriting tools, Business Rules Engines (BRE), and dedicated relationship management, we make home financing faster, simpler, and fully transparent.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our Mortgage team in Dubai. Acting as the critical analytical and operational bridge between Yubi’s Relationship Managers (RMs), homebuyers, and our 25+ partner banks, you will evaluate borrower creditworthiness, verify mortgage application dockets, ensure strict compliance with UAE Central Bank (CBUAE) and partner lender policies, and drive smooth loan processing from pre-approval through to disbursement and registration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Credit Assessment & Underwriting Support**

* Evaluate incoming retail and commercial mortgage applications (salaried, self-employed, resident, and non-resident profiles) against partner bank credit policies and Yubi’s Business Rules Engine (BRE) criteria.
* Calculate Debt Burden Ratios (DBR), Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits, net disposable income, and affordability metrics in alignment with CBUAE mortgage regulations.
* Analyze bank statements, AECB (Al Etihad Credit Bureau) credit reports, income proofs, and financial statements to identify credit risks, liabilities, or red flags early in the lifecycle.
* Draft accurate, structured Credit Appraisal Memoranda (CAMs) and recommend optimal partner lenders to RMs to maximize approval conversion rates.

**2. Document Scrutiny & Non-Discrepancy Verification**

* Conduct thorough pre-sanction and post-sanction scrutiny of loan files, including KYC documents, Emirates ID/passports, salary certificates, trade licenses, property valuation reports, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), and Title Deeds/Oqood.
* Maintain a high first-time-right (non-discrepancy) submission rate by screening files for completeness and accuracy before submission to partner banks.
* Follow up proactively with RMs and borrowers to resolve pending documents, lender queries, and sanction conditions within defined Turnaround Times (TAT) and SLAs.

**3. Disbursement, Islamic & Conventional Fulfilment Coordination**

* Support post-approval execution across both conventional mortgages and Islamic home finance structures (such as Ijarah and Murabaha), ensuring all security documents (PDCs, manager's cheques, settlement letters, and NOCs) are verified.
* Coordinate seamlessly with partner bank credit/operations teams, legal teams, developers, and trustees to track cases from Offer Letter issuance to final disbursement and DLD/municipality mortgage registration.
* Track Post-Disbursal Documents (PDD) and ensure timely closure of compliance requirements.

**4. MIS Reporting, Compliance & Platform Excellence**

* Maintain accurate application trackers, CRM updates, and daily Management Information Systems (MIS) reports covering pipeline status, approval ratios, discrepancy trends, and TAT performance.
* Ensure 100% adherence to UAE AML/KYC guidelines, internal Delegation of Authority (DOA) matrices, and partner bank regulatory standards.
* Provide feedback to Yubi’s Product and Tech teams to improve automated document classification, OCR accuracy, and BRE matching workflows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Banking, Economics, or a related discipline (MBA/CA Inter/CFA Level 1 is a plus).
* Experience: 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in mortgage credit underwriting, home finance operations, or retail loan processing within a UAE bank, mortgage brokerage, or fintech lender.

Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of UAE mortgage products (resident/non-resident home loans, buyouts/equity release, commercial mortgages), CBUAE DBR/LTV guidelines, and both conventional and Islamic (Ijarah) financing workflows.

* Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial calculations, VLOOKUP, pivot tables), CRM/Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and AI-assisted document review tools.
* Core Competencies: Sharp analytical eye for detail, ability to manage high transaction volumes with zero errors, strong stakeholder communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced fintech environment.
* Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory; proficiency in Arabic or Hindi/Urdu is an advantage.

  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.

  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.

jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Experienced Permanent ID: 101458

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for the bank’s business banking asset portfolio. The role drives sustainable growth, profitability, customer value, and portfolio quality across lending solutions, including working capital, term finance, trade-related facilities, and secured and unsecured business loans. It leads the end-to-end product lifecycle, using market and customer insights to develop competitive propositions while ensuring effective risk, regulatory, operational, and digital delivery.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Growth**

Define and execute the business banking assets product strategy, roadmap, and annual business plan in line with the bank’s objectives and risk appetite.

Identify market opportunities and customer needs across working capital, term lending, trade-related finance, and secured and unsecured business loans.

Own portfolio KPIs covering origination, utilization, balances, revenue, margin, risk-adjusted returns, customer penetration, and portfolio quality.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

Lead the end-to-end design, approval, launch, enhancement, and rationalization of asset products and propositions.

Develop product features, pricing, eligibility, collateral, tenor, and channel propositions that balance customer value, competitiveness, profitability, and risk.

Maintain product programmes, policies, procedures, customer documentation, and governance approvals.

**Commercial Performance & Distribution**

Partner with relationship management, sales, segments, and channels to build pipelines, improve conversion, and deepen customer relationships.

Develop campaigns, sales tools, training, and performance insights to support disciplined portfolio growth.

Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback and translate insights into product actions.

**Risk, Compliance & Portfolio Quality**

Work with Credit Risk to define credit parameters, underwriting criteria, portfolio limits, and risk-based pricing.

Monitor arrears, delinquency, concentration, early-warning indicators, and emerging risks, and implement corrective actions.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, conduct standards, internal policies, and product-governance frameworks.

**Digital, Process & Customer Experience**

Lead digitization and process-improvement initiatives across origination, fulfilment, servicing, and renewals.

Use customer journeys and operational data to reduce turnaround time, remove friction, and improve service quality.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management**

Lead cross-functional delivery with Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Distribution.

Prepare business cases, requirements, implementation plans, and management updates, ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes.

Manage relevant external partners and vendors and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.

Minimum 8 years of relevant banking experience, including at least 5 years in business banking, SME or commercial lending product management.

Demonstrated experience managing asset products across the full lifecycle, from proposition design and governance through launch and performance optimization.

Strong knowledge of lending structures, pricing, credit assessment, collateral, portfolio risk, and the regulatory environment.

Proven ability to develop business cases and interpret financial, customer, market, and portfolio data.

Strong stakeholder leadership, communication, negotiation, and programme-delivery capabilities.

Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization tools; knowledge of SQL or other analytics tools is an advantage.

jobs.title: Director, Product Development/Management
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.
  
  
As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.
  
  
Visa is seeking a seasoned Director Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.
  
  
As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer-Centric Product: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Product Vision: Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals. Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Leadership: Set a role model of product management for the rest of product management team. Mentor new product managers, set processes. Take team forward on the set vision. Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation. Structure and manage complex projects and processes with multiple stakeholders.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.
* All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 5+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Senior product management experience in deep technical platform with exposure to Data management, ML/AI platform solutions.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated intellectual rigor.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
* Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.
  
  
Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.
  
  
You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.
  
  
The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
* Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Essential Skills:**

* 14+ years of industry experience
* Bring significant product leadership experience, leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong payments expertise, including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking.
* Have experience across payment investigations and exceptions, including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into scalable product capabilities, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven automation and straight-through processing across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs.
* Can influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about AI and emerging technology, while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and coach and develop product talent.

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**
This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.
  
  

* Move journeys from manual handling toward intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing.
* Determine where deterministic workflows are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore agentic and orchestration approaches while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access.
* Use exception and outcome data to move from exception resolution toward exception prevention.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* Think product, not project: Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**
