jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

jobs.description:
**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you sold credit cards, POS machines, ERP systems, Accounting systems, other Payment instruments.

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)
* POS: 3 years (Preferred)
* Key Account Management: 3 years (Required)

jobs.description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
  
  
PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
  
  
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
Custom description
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a strategic, highly structured Lead Product Designer / Design Manager to head the design for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms pod. You'll own the end-to-end design strategy for this scope, bring operational clarity to complex, multi-quarter projects, and lead and grow a team of 4–5 designers.
  
  
This is a high-leverage role. The Payment Gateway is how online businesses accept payments through PhonePe — the experience you design is felt by merchants and, downstream, by every customer who pays them. The details are hard, the constraints are real, and the work directly moves the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (Competencies & Role Expectations)**

* Co-own Product Roadmaps: Work closely with leadership to understand the overarching business vision and translate it into actionable, design-first GTM strategies for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms.
* Mentorship & Team Structuring: Manage, mentor, and scale a pod of 4-5 designers. Pivot effectively from individual contribution to strategic delegation—optimizing team structures, guiding career growth, and overseeing the quality of hires.
* Influence & Partner: Build deep trust with business unit leadership. Operate as a "first team" with leaders by helping them achieve their functional goals through design. Proactively resolve conflicts and align stakeholders toward common objectives.
* Build to Learn: Direct intuitive product architecture with a strong “build to learn” mindset. Emphasize continuous prototyping, synthesize insights from usability testing, and weave them into the core product strategy.
* Drive Measurable Outcomes: Define North Star metrics for your features and utilize data to form actionable insights. Ensure that design outputs directly influence business revenue and deliver measurable results.
* Holistic Architecture: Direct the team to take a holistic view of the product ecosystem, employing journey maps and service blueprints to align stakeholders and improve end-to-end service delivery.
* Orchestrate Complex Delivery: Own the planning, triaging, and delivery of multiple large, complex projects spanning across quarters. Balance competing priorities and tactically unblock teams to deliver work faster.
* Elevate Visual Systems: Deliver best-in-class, cohesive visual experiences by unifying design systems, motion, and UX copy. Foster tight feedback loops between graphics, creative, and product design teams.
* Technical Synergy: Translate complex technical/backend capabilities into highly scalable, delightful, and user-friendly interfaces, ensuring designs exploit technical constraints to enable speed and security.
* High-Quality Handoffs: Leverage your deep understanding of frontend systems and code as a medium. Deploy robust processes for smooth, repeatable engineering handoffs through high-touch communication and clear documentation.

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 7–10 years of product design experience, with real ownership of complex enterprise, B2B, or fintech platforms.
* 1–2 years managing and scaling direct reports — you've grown designers, not just reviewed their work.
* Proven craft: A portfolio that shows depth: interaction design, visual rigor, and clear reasoning behind each decision.
* Technical acumen: Deep comfort navigating technical constraints to design scalable, developer-friendly interfaces. You speak engineering's language.
* Systems thinking: You design for the whole product and are fluent with design systems — when to extend one and when to break from it.
* Strong communication: You write clear UX copy, make a tight case for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback. You manage stakeholders without losing the user's point of view.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain kn

"

**Job Description**

Job Description

**Life Cycle Management**

* You will be responsible for understanding customer needs and insights with help of market insights team
* You will own end to end ownership of managing Life cycle by building the brand architecture, Global / Local innovations, new patient segments, brand extension ideas, pill plus and consumerisation. Building Business case with growth scenario assessment.
* You will drive the growth projects along with CFTs and country teams to ensure sustainable brand growths.

**Portfolio Maximization - Strategy**

* You will support country teams to Evaluate and classify the product portfolio as Build, Milk, Exit.
* You will provide plan recommendations to country as well as monitor investment as per the strategy.
* You shall assess promotional effectiveness and suggest country teams accordingly
* You will be responsible to drive Cost optimisation - COGS / SCM overheads

**Annual Brand Planning**

* You shall work closely with country marketing teams to build differentiators / brand levers
* You shall work closely with analytics and in-sighting teams to develop strong and actionable insights for brand growth
* You shall work closely with country teams, SFE and digital marketing to deploy innovative GTM and access strategies.
* You shall ensure adherence to Brand plan process in terms of rigour and preparation

**New Product Ideation & portfolio development:**

* You will drive understanding customer needs and current dis-satisfaction through primary research in chosen spaces to build meaningful and differentiated concepts
* You will lead screening internal & external data sources to arrive at potential ideas that could address the customer needs
* You will drive development of Business Strategy- analyse Competition landscape, Customer Journey and Insights, develop TPP, pricing, packaging, positioning - attribute analysis, value proposition, positioning concept check. Reasons to win.

**New Product Launch Excellence**

* You shall
  work closely with the country brand team to build Go-To-Market strategy following the T-12 process of launch readiness. Build differentiators and the reasons to WIN.

  work closely with the country to drive T-12 launch readiness Process - Market Analysis, PESTLE, Segmentation, Targeting, Positioning, pricing, KOL Mapping, Distribution strategy, Brand Levers, Tactical planning, Marketing Mix and spend. Also build T+24 growth initiatives for new launches in collaboration with the country team

**Marketing Excellence**

* You are responsible for driving future growth plans by identifying the growth opportunities and developing the best of class tools, templates and processes to improve segmentation, targeting, positioning and communication
* You shall work closely with the L&D teams for capability building among the country teams to make them future ready
* You should have a good understanding of consumer communication, packaging and media to ensure excellence in consumer led brand growth

**Business Understanding:**

* You should have a sound understanding of Product Management - Process, Customer Journey and Insights, Positioning, Ideation to Launch, PLC Management, Sales and marketing effectiveness metrics
* You should lead the development and implementation – in collaboration with Business Analytics, Market Research, and Competitive & Scientific Intelligence – of a clear ROI-based approach to consumer marketing based on analytical models, insights and information leading to best-in-class consumer marketing practices across the organization

**Qualifications**

Qualifications, Critical Skills & Exposures

5+ years’ experience in marketing in RX , OTC space. MBA from reputed institute

* Experience in Brand Management, Strategic planning, Business analytics, TA knowledge, New Product - Ideation to Launch
* Experience running successful projects including marketing campaigns
* Good knowledge of digital marketing, web analytics, Google Ad-words and creating digital campaigns
* Strategic Orientation: Converts market insights into actionable brand plans, launch strategies, delivering revenue growth
* Stakeholder Leadership: Builds trust-based relationships across HO/COE and country teams, enabling seamless collaboration and execution

"

**Job Title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms**

* Wealth and Personal Banking serves millions of customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative distribution channels.
* As the Product Manager - VOC Platforms, you will act as a product owner and expert for our VOC platforms. You will manage and govern the development and utilisation of the platforms such as Medallia and MMX (complaints platfrom). You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will ensure the platforms deliver value to the business and are used effectively. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. You will manage the relationship with platform suppliers to maximise value to IWPB by driving the implementation and adoption of new functionality and ensuring the rapid and effective response to our required fixes and CRs.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage the full product lifecycle to ensure that, over time, the needs of the platform users continue to be met
* As platform SME, work closely with Technology, Transformation, D&A and market teams to ensure the VOC platforms change agenda is delivered on time and in budget. Be hands-on and remove delivery blockers through appropriate action and escalation
* Operationalise the voice of the customer platform at its full potential across users, securing ROI and value to business and customers

**Platform management (BAU)**

* Manage the integrity of the platforms and all aspects of the of business-as-usual platform operation
* Improve platform functionality, eg. Text Analytics evolution, Topic creation, AI, rules, process, triggers, surveys
* Monitor the performance of the platform to optimise value to the local and global change agenda
* Ensure platforms updates are implemented, assessed and used

* Own the global operationalisation of the customer platforms (e.g. Medallia; Complaints platform)
* Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and issues
* Communicate and align with multiple stakeholders across organizational levels and locations
* Work creatively and solution-focused, demonstrating collaboration, innovation, and excellence
* Establish gaps in platform utilisation and opportunities to create value to business from the platform capabilities

* Obsess about how to apply technology and data to solving problems or finding new opportunities

* Previous experience in implementing and configuring customer platforms (e.g. Medallia, complaints platforms)
* Previous experience in creating and managing text analytics rules and topic trees; closed loop alert rules, user roles
* Experience in a global roles, with proven experience in working in a cross functional matrix environment
* Knowledge in customer experience metrics (e.g. NPS, CSAT, Ease) and customer experience measurement
* Data driven analytical approach to problem solving, looking to understand the underlying causes, so that we can build a global solution rather than a series of point solutions
* An entrepreneurial drive, with the ability to deconstruct and solve problems
* Experience with the range of product development and deployment activities including identifying opportunities and developing business cases, defining product requirements, engaging a wide range of functional experts to agree deployment approach, project execution, launch, and post launch performance measurement and management.
* Experience of Design Thinking and leading run ahead work to explore new problems or potential ideas, bringing in Design, Analysis, Architecture and Engineering colleagues
* Good communication skills for navigating through business requirements, differences of opinion on approach
* Proven ability to build strong relationships across stakeholder groups
* Excellent understanding of the bank’s risk framework and experience of working with second line of defence: legal, compliance, financial crime (AML & sanctions), fraud, risk
* Strong outward focus and grasp of the competitor environment – opportunities, threats, gaps
* Demonstrable resilience and persistence – a ‘can-do’ attitude

jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

Job description:

Job Description – Business Development Manager (Field Sales)

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years  
**Job Location:** Mumbai (Open to candidates across Mumbai and nearby locations)  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field-Based Role

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and target-driven Business Development Managers to drive business growth by connecting with founders, business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. The role involves field sales, client acquisition, relationship building and converting qualified prospects into customers.

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet business owners, founders, directors and decision-makers through daily field visits.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, references and follow-ups.
* Identify businesses that require funding-readiness support.
* Explain the services, programme fees, deliverables and terms transparently.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain daily records of leads, client visits, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM.
* Submit daily sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate with the internal team after successful client onboarding.

Target Audience

You will primarily connect with:

* Manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers.
* Traders and exporters.
* Retail and restaurant businesses.
* Clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses.
* Education businesses.
* D2C and e-commerce brands.
* Technology startups and entrepreneurs.
* Logistics, textile and other business sectors.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–8 years of experience in target-based sales.
* Experience in Banking, NBFC, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, Financial Products or B2B Field Sales preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Comfortable with daily field visits and meeting business owners.
* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* **During Probation (First 3 Months):** 5 verified paid clients per month.
* **After Confirmation:** 10 verified paid clients per month.

A client is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and onboarding is completed.

Salary & Incentives

**Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000**

Incentive structure:

* 0–4 verified paid clients: No incentive.
* 5–9 verified paid clients: ₹20,000 incentive.
* 10 or more verified paid clients: ₹40,000 incentive.

Salary consists of base wages and a target-linked component, as specified in the written offer.

**Travel Allowance:**

* During probation: ₹3/km for bike and ₹2/km for scooty, based on field kilometres recorded in the CRM.
* After probation: ₹3,000 per month.

Training & Joining Process

* 7-day online training programme before employment.
* Training starts: 1 December 2026.
* Certification is mandatory.
* Shortlisted candidates will complete joining formalities on 7 December 2026.
* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in field sales ?
* How many years of experience you have in NBFC?
* Can you work from Pune?
* Please mention your current CTC
* Please mention your expected CTC
* Please mention your notice period?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate - Legal Counsel - Cross Border - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

**Description**
---------------

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.

**Job Description**
As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools. You will identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver measurable impact by automating and augmenting complex operational workflows with reliable, auditable agents.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Agent Development and Delivery

+ Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
+ Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.

* Evals and Prompt Improvement

+ Build and run the evaluation program for agents: task-level benchmarks built from real operational cases, regression gates in CI, and online monitoring tied to business outcomes.
+ Lead systematic prompt and program improvement using automated optimization techniques (e.g., GEPA, DSPy, AutoPrompt), driven by execution traces and failure analysis.

+ Partner with AI Engineering to design scalable agent and model serving on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Bedrock/SageMaker), with orchestration, model gateway routing, versioned prompt/model registries, sandboxed tool execution, and rollouts gated by eval regressions.
+ Define and enforce SLOs for task success, latency, and cost per task, using distributed tracing, caching, and tiered model routing to meet them.

+ Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML data scientists, guiding iterative experimentation and tracking progress to deliver measurable outcomes in an agile manner.

* Drive Model Methodology Documentation

+ Champion documentation of methodologies, results, and best practices for knowledge sharing

+ Align design and delivery across partner teams to maintain execution velocity, and drive clarity on prerequisites for AI/ML development.
+ Engage stakeholders in an agile manner to develop, demo, and iterate on deliverables. Work closely with Operations, Technology, and Transformation teams to solve complex problems with AI.

* MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.

* Hands-on experience building production agents, including the harness (function calling, context and memory, planning, orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls), rigorous evals for multi-step systems, and systematic prompt optimization (GEPA, DSPy, or AutoPrompt) with measured production gains.

* Problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as a leader within cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Demonstrated experience in financial services, particularly investment banking operations.
* Experience with agent safety and security: prompt injection defense, permissioning, sandboxing, audit logging, and adversarial testing of autonomous workflows

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. jobs.title: Vice President, Treasury Product Control GBS
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

**Risk Management**

* Support effective compliance by embedding an effective Operational Risk Framework (ORF) within the PC-VC process universe to ensure all areas manage operational risks in a proactive, risk based and disciplined manner.
* Support functioning of day-to-day controls, by performing periodic assessment and monitoring activities (CST & KCI) as well as timely identification, escalation, and resolution of risk issues
* Support and monitor compliance with Operational Risk policies, procedures, and applicable regulations within PCVC and advice wherever changes are required.
* To actively support exercising of direct Risk Control Ownership / Process ownership for Operational Risk to ensure risks of processing failure are being actively owned and resolved on an end-to-end basis

**Governance and Stakeholder management**

* Regular face off with Traders, Product Control Management, Regional finance team and various internal stakeholders within GFS.
* Act as a point of reference for team members and internal clients.
* Manage relationship with internal stakeholders, take regular feedback, anticipate and understand issues and escalate appropriately for timely resolution
* Manage strong relationship with support teams (IT, Operations and Risk) and bring synergies by interacting and integrating with cross functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* MBA, CA, CFA, ACCA with a minimum of 10+ years experience (post qualification) in a financial service industry with at least 2+ years of People Management experience.
* Strong leadership skills and ability to manage teams
* Control mindset and ability to identify and mitigate and control gaps
* Good understanding of financial market products
* Ability to develop, implement and maintain effective and standard operational processes.
* Excellent people and resource management skills.
* Excellent Interpersonal skills. Should be able to communicate at all levels.
* Strong planning, negotiation and analytical skills.
* Excellent business writing and verbal English communication skills
* Ready to travel & work in shifts.

jobs.title: Asset & Wealth Management - AM Digital Technology-Bengaluru-Vice President-Software Engineering
Solution Architect, VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect
  
  

* We’ll look to you to lead the solution architecture definition for your assigned change programme, in addition to delivering business outcomes for both customers and colleagues
* You'll be driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Solution Architect, you’ll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architecture.
  
  
You’ll be actively contributing to the growth of architecting capability and the community across the bank by sharing knowledge including best practices, proven solutions and key learnings, contributing to the community of practice, and building capability in others through coaching, mentoring and teaching.
  
  
**As Well As This, You’ll Be**

* Supporting the realisation of the Enterprise and Solution Architecture, working as part of development teams throughout the engineering development lifecycle
* Providing technical guidance, resolving architectural impediments, and championing the adoption of architecture patterns and practices
* Proactively influencing stakeholders to embed the reuse of digital capabilities, contributing to simplification and the realisation of the bank’s strategic target architecture
* Partnering and engaging with programme stakeholders and following the bank’s data driven architecture method and framework to define and evolve the minimum viable solution architectures that deliver the programme objectives and business value
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Undertaking design reviews of delivery programmes of high architectural significance or high architectural risk

The skills you'll need
  
  
To take on this role, you’ll need extensive knowledge of solution architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success.
  
  
You’ll bring experience of defining and developing strategic solution architectures that align with organisational objectives. This will include experience of engaging with partners across the organisation to define architectures that deliver tangible business outcomes. You'll need an experience of 15+ years for this role.
  
  
**You’ll Also Demonstrate Experience Of**

* Collaborative decision-making processes, partnering with business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Creating business cases to influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Participating in architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* Proven people capability development, including mentoring, supporting professional development, encouraging knowledge sharing across architecture teams and promoting best practices

Process Manager - Product Owner, MDM
jobs.description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition:**

* Drive Enterprise Data Trust: Lead strategic Data Quality and Master Data Management initiatives that directly improve business decision-making, operational efficiency, compliance, and data readiness across the organization.
* Shape the Future of Data Maturity in MDM : Build and mature enterprise-wide capabilities in Data Quality, MDM, Reference Data Management, while influencing senior leaders and driving transformational change

**Job Details**

* Position Title: Process Management, MDM
* Career Level: P4
* Job Category: Assistant Vice President
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bangalore

**About The Team**
The Master Data Management team is responsible for establishing trusted, governed, and business-ready MDM data assets across the organization. Our mission is to enable high-quality, consistent, and accessible data that powers operational excellence, analytics, and digital transformation using Master Data Domains.
  
  
Implement and monitor data quality dimensions including completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, accuracy, and timeliness.
  
  
Conduct ongoing assessments and reviews of critical enterprise data assets.
  
  
**Impact**
The Product Owner for Master Data Management is responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, and delivery of FCB's Unified Master Data Management (UMDM) platform.
  
  
The role partners closely with UMDM Business Owners, Data Governance, Architecture, Compliance, Operations, and Agile delivery teams to establish a unified and trusted source of MDM Customer, Relationship, and Reference Data across the enterprise.
  
  
The Product Owner is accountable for prioritizing the MDM backlog, defining business requirements, and ensuring the delivery of data capabilities that support regulatory compliance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, reporting, analytics, and downstream consumers and applications in Batch and Realtime.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the UMDM product roadmap and align delivery objectives with FCB's data strategy.
* Define and prioritize capabilities supporting:

+ Customer and Party Master Data
+ Relationship Management
+ Reference Data Management
+ Data Quality and Data Governance

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process simplification and data standardization.
* Ensure MDM capabilities support strategic business initiatives and regulatory requirements.

**Backlog Management**

* Own and prioritize the MDM product backlog.
* Develop Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Balance competing priorities across business units and technology teams.
* Ensure stories are sufficiently refined and ready for sprint execution.
* Drive backlog grooming and prioritization sessions.

**UMDM Platform Ownership**

* Define requirements for:

+ Golden Record Creation
+ Match and Merge Rules
+ Survivorship Rules
+ Hierarchy Management
+ Party Models
+ External Identifier Management
+ Address Management
+ Data Stewardship Workflows
+ UI for Users C360
+ Mandatory columns and Integration requirements for batch/real-time

* Partner with architects to evolve the enterprise customer data model.
* Ensure alignment between source systems, UMDM, and downstream consumers.

**Data Quality and Governance**

* Collaborate with Enterprise Data Governance teams.
* Define business data quality rules and data standards.
* Oversee implementation of MDM / DQ services including CDQ, Address Validation, and external data providers like D&B.
* Partner with Collibra and Data Governance teams to ensure data lineage, metadata management, and policy compliance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to data quality, completeness, accuracy, and duplicate reduction.

**Leadership/Stakeholder Engagement**

* Facilitate workshops or participate in requirements gathering with Product Owners, Business Users, Data Stewards, and Technology teams as required.
* Present updates, risks, and metrics to leadership.
* Manage delivery expectations and drive decision-making.

**Agile Delivery Leadership**

* Participate in:

+ Sprint Planning
+ Backlog Refinement
+ Sprint Reviews
+ Retrospectives

* Provide clarifications to development and testing teams.
* Review completed stories and approve business acceptance.
* Ensure business value is delivered for Sprints/ Program.

**Testing and Release Management**

* Define UAT scope and acceptance criteria.
* Support SIT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation activities.
* Validate parity testing between source systems and UMDM.
* Ensure releases meet business requirements.
* Sign off on production deployments and post-release validation.

**Required Experience**
**Professional Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Data Management or Enterprise Data Programs.
* 5+ years in Product Owner, Lead Business Analyst, Product Manager, or MDM leadership roles.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale Customer or Party Master Data Management solutions.
* Experience working within Financial Services, Banking, Wealth Management, Commercial Banking, or Risk Management environments.
* Experience managing distributed and offshore delivery teams.

**MDM Expertise**
**Strong Experience With**

* Informatica Multidomain MDM / UMDM
* Customer 360 and Party Data Models
* Onboarding Data
* Match and Merge Configuration
* Survivorship Rules
* Hierarchies and Relationships
* Data Stewardship
* Golden Record Management
* Regulatory Data Requirements

**Experience With**
**Platform/Technology Experience (Preferred)**

* Informatica MDM
* Informatica IDMC, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ)
* CDQ Validation Services
* D&B Data Integration
* Collibra
* Oracle and SQL Databases
* Data Lake and Analytics Platforms
* APIs and Event-Driven Architectures

**Required Competencies**

* Product Ownership
* Requirements gathering
* Backlog Prioritization
* Stakeholder Management
* Data Governance

**Technical Competencies**

* Enterprise Data Architecture
* Data Modeling Concepts
* Data Integration Patterns
* Metadata and Lineage
* Data Quality
* Reporting and Analytics Enablement
