jobs.title: OneLIMS Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sanofi**
At Sanofi, we are an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**OneLIMS program**
is a strategic global initiative to modernize and standardize Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) across Sanofi's entire worldwide QC laboratory network. The program aims at delivering a unified, compliant, and future-ready digital platform, carrying significant impact and touching hundreds of users across Sanofi's global operations.
  
  
The
**OneLIMS Product Line Manager**
owns the OneLIMS solution as a digital product — including
**Core LIMS**
,
**LES (Laboratory Execution System)**
, and integration with partner solutions. This role is a key decision maker, accountable to the business for delivering value to customers, and owns the entire product lifecycle from design, build, test, release, sustain & maintain, and eventually until retire.
  
  
The Product Line Manager leads a dedicated cross-functional team composed of:
  
  

* Core LIMS Product Owner
* LES Product Owner
* Integration Lead
* OneLIMS Configuration Manager

**Main Responsibilities**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Aligning product to business needs & priorities: ensuring alignment between Quality Function (QC Excellence, Quality Programs team, GBU priorities), deploy business & digital leads, and Product Owners to constantly align & prioritize needs, Core product, LES or integration related
* Continuously develop and communicate the product vision to development teams and define, orchestrate, sequence the features of the system and handle relative interfaces (core models, instrument core models) commensuratly with Qc modernization & performance improvements
* Contribute to and maintain Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) to help ensure that the solution meets relevant regulations, standards, and other system quality requirements, keep adequate cybersecurity status, and manage obsolescence upfront
* Define KPIs and value proposition, acting according to impacts (Continue, Adjust, or Stop) in alignment with Business stakeholders
* Product Lifecycle Management
* Manage end-to-end core solution delivery, lifecycle, configuration, interfaces, and integration with partnering solutions and instruments / LISS program
* Own the roadmap, illustrating how features are intended to be implemented over time in line with Business priorities/stakes towards value realization, performance & compliance
* Manage the flow of work into the program backlog
* Manage backlog refinement and drive features prioritization efforts
* Be responsible for release definition, deciding when enough value has accrued to warrant a release to the customer together with Product owners & Business owners (LES/Core LIMS/connectivity)
* Participate in product increment objectives approval and business value achievement measurement
* Cross-functional Orchestration
* Orchestrate delivery (solution lifecycle management), build and run activities
* Prioritize, coordinate, and aggregate the delivery roadmap; align the team towards common goals, priorities, and planning, addressing interdependencies and synchronization across LES, Core LIMS, integration activities, and deployment activities
* Build and manage a cross-functional team (Core LIMS Product Owner, LES Product Owner, Integration Lead, Configuration Manager)
* Maintain close interaction with the OneLIMS Deploy Lead to ensure smooth deployment and address deployment-related needs
* Present the product vision, highlighting proposed features and relevant milestones
* Compliance
* Oversee solution compliance with applicable regulations and internal rules
* Ensure that OneLIMS digital products and computerized systems meet all controls to address applicable regulations and cybersecurity requirements
* Manage obsolescence and ensure cybersecurity of the solution

**About You**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in digital product management, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industries
* Proven experience managing digital products with global scope
* Hands-on experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or similar enterprise-level scientific or quality systems is highly desirable
* Solid understanding of GxP-regulated environments, quality, compliance, and regulatory requirements as well as cybersecurity related constraints
* Demonstrated ability to lead and build cross-functional, multicultural teams

**Required Skills**

* Advanced Product Management: end-to-end ownership of product lifecycle, customer research, and product vision definition, with aligned decision-making (business/digital) on product direction
* Advanced Stakeholder Management: ability to engage and align business and technology stakeholders across multiple sites and functions, operating with a high degree of independence
* Advanced Agile practices: backlog refinement, Kanban flow management, feature prioritization, and Program Increment (PI) objectives
* Good understanding of QC laboratory operations and scientific workflows in regulated environments
* Deep knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks: GxP, data integrity, cybersecurity …
* Advanced data-driven decision-making: KPI definition, value measurement, and analytics-based prioritization
* Cross-functional team leadership: ability to build, manage, and motivate distributed product teams across multiple geographies
* Strong integration and architecture understanding system interfaces and partner solution integration in regulated IT environments
* Change management: experience driving adoption of digital products in complex, matrixed organizations
* Innovation mindset: focus on leveraging emerging technologies and continuous improvement to deliver competitive advantage
* Cultural intelligence: ability to work effectively across diverse, global teams and geographies

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency with product management tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Understanding of LIMS architecture and QC laboratory solutions ecosystem
* Data analysis and reporting capabilities to track product performance and communicate insights to stakeholders
* Knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, and IT architecture in regulated environments

**Education**

* Master's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (required)
* Product Management certification advantageous
* Additional certifications in Agile or digital transformation are a plus

**Pursue**
***Progress.***
**Discover**
***Extraordinary.***
Progress doesn't happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let's pursue Progress. And let's discover Extraordinary together.
  
  
At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
  
  
Watch our ALL-IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Technology Delivery & Digital Platforms (AEM)
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.
  
  
This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.
  
  
**Leadership opportunity:**
Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, modernization objectives, client outcomes, and long-term platform roadmaps.
* Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
* Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
* Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Lead platform and digital-experience modernization focused on cloud adoption, APIs, automation, observability, resiliency, simplified architecture, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
* Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
* Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
* Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
* Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed teams and developing technical talent across multiple roles and experience levels.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and secure development practices.
* Experience partnering with product and business leaders to shape technology strategy, manage priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, cross-team dependencies, organizational change, and vendor or third-party relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading modern front-end and digital-experience technology teams, with exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content-management platforms, design systems, accessibility standards, and scalable digital-experience architectures. This capability is strongly recommended because the role is expected to expand into the AEM and front-end technology space within FAST.
* Experience delivering client- or advisor-facing digital products in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, serverless architecture, API-led integration, data platforms, and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience applying AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation within software engineering, operations, or digital product delivery.
* Experience leading platform modernization, operating-model evolution, or transformation across multiple products and teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a **Senior Vice President, Data** **& Infrastructure** , to join our **Risk & Compliance Analytics & Reporting team** . This position is based in **Pune/Chennai** , with an expectation of 4-5 days per week in the office. The role will report to the Head of Data & Infrastructure horizontal in Risk and Compliance Analytics & Reporting.

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Apply quantitative techniques from applied mathematics, statistics, econometrics, and risk modeling to solve business problems, assess risk, and generate insights that support decision-making across Risk & Compliance.
* Work on AI,GenAI,and machine learning use cases, using modern data science approaches for document intelligence, summarization, classification, knowledge extraction, intelligent search, workflow automation, and advanced analytics.
* Design and deliver scalable digital solutions by contributing across the full solution lifecycle, including ideation, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement, in partnership with business and engineering teams.
* Build and enhance data pipelines, dashboards, UI/UX and reporting solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, and enterprise platforms, working with both structured and unstructured data.
* Support data-driven transformation by improving processes, strengthening controls, and building hands on skills across analytics, data, engineering, automation, and emerging technologies
* Build and operationalize a centralized calculations service (rules, versioning, traceability) to ensure consistency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness across dashboards and reports.
* Build and govern a comprehensive metadata program—including catalog, lineage capture, classification, ownership (RACI), stewardship, and approval workflows—to improve discovery, traceability, and audit-readiness.
* Elevate data quality through critical data element (CDE) governance, validation rules, profiling, anomaly detection, and proactive remediation workflows; publish data quality scorecards and ownership.
* Provide executive-ready data health reporting and platform metrics that link infrastructure performance to business outcomes, risk posture, and regulatory commitments; maintain clear decision logs and evidence packs.
Align platform strategy with BNY’s strategic pillars—be more for our clients through usable data products, run our company better with automation and controls, and power our culture through collaboration and standards.  

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* 8-10 years in in data architecture, platform engineering, analytics or data product leadership; experience in financial services and Risk/Compliance domains strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of risk and compliance frameworks (e.g., KRIs/KCIs, RCSA, issues/actions, surveillance, regulatory reporting) and ability to map them to measurable analytics.
* Proven expertise in enterprise data design (dimensional/normalized models), canonical data forms, vectorization/embeddings, semantic layers, and distributed data systems.
* Hands-on experience with metadata cataloging, lineage, data governance, and access controls across regulated environments.
* Familiarity with AI/ML platform components (feature stores, embedding/vector databases, model registries, monitoring/explainability) and MLOps/DataOps practices.
* Demonstrated track record delivering executive-grade dashboards and reporting at enterprise scale based on understanding of user journeys
* Proficiency with SQL, data warehousing/data lakes, streaming, orchestration, and observability tools; familiarity with Python and ML pipelines is advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—able to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and influence senior leaders.
* Intellectual curiosity, enthusiasm, and adaptability to rapidly assimilate new information and operate with a strong delivery focus in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; advance degree in a quantitative areas like business, finance, engineering, or related disciplines; relevant industry certifications or qualifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

The Team more over acts as a support function and performs processes like Document Gap analysis, Pan validation and Centralized Know your customer (CKYC) uploads to CERSAI Portal. The team also participates in periodic internal and external audits, regulatory submissions and furnish refresh datapoints to relevant stakeholders.

* Ensure regulatory and audit readiness through accurate reporting, evidence preparation, query resolution, control monitoring, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Oversee remediation and risk-management activities, including Aadhaar remediation governance and coordination with Business Control, Remediation, and Outreach teams.
* Drive process improvement and operational efficiency, including simplification of document-review activities and improvements to the BOFASI KRA download process.

* Partner with Process Design to develop and enhance BANA India Refresh workflows, including L4 process mapping, identification of process gaps, improvement opportunities, and potential automation areas.
* Manage team delivery and capability development through workload management, one-on-ones, goal setting, knowledge sharing, training completion, recognition, hiring support, and employee engagement.
* Coordinate with senior leadership, local and onshore teams, governance partners, Business Control, Process Design, COO partners, and regulatory stakeholders to manage priorities, queries, issues, and dependencies.

**Skills:**

* 7-12 years’ experience in Anti-Money Laundering (AML)/ Know your customer (KYC).

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. * 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.

Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of trading services? At JPMorganChase, we offer an exciting opportunity for career growth and development as a Trading Services Manager. As a Trading Services Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in our team, leveraging your deep knowledge of trade activities and market products to ensure seamless order execution and settlement. Your role will involve managing a diverse team, interpreting customer needs, and identifying trends to generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for end-to-end trade processing control, monitoring asset and cash levels, and driving continuous improvement in our operating platform. Your advanced understanding of automation technologies and data literacy will be crucial in optimizing our systems and making data-driven decisions. As a recognized expert in your field, you will use your strong presentation skills and influence to communicate insights, manage internal stakeholders, and lead your team through change. Your work will have a wide-ranging impact on our operations, financial management, and service delivery, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

* Utilize advanced knowledge of market products to monitor and manage asset and cash levels, identifying trends and potential risks.
* Implement automation technologies and data analysis techniques to optimize trading systems, enhance efficiency, and inform strategic decisions.
* Lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in our trading services.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, leveraging strong presentation skills to communicate insights, drive change, and align operations with the firm's strategic objectives.

* 7+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in trading services, specifically in order execution, trade execution, and settlement.
* Demonstrated advanced skills in using automation technologies to optimize trading systems and processes.
* Advanced knowledge of market products, including their definitions, operating procedures, and relevant industry regulations.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a diverse team, with a focus on fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
* Expertise in data analysis techniques, with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to inform strategic decisions.
* Expertise to create presentations across various levels. Ability to deliver in person & virtual presentations to senior management and stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Skilled in leveraging digital literacy to adopt and integrate innovative technologies, enhancing trade services and operational efficiency.

**Job Description**
**Custody Product Manager**
**The opportunity & role purpose**
Emirates NBD Capital Custody is building a larger, more connected custody franchise combining high-touch local service, regional and international market access, the wider Emirates NBD ecosystem and institutional-grade control. We are seeking a commercially minded Product Manager to turn this ambition into a prioritized, scalable and profitable product roadmap.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Own the end-to-end Custody product agenda across strategy, proposition, commercial performance, governance and delivery. The role will optimize existing services, expand the product set and support new business across priority client segments.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
Product strategy and proposition
  
  

* Define and maintain a three-year product roadmap based on client demand, commercial value, strategic fit, delivery complexity, risk and scalability.
* Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and technology developments across local and global custody, sub-custody, funds, collateral and digital assets.
* Lead new-product development from concept through business case, approval, operating model, pricing, launch and adoption.
* Evaluate build, buy, partner and network options, ensuring solutions are commercially viable and operationally deliverable.

Commercial and business development
  
  

* Partner with Business Development, Relationship Management and the wider Emirates NBD franchise to convert client needs into viable solutions.
* Support pitches, RFPs, due diligence, pricing and solution design for new and existing clients.
* Create segment-led propositions, identify appropriate target clients and build profitability models for new products.
* Own product performance across Assets under Custody, revenue, pricing, yield, linked cash, FX, ancillary income and fee leakage.

Delivery, technology and client experience
  
  

* Act as product owner for priority change, defining scope, requirements, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks and benefits.
* Work with Technology and Operations to increase automation and straight-through processing across onboarding, settlement, corporate actions, reporting, reconciliations, billing and service quality.
* Advance client connectivity through portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and configurable reporting; maintain a transparent backlog and escalate blockers early.

Governance and market engagement
  
  

* Ensure propositions meet product approval, legal, regulatory, tax, financial-crime, data, cyber-security and operational-risk requirements.
* Maintain a robust product-control framework with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations and Internal Audit.
* Manage relationships with exchanges, CSDs, ICSDs, global custodians and vendors; represent Emirates NBD Capital in relevant client and industry discussions.

**First 12 months**

* Diagnose - Validate the current product perimeter, client needs, operating constraints, economics, control gaps and in-flight change.
* Prioritize - Agree a funded three-year roadmap and decide what to accelerate, partner for, defer or stop.
* Deliver - Progress the highest-value capabilities, focusing on market connectivity, institutional and sub-custody readiness, digital servicing, reporting and automation.
* Commercialize - Package propositions by segment, equip client-facing teams and embed product-level pricing and profitability disciplines.
* Measure - Establish a monthly scorecard covering assets, revenue, profitability, linked cash, activity, adoption, delivery, service health and realised benefits.

Measures of success:
  
  

* Roadmap delivery against agreed milestones, budget and benefits.
* Incremental Assets under Custody and revenue enabled by new or enhanced products.
* Improved product yield, linked cash, ancillary wallet capture and pipeline conversion.
* Greater adoption of portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and automated reporting.
* Reduced manual touchpoints, exceptions, service issues and operational risk.
* Timely product approvals, control remediation and effective change governance.

**Essential**
**Experience and capabilities**

* Minimum five years' relevant experience in custody, securities services, post-trade, transaction banking, market infrastructure or a related institutional financial-services business.
* Proven product-management experience across strategy, business cases, governance, requirements, delivery, launch and performance.
* Working knowledge of safekeeping, settlement, corporate actions, cash, FX, tax, reporting, reconciliations and custody operating models.
* Strong commercial judgement, linking client needs and product choices to pricing, profitability, assets, revenue and wider relationship value.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and work across Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Sales and Relationship Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Highly desirable
  
  

* UAE or GCC custody experience and familiarity with SCA, UAE exchanges, CSDs and regional institutional clients.
* Knowledge of global-custody networks, ICSDs, sub-custody, fund settlement, collateral, securities financing or custody-linked lending.
* Exposure to TCS BaNCS, SWIFT, APIs, SFTP, client portals, institutional reporting, Agile delivery or digital-asset propositions.

The person we are looking for
  
  
You combine product depth with commercial energy. You can navigate operational details and bank governance while maintaining pace and ambition. You are credible with clients, precise with control functions, pragmatic with technology and comfortable presenting investment cases to senior management.
  
  
If you do not meet every requirement but believe you can materially contribute to our ambition, please apply with a covering letter explaining the value you would bring.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.
  
  
We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.

* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Presales Director
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
  
  
The Opportunity Ahead
  
  

* Shape and lead the presales function of a fast-growing B2B fintech from an early stage, with a direct line to the founders.
* Work with top banks and cutting-edge credit infrastructure on high-visibility, high-value deals.
* Own the story behind products that run for millions of end users.
* Fast-paced, high-learning environment with strong growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Business Head - BFSI
jobs.description:
Business Head – BFSI | OTPless

Bengaluru or Mumbai · On-site · 8–12 years

**ABOUT OTPLESS**

OTPless builds the authentication, identity and trust infrastructure for digital businesses. We power login and user journeys for Zepto, Meesho, Ixigo and ShareChat, we run 300Mn+ silent verifications a month, and we're backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. We were founded by the founding team at BharatPe.

Authentication is where we started — Smart Auth is live across some of India's largest consumer and financial businesses. Our next growth engine is OTPless Watch, a device and risk intelligence platform that combines device fingerprinting, app protection, telecom and IP signals, and identity data to help businesses spot suspicious activity and make better risk decisions. Watch sits right next to Smart Auth, so businesses get authentication and fraud intelligence from one place.

**THE ROLE**

We're hiring a Business Head to own the entire OTPless BFSI business — the full vertical, end to end, across Smart Auth, Watch and everything we take to market in financial services.

You'll own the BFSI P&L outright: the strategy, the revenue, the customers and the roadmap. That means growing and deepening our existing Smart Auth footprint in BFSI, and opening the next frontier with Watch — starting with fintechs and NBFCs, then banks and insurance. You'll find the market, prove the products, carry the number, and build the business.

You won't be starting from zero. Smart Auth is already live in production with Navi, Paytm and Bajaj, which gives you relationships, reference customers and a running start to expand across the vertical and pull Watch into live accounts.

This is a hands-on ownership role — you'll lead the biggest deals yourself and work directly with the CBO and the founders, with real influence over product, pricing and strategy.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* The business. The full BFSI P&L — strategy, revenue growth and ownership across the vertical. You decide which fintechs, NBFCs, banks and insurers to go after, grow the accounts we already have, build the relationships that matter across Product, Risk, Fraud and Business teams, and set the pricing and commercial models that make the motion repeatable.

* The market fit. Run discovery with real buyers, find the use cases where OTPless wins, and work directly with the Product and Engineering teams to turn what you hear into roadmap. Use our live Smart Auth relationships to expand accounts and pull Watch into them.

* The deals. Lead consultative engagements end to end — discovery, solution design, technical evaluation, POC, commercial close and expansion — across the full OTPless stack. Prove measurable outcomes, not demos.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Above all, someone who can own and grow a BFSI business — a builder who carries revenue, closes senior deals and can be trusted with the full vertical. Beyond that, we're looking for:

Domain & experience

* 8–12 years across product, growth, strategy or business roles, with real ownership of revenue or outcomes
* Deep experience in fintech, payments, UPI, digital lending, NBFCs, banking or insurance, and a real grasp of the Indian BFSI ecosystem
* A track record on products or deals involving fraud, risk, trust and safety, identity, authentication or digital onboarding
* Live relationships inside fintechs and NBFCs; connections into banks and insurers are a plus

Product & technical depth

* You don't have to code, but you're technically credible — you can sit with an engineer, understand how it works, and shape what gets built
* Comfort with APIs, SDKs, device intelligence, fingerprinting, SIM binding, risk scoring and digital onboarding flows
* You can translate what a customer needs into product requirements, and work with Product and Engineering to get it built

Business & growth instinct

* You turn market opportunities into revenue — hunting new logos and growing the accounts you already have
* Strong consultative selling, senior stakeholder management and commercial negotiation
* An entrepreneurial streak — you can operate alone, build from nothing, and own the outcome end to end

**STRONG SIGNALS**

This is likely to fit people coming from:

* Payments & fintech: Juspay, Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cashfree, CRED
* Lending & NBFCs: Navi, KreditBee, Fibe, Lendingkart and other tech-led lenders
* Fraud, risk & identity: Bureau, SHIELD, Signzy, HyperVerge, IDfy, GoKwik
* Banks & financial institutions: product, digital banking, payments and fraud-risk leaders

We're especially keen on product, growth and strategy people who've worked close to business, tech and risk teams and now want to own a business, not a backlog.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6 MONTHS)**

* A clear BFSI strategy and target-account universe across the full OTPless portfolio
* Existing Smart Auth accounts grown and deepened, with measurable revenue
* 5–10 lighthouse fintech/NBFC wins across Smart Auth and Watch, with banks and insurers seeded in the pipeline
* A repeatable business development and account-growth motion
* Validated high-value use cases that have moved the product roadmap
* Real cross-sell between Smart Auth and Watch

**WHY OTPLESS**

You'll own an entire vertical with real P&L responsibility, at the intersection of payments, identity and fraud — three of the spaces moving fastest in Indian financial services. You build on top of an authentication platform and customer base that already exist, not a blank page.

You'll work directly with the CBO and the founders — the founding team behind BharatPe — backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. It's early enough that you shape the business, the product and the commercial model, with the autonomy and ownership of a founder and the backing of a company that's already at scale.

If you're ready to move past managing a product and own a business, let's talk.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transpare

Identify emerging industry, regulatory, GCC and technology trends, and convert them into targeted opportunity plays, propositions and thought leadership.

Create proactive propositions, value hypotheses, executive points of view and client-ready collateral, including quantified business cases tied to measurable banking outcomes.

Lead or support strategic BFS pursuits, including discovery, solution shaping, RFPs and RFIs, orals, solution defense and executive presentations.

Direct the design and development of PoCs, PoVs, reusable assets and accelerators, with a strong focus on AI, GenAI, data-led transformation and modern operating models.

Develop India as a global hub for BFS domain capability, ensuring that expertise, solutions and assets created in India are accessible and reusable across regions.

Build, mentor and grow the India ISG BFS team, strengthen domain communities and create practical mechanisms for knowledge sharing across delivery and account teams.

Represent the organization in relevant GCC, client, analyst, advisor and industry forums in India, while supporting global market positioning where required.

Share explicit accountability for proactive pipeline creation, strategic deals, solution adoption, TCV and revenue growth across India and supported global markets.

**Candidate profile**

15+ years of professional experience, primarily in Banking & Financial Services, gained within financial institutions, GCCs, consulting, professional services or global technology services organizations. Quality and seniority of experience matter more than tenure alone.

Senior experience leading or advising BFS transformation, industry solutions, domain consulting, product, operations or technology programs.

Strong understanding of the India GCC landscape and the role GCCs play in global financial institutions, including capability expansion, product and platform ownership, transformation, innovation and enterprise-wide delivery.

A proven record of engaging senior stakeholders in India and internationally, with the credibility to advise business, product, operations and technology leaders as a peer.

Deep BFS domain and operating-model knowledge across the front, middle and back office, with working knowledge of core platforms, data, cloud, digital channels, payments, risk, compliance and RegTech.

A strong record of shaping large change and transformation programs with measurable impact on outcomes such as cost-to-income, cycle time, straight-through processing, control effectiveness, customer experience and revenue growth.

Practical depth in financial-services AI and GenAI, including where it creates value, where it does not, and how to prove and scale outcomes through PoCs and PoVs.

Ability to shape and sell propositions internally and externally, build business cases, secure sponsorship, navigate complex stakeholder groups and lead solution narratives.

Strong commercial understanding of large programs, including proactive propositions, RFPs and RFIs, solution defense, pricing trade-offs, TCV and revenue impact.

Experience working effectively across geographies and time zones, mobilizing matrixed teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create executive-ready content and lead senior client conversations.

**Preferred experience**

Leadership experience within, or significant advisory experience serving, a Global Capability Center in India.

Experience advising Product Management and Digital Product Management organizations on product strategy, operating-model design, value realization and digital product innovation.

Experience building domain-led solutions or consulting capabilities that have been deployed across multiple geographies.

Financial-services M&A, post-merger integration, captive setup, capability transition or GCC transformation experience.

Experience engaging industry analysts, advisors and external forums.

**What the role offers**

A mandate to build India as a global hub for BFS domain expertise, propositions, thought leadership and reusable solution assets.

A US-headquartered payments technology company providing end-to-end payment processing, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and e-commerce payment solutions to businesses across the United States. The organization is establishing and scaling its core technology and engineering hub in Bengaluru to power next-generation merchant payment infrastructure.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on, strategic Director of Engineering – Payments (7–14 years experience) to lead platform architecture, engineering execution, and team scaling in Bengaluru. You will partner directly with US executive leadership (CEO/CTO) and product stakeholders to build high-throughput, secure, and resilient payment processing, POS, and merchant orchestration systems from the ground up.

-Strong experience in Fintech, NBFC, Digital Lending, BFSI or Consumer Internet.

-Proven track record of managing and scaling large marketing budgets.

-Experience in building teams and delivering measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Full Stack Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?

If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
  
  
We want to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack.
  
  
**About Us**
At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money.
  
  
Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform.
  
  
Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights.
  
  
**Modulr values**

* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.

**The Role**
The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead
  
  
the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams.
  
  
**Specific duties**

* Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices.
* Technically efficient to write production-quality Python code, designing high-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards.
* Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues.
* Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend & frontend through 1-2-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression.
* Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking.
* Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend.
* Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy.
* Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values.
* Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation.

**About You**
**Must Have**
:
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in Python (9+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices.
* Strong, hands-on experience with FastAPI, including building high-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations.
* Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full-stack integration and frontend-backend communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc).
* Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes.
* Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud-native application patterns.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations.
* Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision-making in a collaborative environment.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.

**Good to have:**

* Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing.
* Experience in the fintech or payments domain.

**Key Attributes:**

* Strong problem-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies.
* Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems.
* Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions.

**ModInclusion**
At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.
