jobs.title: Head of MarTech & Personalisation
jobs.description:
**Head of MarTech & Personalisation**
=====================================

The **Head of MarTech & Personalisation** makes sure every inDrive user sees the right service, offer and communication at the right moment - and, as a result, uses more of the app’s verticals, more often.

inDrive grew out of ride-hailing and is becoming a super app: rides, delivery, intercity, food, groceries and financial services. Most users still live in a single vertical. The SuperApp platform owns multi-vertical growth and frequency, and personalisation is its main lever; MarTech is the layer that makes personalisation run at scale.

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.title: Head of Operational Risk
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced banking risk professional to lead the Operational Risk function at slice.

As a digital-first, AI-first bank, we are building banking products and experiences that challenge traditional ways of operating. We need someone who can think from first principles, anticipate risks in an evolving banking environment and build operational risk frameworks and processes that are robust, scalable and suited to how a modern bank operates.

This is a senior leadership role that goes beyond traditional risk monitoring and compliance. The individual will be responsible for identifying, assessing and managing operational risks across the bank, while building systems and controls that enable innovation, speed and responsible business growth.

Working closely with the Chief Risk Officer (CRO) and business leadership, this person will play a critical role in shaping how operational risk is understood, measured and managed across the organisation. We are looking for someone who combines strong banking risk fundamentals with the ability to question existing practices, solve complex problems and build for the future.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, implementation and continuous enhancement of the bank’s Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, processes and controls, ensuring they are scalable and aligned with the bank’s digital-first operating model.
* Identify, assess, measure, monitor and mitigate operational risks across the bank, including emerging risks associated with digital banking, AI-led processes, technology, products and evolving business models.
* Support the CRO in developing and operationalising the bank’s risk appetite framework, including risk limits, thresholds, monitoring mechanisms and escalation processes.
* Establish and strengthen risk management practices including Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), scenario analysis, operational loss event management and control effectiveness assessments.
* Lead the identification, investigation and escalation of operational risk incidents, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions and monitoring of remediation.
* Partner with business, Product, Technology and Operations teams to assess operational risks associated with new products, processes, partnerships and business initiatives, ensuring appropriate controls are embedded from the outset.
* Provide independent operational risk oversight across banking activities, including digital transactions, payments, deposits, lending and treasury-related operations, with a strong understanding of the operational implications of liquidity and market risks.
* Develop and strengthen operational risk controls for outsourcing and third-party arrangements, including vendor risk assessments, operational dependencies, business continuity and service disruptions.
* Support the CRO in enhancing risk governance, management reporting and committee dashboards, providing actionable insights on risk exposures, emerging trends, control effectiveness and remediation progress.
* Ensure the bank’s operational risk practices remain aligned with applicable RBI regulations, regulatory expectations and internal governance requirements.
* Act as an independent second line of defence, working closely with senior stakeholders across the bank to challenge decisions where necessary, strengthen risk ownership and enable responsible business growth.
* Build and lead a high-performing Operational Risk team, fostering a culture of accountability, proactive risk identification and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Experience:**
  12–20 years of experience in the banking sector, with significant expertise in Operational Risk Management, preferably in a senior leadership role.
* **First-Principles Thinking:**
  Ability to challenge conventional approaches, identify risks in new and evolving business models, and design practical, scalable risk frameworks rather than relying solely on established processes.
* **Domain Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of banking operations and associated risks, particularly in digital banking, payments and transaction processing, with exposure to deposits/liabilities, treasury operations and related liquidity and market risks.
* **Risk Management:**
  Proven experience in building and strengthening operational risk frameworks, risk appetite monitoring, RCSA, KRIs, incident management and regulatory governance.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of RBI regulations, banking risk governance and experience engaging with risk committees, auditors and senior management.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to independently challenge senior business leaders, simplify complex risk issues and balance risk considerations with business priorities.
* **Leadership:**
  Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience building teams, establishing processes and driving cross-functional initiatives.
* **Qualifications:**
  Graduate or postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Professional certifications such as FRM or PRM would be an added advantage.

jobs.title: Vice President - Technology- Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
  
- Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
  
- Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
  
- Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
  
- Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
  
- Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
  
- Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
  
- Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
  
- Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
  
- Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
  
- Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
  
- Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
  
- Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
  
- Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
  
- Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
  
- Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
  
- Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
  
- Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key Result Areas: --
  
A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning
  
- Partner with assigned Groups to translate strategic priorities and change demand into an integrated technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap.
  
- Lead/support annual and in-year budget formulation for CAPEX and OPEX projects, challenging scope, estimates, sequencing, dependencies, resource needs, benefits and delivery readiness.
  
- Coordinate initiation, planning, estimations, benefits articulation and business-case / Executive Summary preparation; review submissions for completeness, quality and decision readiness and provide required Transformation Office sign-off.
  
- Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.
  
  
B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting
  
- Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.
  
- Track projects against approved scope, schedule, cost, milestones, resourcing, risks, dependencies and benefits baselines; identify variance and require credible recovery actions.
  
- Produce concise, evidence-based Group portfolio reporting highlighting performance, exceptions, decisions required and forward outlook.
  
- Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.
  
- Forecast portfolio performance, delivery milestones, financial utilization, emerging risks and likely year-end outcomes; identify potential slippage, under-utilization or value leakage early.
  
C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods
  
  
- Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
  
- Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.
  
- Escalate material non-compliance, delivery risk and control weakness, and track agreed remediation to closure.
  
- Assure that onboarded Project Managers understand and apply Mashreq Methods; provide coaching, training and targeted knowledge transfer.
  
- Where specifically required, act directly as Project Manager / recovery lead for selected critical or complex initiatives without diluting independent assurance across the wider portfolio.
  
- Contribute lessons learned and practical enhancements to Mashreq delivery Methods and Transformation Office standards.
  
D. Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory
  
  
  
- Work with Group Heads, project sponsors, business/technology owners and Project Managers to remove delivery blockers and resolve cross-project or cross-functional issues.
  
- Serve as trusted advisor on change demand, portfolio composition, prioritization, execution choices, dependencies, delivery risk and value creation.
  
- Create fact-based escalation paths for issues requiring senior leadership intervention, with clear options, impact and recommended action.
  
- Build effective working relationships across Technology, Business, Functions, Finance, Procurement, Technology GRC, ISG, ORM, Internal Audit, Compliance and other relevant functions.
  
E. Benefits & Value Realization
  
  
- Work with accountable business owners to define measurable financial and non-financial benefits, establish baselines, ownership and realization timelines.
  
- Ensure approved benefits are recorded, tracked and periodically validated through the delivery lifecycle and after go-live where applicable.
  
- Challenge gaps between investment cases, delivered capabilities, adoption and realized outcomes; escalate material benefit shortfalls and agree corrective actions.
  
  
  
F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability
  
- Provide functional leadership to Project Managers supporting assigned portfolios, setting expectations for delivery discipline, transparency and escalation.
  
- Assess PM onboarding/readiness, coach performance and reinforce consistent application of Mashreq Methods and reporting standards.
  
- Support assignment of appropriately skilled Project Managers to initiatives based on complexity, risk and critica

jobs.title: Financial Crime Operations Executive Manager
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress, make better financial decisions, and achieve their goals. Every day, our people use technology, data, and innovation to create better experiences and outcomes for our customers.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Economic Crime Services - Financial Crime Operations
  
  
Financial Crime Operations plays a critical role in protecting our customers, the financial system and society from economic crime. We bring together operational expertise, risk-based decision-making, data, technology and strong partnerships to detect, investigate and respond to financial crime threats.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a significant portfolio supporting CommBank’s Australian operations from India.
  
  
You will be accountable for delivering safe, sustainable and high-quality operational outcomes across one or more financial crime disciplines. These may include Transaction Monitoring, Enhanced Customer Due Diligence, Customer and Payment Screening, fraud-related investigations, remediation, Suspicious Matter Report preparation, specialised risk queues, Quality and Performance, or other enabling capabilities.
  
  
You will lead through a period of significant regulatory, technological and operational change. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Strategy and Performance, Technology and Transformation teams, you will ensure effective detection, investigation, escalation and mitigation of financial crime risk.
  
  
The role requires an enterprise leader who can balance customer, risk, people and performance outcomes while building a future-ready operation.
  
  
The existing role profile also establishes responsibility for Australian financial crime operations, close collaboration across Operations, Risk, Compliance, Quality and Technology, and leadership of the India-based team.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
General Manager, Financial Crime Operations, CBA India
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Strategic and operational leadership**

* Lead the strategy and execution of a large and complex Financial Crime Operations portfolio.
* Translate enterprise and Economic Crime Services priorities into clear operational plans, measures and accountabilities.
* Deliver agreed service, quality, productivity, customer and risk outcomes.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational capacity, queue health, demand, productivity, ageing, service levels and emerging risks.
* Ensure the operating model remains sustainable, scalable and aligned to changing business and regulatory requirements.
* Provide clear, timely and evidence-based reporting to senior leadership and governance forums.
* Make sound decisions across competing priorities, balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term strategic outcomes.
* Support operational resilience and continuity through effective workforce, succession and contingency planning.
* The current FCO operating model includes Transaction Monitoring, CDD/KYC, screening and focused risk queues, Performance and Enabling capabilities, and Quality Assurance, with a future-state focus on rationalised leadership spans and increased work complexity.

**Financial crime risk and governance**

* Promote strong risk ownership and ensure financial crime risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed within applicable frameworks.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational controls, incidents, issues, quality results, audit actions and remediation commitments.
* Ensure operations comply with relevant policies, procedures, regulatory obligations and agreed risk appetite.
* Oversee complex investigations and escalations, ensuring decisions are appropriately evidenced, documented and governed.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk and Quality teams to interpret requirements and implement them consistently across operations.
* Champion a proactive risk culture where colleagues feel safe and accountable to identify concerns, challenge decisions and raise emerging risks.
* Ensure changes to processes, controls, detection approaches and operational procedures are assessed and implemented through appropriate governance.
* FCO governance includes oversight of operational risks, queue performance, process changes, detection-rule changes, policy application, issues and incidents, and the prioritisation and implementation of change.

**Transformation, simplification and technology**

* Lead the successful operational implementation of strategic change, including new processes, platforms, analytical models and risk-based detection and investigation approaches.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve controls, remove duplication and increase operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to improve decision-making, workforce deployment, quality and customer outcomes.
* Champion responsible adoption of automation, artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve financial crime detection and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure new technology and process changes are supported by appropriate operational readiness, capability, controls and governance.
* Build a culture of curiosity, experimentation and continuous improvement while maintaining effective risk management.

**Stakeholder engagement**

* Act as a senior FCO representative and trusted partner between the India-based operation and Australian business, operations, risk and compliance teams.
* Build strong, transparent and constructive relationships with senior stakeholders across Economic Crime Services, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Technology, Transformation, Workforce and Human Resources.
* Surface risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and provide practical recommendations to support decisions.
* Influence outcomes across organisational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
* Promote a whole-of-organisation mindset and ensure that local delivery decisions support broader enterprise outcomes.
* Represent the portfolio in senior operational, risk, governance and transformation forums as required.

**People and culture leadership**

* Lead and inspire a large, diverse workforce through a clear sense of purpose and shared accountability.
* Build a strong leadership team with clear responsibilities, effective spans of control and robust succession plans.
* Attract, develop and retain high-quality financial crime and operations talent.
* Coach senior leaders to strengthen strategic thinking, risk ownership, commercial judgement and people leadership.
* Set clear performance expectations and ensure fair, consistent and timely performance and development conversations.
* Build capability through targeted learning, cross-skilling, leadership development and career pathways.
* Foster an inclusive and psychologically safe environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed.
* Role-model the organisation’s values and leadership principles, including care, courage and commitment.
* Strengthen engagement, wellbeing and connection across teams while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

**Success measures**
Success in the role will be demonstrated through:
  
  

* Sustainable achievement of service, quality, productivity and customer outcomes.
* Effective management of operational and financial crime risks.
* Timely identification, escalation and closure of incidents, issues and control gaps.
* Strong audit, assurance and regulatory outcomes.
* Successful implementation and embedding of strategic change.
* Improved process efficiency, simplification and use of technology.
* Strong colleague engagement, capability and lead

jobs.title: Vice President and Area Head Bangalore
Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates within one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Extended Leadership Team, and report directly to the Senior Director and Head of Specialist & Consulting Delivery, VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Director, Consulting Delivery will lead the consulting delivery team within VCA-X and will be responsible for ensuring consulting resources are effectively deployed, developed, and supported across the portfolio. They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.
  
  
This leader will ensure VCA-X engagements have the consulting capacity, expertise, and leadership required to deliver high-quality client outcomes. Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Of The Role Include**
Specialist & Consulting Organization Leadership
  
  

* Build and manage a flexible consulting delivery pool that can be deployed across priority use cases, Regions, and multidisciplinary engagement teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing specialist and consulting talent.
* Partner with Program Management to forecast consulting resource needs and ensure sufficient consulting delivery capacity to support engagement demand.
* Foster a culture of intellectual rigor, collaboration, learning, and client impact.

Consulting Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Ensure engagements are staffed with the appropriate consulting capabilities and delivery support required to achieve engagement objectives.
* Provide oversight for complex, high-impact, or strategically important engagements.
* Lead deployment of consulting delivery resources across the VCA-X portfolio, balancing expertise, capacity, development opportunities, and delivery priorities.
* Coach teams in structured problem solving, insight development, recommendation formulation, and executive communication.
* Serve as an advisor and first escalation point for delivery teams.

Delivery Quality & Client Readiness
  
  

* Establish delivery standards, quality expectations, and review processes across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Ensure outputs are commercially relevant, supported by sound specialist judgement, and appropriate to client and market context.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Partner with Regional VCA teams to ensure outputs support successful client engagement.

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To ensure effective, accurate and timely management of Finance and Accounting operations

for ESPL and its associated schools. The role is responsible for vendor accounting and

payments, employee reimbursements, statutory tax compliance, banking and cash

reconciliations, travel management, accounting operations, audit closure and accounts

receivable.

accounting activities and continuous improvement in financial controls, ensuring adherence

to organisational policies and timely resolution of stakeholder queries.

**A. Finance & Accounting Operations**

1. Manage and ensure accurate accounting of all vendor bills and payments in **Zoho**

Books.

3. Conduct vendor account reconciliations every six months (August and February).

4. Maintain and regularly update the Vendor Payment Tracker.

5. Process employee reimbursements through Zoho Expense with accuracy and within

the defined timelines.

6. Ensure timely processing of approved employee reimbursement payments every

Friday.

7. Address and resolve reimbursement-related queries and discrepancies raised by

**ESPL** employees.

timelines.

9. Ensure timely bank account reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.

basis.

11. Coordinate with **Tally** support teams and assist schools in resolving accounting

software-related issues.

12. Ensure accurate day-to-day accounting entries and maintenance of financial records

in Zoho Books.

**B. Travel & Hotel Management**

1. Manage employee travel and hotel-related payments.

2. Ensure timely uploading and maintenance of travel balances wherever required.

3. Manage employee additions, deletions and modifications in the Travel Portal.

4. Address travel-related queries and provide timely support to employees.

5. Ensure proper reconciliation of travel and hotel accounts.

6. Maintain accurate records of travel-related expenses and payments.

**C. Statutory Compliance & Audit Management**

1. Ensure accurate accounting and maintenance of statutory financial records.

2. Monitor GST and TDS calculations and ensure timely accounting of applicable

liabilities.

3. Coordinate and manage statutory audit activities for ESPL.

4. Ensure availability and accuracy of supporting documents and financial records

required for audits.

5. Coordinate with auditors and internal stakeholders for timely closure of audit

observations.

6. Ensure audit closure within the prescribed TAT with minimal audit queries and

observations.

7. Take corrective action on audit observations and ensure that issues are not

repeated.

**D. Accounts Receivable & Revenue Accounting**

1. Raise tax invoices for revenues earned by Edunation in a timely and accurate

manner.

2. Ensure proper accounting of revenue transactions inZoho Books.

3. Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain accurate accounts receivable records.

4. Conduct regular follow-ups with concerned stakeholders for outstanding payments

and collections.

5. Ensure timely resolution of discrepancies relating to invoices and receivables.

1. Develop effective backup arrangements for all critical finance and accounting

activities.

2. Ensure continuity of operations during planned and unplanned absences.

3. Acquire knowledge of additional processes and cross-functional responsibilities.

4. Improve individual and team efficiency through learning and process familiarisation.

5. Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer of critical processes.

**F. Process Excellence, Automation & amp; ERP**

1. Identify opportunities for automation and ERP implementation across Finance and

Accounting operations.

2. Suggest and implement improvements to existing accounting processes.

3. Drive the implementation of centralised accounting processes across all schools.

4. Ensure strict adherence to the organisation's Finance Policy without deviations.

5. Identify process gaps and recommend corrective measures to strengthen internal

financial controls.

6. Standardise accounting practices and reporting processes across schools.

**G. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery**

1. Respond proactively to feedback and queries received from schools and REN

employees.

2. Ensure timely resolution of finance-related issues within the defined turnaround

time.

3. Provide accurate and quality resolutions to improve stakeholder satisfaction.

4. Maintain professional and responsive communication with all internal stakeholders.

5. Ensure recurring issues are identified, analyzed and addressed to prevent repetition.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a meaningful difference, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. As one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations, HSBC operates across 62 countries and territories.

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

jobs.description:
**Who we are**
We are a global wealth-tech company powering the next generation of trading. We deliver cutting-edge centralised trading solutions and robust B2B financial infrastructure. Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.

Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.
  
  
**The Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships to lead the development, expansion and management of EXANTE’s global banking and payment partner network.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
— Chair Of Executive Committee
  
  
**Worksite**
— Remote
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and expand our global banking network: Identify, evaluate and establish new relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across key jurisdictions, including Malta, Cyprus, the UAE and Mauritius, supporting EXANTE’s international growth and operational needs.
* Own the end-to-end counterparty lifecycle: Lead the entire process from initial engagement and commercial negotiations through due diligence, onboarding, account opening and ongoing relationship management, ensuring timely and successful execution.
* Drive commercial value: Negotiate competitive banking and payment terms, including transaction fees, interest on client balances, credit facilities, account conditions and service levels, with a focus on cost optimisation and long-term value.
* Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships: Build trusted, sustainable relationships with existing banking partners through regular engagement, proactive issue resolution and ongoing management of compliance requirements, account restrictions and service performance.
* Lead banking due diligence and onboarding: Coordinate complex KYC, AML and regulatory due diligence processes, working closely with internal Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to address counterparty requirements and facilitate successful onboarding.
* Ensure operational readiness and resilience: Partner with Finance, IT and Operations to establish effective banking and payment processes, including account structures, payment connectivity, transaction flows, reconciliations and contingency arrangements.
* Optimise counterparty diversification and performance: Monitor banking relationships, service quality, costs and counterparty concentration, identifying opportunities to mitigate risks, improve efficiency and strengthen the resilience of our banking infrastructure.
* Drive cross-functional execution and reporting: Collaborate with senior leadership and teams across the business to prioritise banking initiatives, manage multiple onboarding projects and provide clear visibility of partnership pipelines, commercial outcomes and emerging risks.

**What You Will Bring**
- Extensive relevant experience: At least 8 years of experience in banking relationship management, treasury, payment partnerships or financial institution coverage, ideally within a brokerage, fintech, payment institution, e-money business or financial services environment.
  
  

* Established banking network: Strong, active relationships with banks, financial institutions and payment providers, ideally across key international markets, including Europe, the UAE and other relevant jurisdictions.
* Proven track record of establishing banking partnerships: Demonstrable success in securing new banking relationships, opening corporate and client-money or safeguarding accounts, and establishing payment solutions for regulated financial services businesses.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills: Experience negotiating banking fees, interest arrangements, credit facilities and service agreements, with the ability to demonstrate measurable commercial improvements and cost efficiencies.
* Deep understanding of banking due diligence: Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, regulatory requirements and financial institution onboarding processes, particularly for businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions with complex international client bases.
* Knowledge of banking and payment infrastructure: Solid understanding of banking operations, client-money arrangements, payment flows and relevant payment systems, such as SWIFT, SEPA, local payment rails and banking APIs.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills: Ability to engage confidently with senior banking executives, compliance and risk teams, internal leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, building credibility and maintaining productive long-term partnerships.
* Strong execution and project management capabilities: A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple complex banking initiatives simultaneously and drive them through to completion.
* International financial services exposure: Experience supporting brokerage or financial services businesses with international client bases, particularly across European, CIS or Middle Eastern markets, would be a strong advantage.
* Communication skills: Fluency in English, with excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills

jobs.title: Knowledge Graph Devloper / Associate Director, Service Management
jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

67909

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Department**

Technology

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

26 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

03 December 2026

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
