**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

jobs.title: Director - Visa Direct Business Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.
* Lead analysis and recommendations on Visa Direct pricing, incentives and IRF changes, and support M&A, investment and partnership opportunities with due diligence and business cases.
* Scan market, regulatory and ecosystem trends (e.g. real-time payments, stablecoins, fintech disruption) and provide insights on impact to strategy and key initiatives; coordinate with the VCS BPO Director on topics spanning CMS.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.
* Optimize sales processes, tools (MS Dynamics) and funding programs (e.g. VIK, MDF), with training to improve the team's skills.
* Orchestrate account planning to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and drive the annual Global Client Engagement Survey (GCES) and corrective actions.

**Communications**

* Maintain internal communications (all-hands, newsletters) and share success stories across the CEMEA Money Movement organization.
* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.
* Coordinate planning cycles with Global Visa Direct and Global CMS BPO, bring global best practice to the region and reuse CMS BPO and Centers of Excellence capabilities rather than rebuilding them.
* Work as one team with the other CMS functional BPOs and CoE to share best practices from Visa Direct with the wider team

This role sits at the intersection of multiple functions, so organizational savvy and interpersonal skills are critical. It works with Product groups, AEs, Merchant Sales, Regions, Operations, Technology, Risk, Data Science, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Corporate Strategy, Interchange/Pricing and Finance. About 60% of the role is the recurring operating rhythm (planning, OKRs, MBR/QBR, pipeline and performance reviews, Opex) and 40% strategic, project and ad-hoc work. The individual will be a thought leader in strategy and business growth with a proven track record in fast-paced environments with demanding timelines.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD, PhD).
* Prior experience in management consulting or corporate strategy.
* Proven track record in annual and multi-year planning, OKRs and executive business reviews; strong financial acumen, including business cases and financial modeling.
* Financial/payment industry knowledge mandatory (money movement, cross-border flows); experience across emerging, multi-country markets such as CEMEA.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, customer-centric mindset and thought leadership, with evidence of tangible business results.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills; able to explain complex concepts to broad audiences and lead cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in.
* Strong sense of urgency and experience driving to successful commercialization; takes prompt, decisive action after analyzing relevant information.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
* Experience leading and developing people; inclusive, learning-agile, with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a technology / digital-first approach; English required, Arabic, Russian or French an advantage.
* High levels of learning-agility with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a ‘technology / digital-first’ approach.
* Diversity of thought and experience. Continually seeks new perspectives and feedback, takes an inclusive approach, and engages diverse points of view.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Our healthcare clients include mental health hospitals, residential and nursing care, supported living, children's services and specialist complex care. The role

We are hiring a Financial Controller to own the revenue cycle and day-to-day finance operations for the UK healthcare organisations our Finance Healthcare team supports. You will be accountable for cash, billing integrity and financial controls across receivables, payables and banking, lead the teams that deliver them, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). It is a senior role with real ownership in a function that is building to a corporate standard.

Reports to

Director, Finance (Healthcare)

- Revenue cycle: own it end to end for the UK healthcare entities, from funding and contracts to cash, with full accountability for results.

- Leadership: lead and develop the receivables and payables functions, and set their standards, priorities and performance rhythm.

- Billing integrity: run billing as a controlled monthly close in Odoo, with every variance explained and leakage fixed at source.

- Cash and working capital: improve cash conversion and the aged debt profile, and handle escalated disputes with NHS bodies, ICBs and Local Authorities.

- Controls: own the control environment across receivables, payables and banking, to an audit-ready standard.

- Experience with healthcare billing or practice management systems.

- GBP accounting and supporting UK operations from overseas.

Full time, on site, Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00.

Armada Tower 2, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai.

**Job Description**
**Global Account Manager – Etisalat Group**
**Location:**
Based in Dubai
  
  
**Account coverage:**
Entire Etisalat Group globally, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Fortinet is seeking a senior Global Account Manager to lead the strategic relationship with Etisalat Group worldwide, developing its potential as both a major enterprise customer and a strategic service-provider partner.
  
  
The role brings together two complementary growth strategies: sell-to, expanding Fortinet’s contribution to the Group’s own cybersecurity and infrastructure priorities; and sell-with, building joint propositions and go-to-market programmes that bring Fortinet-powered services to its customers.
  
  
The successful candidate will own the overarching global account strategy, build executive sponsorship and lead coordinated execution across Fortinet teams, Group functions, business units and operating companies. The role requires the ability to translate a complex multinational relationship into a focused business plan, strategic commercial agreements and measurable growth.
  
  
The Global Account Manager provides strategic leadership across local quota-carrying account owners, aligning priorities and enabling execution without replacing their direct sales accountability. Local account owners retain responsibility for their assigned quotas, opportunities and forecasts; the Global Account Manager leads the consolidated Group strategy, executive engagement and cross-market growth agenda.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Account Leadership**
Develop and lead an integrated, multi-year global account strategy spanning the Group’s internal technology requirements and customer-facing services businesses.
  
  
Build trusted executive relationships across Group leadership, operating companies and technology, security, commercial, product and procurement functions.
  
  
Establish joint priorities, executive sponsorship and governance to advance strategic initiatives and remove barriers to execution.
  
  
Translate Group-level priorities into coordinated local account plans, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
**Sell-To: Strategic Customer Development**
Position Fortinet against the Group’s cybersecurity, network modernization, cloud, data-centre and operational resilience priorities.
  
  
Identify strategic opportunities through a deep understanding of investment plans, architectures, decision-making processes and business objectives.
  
  
Lead Group-level engagement and support local account owners in complex sales pursuits, commercial negotiations and executive alignment.
  
  
Drive adoption and expansion across business units and operating companies through compelling business cases, shared reference architectures and demonstrated customer outcomes.
  
  
**Sell-With: Joint Solutions and Go-to-Market**
Co-develop a global growth strategy for Fortinet-powered offerings across the Group’s enterprise, SMB and managed-services businesses.
  
  
Work with product, commercial and technical teams to turn capabilities into market-ready propositions with defined customer segments, value propositions, commercial models and launch plans.
  
  
Develop joint sales plays, account targeting and demand-generation programmes with Group stakeholders, operating companies and Fortinet field teams.
  
  
Drive partner-sourced and co-sell opportunities from proposition development through pipeline creation and commercial execution, alongside the relevant local account owners.
  
  
Scale successful offerings across markets and operating companies, adapting to local demand, regulation and delivery capabilities.
  
  
**Commercial Frameworks and Executive Governance**
Lead the development and advancement of strategic framework, managed-services and other relevant agreements with Fortinet Legal, Finance and commercial stakeholders.
  
  
Establish joint business plans with clear objectives, accountable owners, milestones and success measures.
  
  
Lead executive business reviews and steering committees, translating strategic alignment into decisions, actions and business outcomes.
  
  
Maintain clear engagement and opportunity-ownership arrangements across global-account, local sales, alliance and channel teams.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Execution and Enablement**
Mobilize Fortinet Sales, Systems Engineering, Product and Marketing around agreed account priorities.
  
  
Coordinate across regions to provide a consistent global-account approach while enabling effective local execution.
  
  
Develop targeted enablement programmes that equip the Group’s sales, presales, product and delivery teams to position, sell and support joint offerings.
  
  
Share customer insights and successful practices across markets, bringing strategic requirements into Fortinet’s solution development and planning.
  
  
Maintain a consolidated global view of account performance, strategic opportunities and pipeline across sell-to and sell-with activities.
  
  
Align local account plans and forecasts with the overarching Group strategy, while preserving local quota and opportunity accountability.
  
  
Drive disciplined opportunity qualification and CRM reporting with local account owners; identify execution gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**
10+ years of experience in strategic or global account management, enterprise technology sales, service-provider business development or strategic alliances.
  
  
Demonstrated success managing large, complex relationships with telecommunications groups, service providers or multinational technology organizations.
  
  
A proven track record in both direct enterprise sales and partner-led growth, including joint solution development and co-sell execution.
  
  
Experience coordinating multinational account strategies across diverse markets, ideally including the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
  
  
Strong understanding of cybersecurity and networking, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to commercial value and customer priorities.
  
  
Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic agreements and multi-stakeholder sales engagements.
  
  
Executive presence and credibility with C-suite stakeholders, combined with the discipline to drive detailed execution.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience working with Etisalat / e& Group, its operating companies or comparable multinational telecommunications groups.
  
  
Familiarity with managed security services, service-provider productization and recurring-revenue business models.
  
  
Experience developing propositions spanning secure connectivity, SD-WAN, SASE, cloud and data-centre security, and security operations.
  
  
Experience within Fortinet’s ecosystem or a comparable cybersecurity vendor environment.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Fortinet is established as a strategic partner to the Group for both its internal transformation and customer-facing services.
  
  
A unified global account plan produces measurable growth across sell-to and sell-with activities, with effective execution by local account owners.

Group-level and local teams operate with clear accountability, consistent opportunity attribution and a coordinated approach to the account.

jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years’ enterprise sales or direct client coverage and relationship management of a broad spectrum of institutional clients: regional banks, central banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers
* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics
* Partner with global product heads to position Moody’s insights in the context of local and regional regulatory and industry trends, including private credit, lending modernisation, AI adoption, automation, KYC and supplier risk management, climate risk and digitised credit workflows
* Travel (~30 %) across the GCC and wider Middle East and, when required, to regional hubs to strengthen senior relationships and align global strategy
* Build, lead and empower high-performing sales teams, fostering talent development and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Specialists, Finance and Legal to drive complex sales cycles, identify new use cases, negotiate commercial terms and close enterprise agreements
* Deliver accurate forecasting and client feedback to senior leadership, surfacing cross-business leads and supporting business growth objectives
* Participate in management and risk committees to support governance, conduct and best execution standards

**About The Team**
You will sit within the Moody’s Analytics Middle East Sales team, a high energy group of enterprise sellers, with this role based in Dubai and focused on the GCC. The team partners with the region’s biggest banks and FIs to deliver Moody’s data, analytics and workflow solutions. Collaboration is core: Relationship Managers lead opportunities while working hand in hand with Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Finance and Legal colleagues to solve complex client challenges, accelerate revenue growth and share best practices across the wider regional and global sales organisation.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

jobs.title: Growth (French speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Director, Government Sales Executive, UAE
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa is seeking an experienced payments and public sector business development leader to join the CEMEA Visa Government Solutions team as Director, Government Solutions for UAE, reporting to the Head of Visa Government Solutions for GCC. The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with key public sector stakeholders across federal and local government entities in UAE, positioning Visa as a trusted partner in payments and digital transformation.
* Identify and engage relevant issuers, program managers, processors, fintechs and FI partners to enable the delivery of Visa Government Solutions to government clients.
* Develop and execute market strategies and account plans to grow revenue, payment volume and market share, while expanding the adoption and visibility of relevant Visa capabilities across government use cases.
* Identify market specific needs, emerging use cases and client requirements, and partner with regional and global solutions teams to help shape proposition and product roadmaps.
* Drive achievement of UAE Visa Government Solutions scorecard metrics and commercial objectives, with clear ownership of pipeline development, execution and business outcomes.
* Maintain close alignment with the UAE Country Manager to ensure Visa Government Solutions priorities and execution are fully aligned with country strategies and broader Visa objectives.
* Create and maintain clear business reporting, pipeline visibility and performance tracking against KPIs and commercial targets, ensuring accountability and timely management of risks and opportunities.
* collaborate with Product, Legal, Solutioning and Government Engagement to coordinate Visa’s approach to government clients and strengthen engagement with key decision makers and stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen Visa’s positioning as a leader in payments and a strategic resource for government entities across UAE.
* Lead and coordinate Visa Government Solutions input into RFPs, proposals and complex commercial opportunities, working across internal teams to ensure high quality responses and effective execution.
* Continuously assess the market and competitive landscape, identify new growth opportunities and recommend creative approaches to expand Visa Government Solutions business across UAE.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex commercial, delivery and stakeholder challenges that may impact government business growth, client relationships or execution.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in government, state owned enterprise or public sector sales and business development, ideally within payments or financial services, with a track record of managing complex opportunities and commercial engagements.
* Strong understanding of how government entities and public sector organizations operate across UAE, including stakeholder dynamics, procurement processes and decision making environments. A strong network across the public sector ecosystem in UAE is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated business development and consultative sales capability, with the ability to translate client needs into compelling propositions, build strong business cases and advance complex opportunities from origination through execution.
* Proven experience engaging senior public sector stakeholders and building trusted, long term relationships across complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements while strengthening existing relationships and building new partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives across cross functional teams, solve complex problems and drive engagements through to completion.
* Knowledge of public sector payments infrastructure and government payment flows is an advantage. Strong collaboration and influencing skills are essential to successfully mobilize cross functional teams and deliver results.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
**Institutional**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
At
**Associate Directo**
**r**
level, the role is responsible for the identification, assessment, management, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end product, platform and client lifecycle. The incumbent will help strengthen the control environment for Transaction Banking products and digital capabilities, support product design and change execution, contribute to client implementation and delivery risk management, regulatory readiness and incident learnings, and escalate material matters as appropriate.
  
  
This role is responsible for helping manage non-financial risk across Transaction Banking products, including Payments and Cash Management, Trade and Digital Payments. The role acts as a trusted risk partner to product, sales, implementation, operations, technology and digital delivery stakeholders, providing practical risk advice and execution support to enable safe, sustainable and customer-focused growth.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Work Hours: 7AM to 4PM**
**What will your day look like?**
As an
**Associate Director Institutional NFR GCC Transaction Banking**
, you will:
  
  

* Act as a trusted non-financial risk partner to Transaction Banking product and digital businesses, providing practical guidance on product strategy, client solutions, commercialisation, platform delivery and change initiatives
* Provide analysis, advice and constructive challenge on product and digital risk profiles, control effectiveness, customer outcomes and risk in change across Payments and Cash Management, Trade, Digital Payments, client channels, connectivity solutions and related Transaction Banking capabilities
* Support the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end Transaction Banking product and platform lifecycle, including operational, compliance, technology, cyber, data, fraud, third-party, conduct, financial crime and resilience risks
* Contribute to uplift in product, platform and channel controls, risk indicators, governance, documentation and management information to strengthen transparency, ownership and control effectiveness
* Support quality and timely completion of risk assessments, control assurance, issues management, incident response and remediation activities relevant to Transaction Banking products, platforms and digital capabilities
* Provide risk input and execution support for new product development, product enhancements, platform changes, digital payment capabilities, client implementations, trade and cash management solutions and strategic initiatives impacting Transaction Banking
* Support strong product and digital governance through quality forum papers, issue transparency, escalation and decision support for relevant stakeholders
* Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Implementation, Compliance, Legal, Financial Crime, 2LOD Risk and Internal Audit stakeholders to support aligned and effective non-financial risk outcomes
* Help embed strong first-line risk ownership and awareness across Transaction Banking product and digital teams by promoting practical, customer-focused and commercially aware risk management

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* 15+ years of expertise in Transaction Banking, with strong knowledge of products and client solutions
* Strong experience in transaction banking, with sound understanding of Payments and Cash Management, Trade and/or Digital Payments products, platforms, client journeys, servicing models and the end-to-end product lifecycle
* Strong knowledge of non-financial risk management within a large and complex financial services environment, including governance, risk assessment, controls, issues and incident management, risk reporting and risk in change
* Demonstrated knowledge of key risk exposures relevant to Transaction Banking products and digital channels, including operational resilience, technology and cyber dependencies, data, fraud, third-party risk, financial crime, conduct risk, regulatory compliance and customer outcome risks.
* Demonstrated ability to provide credible advice and constructive challenge to product, digital, operations and technology stakeholders on product risk, platform controls, control design and risk in change, escalating material matters where appropriate
* Experience supporting new product approvals, product changes, digital platform enhancements, client implementation risk assessments and governance processes in a controlled banking environment
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across business and control teams, simplify complex risk matters, and provide clear recommendations that support effective and sustainable risk outcomes
* Knowledge of domestic and cross-border payment rails, cash management structures, trade finance products, digital payment capabilities, client connectivity solutions, APIs and emerging payment industry standards
* Knowledge of digital risk and control frameworks, payment security, fraud prevention, operational resilience, and regulatory requirements, with experience supporting audit, compliance, and non-financial risk management activities within banking and Transaction Banking environments
* Experience using risk data and governance reporting to identify emerging risks, support decision-making, and drive timely actions
* Exposure to global Transaction Banking environments and familiarity with risk systems, governance frameworks, and control improvement initiative

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

jobs.title: Temenos - SME Business analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced T24 Technical Lead / Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end technical delivery of a core banking implementation. The role will be responsible for owning T24 application development, solution design, customisation, configuration, integration, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, core banking architecture, system integrations, and end-to-end implementation delivery, including at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, system integrators, and technology teams to ensure the solution aligns with banking requirements, regulatory standards, and approved architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application and Development Ownership

* Take ownership of the T24 application build and customisation from project commencement until production go-live.
* Lead and govern the T24 design and development teams, interface teams, and system integrator developers, ensuring alignment with programme scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, and testing from a technology standpoint.
* Establish quality standards for IRDs, IDDs, and FSD documents covering the incumbent bank's products, services, and configurations.
* Own end-to-end delivery governance across all phases and report progress to senior management and steering committees.

2. Solution Design and Architecture

* Coordinate and participate in detailed functional and technical deep-dive sessions with system integrators to validate architecture, scope, IRDs, IDDs, and FSDs against the bank's requirements.
* Lead design discussions with solution designers and bank stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions follow event-driven architecture principles and approved architectural patterns.
* Drive Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions covering T24 Chart of Accounts, customer and account structures, product setup, accounting entries, interfaces with SAS systems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct operational workshops with Finance, Compliance, Risk, Fraud, and Operations teams to finalise process flows and technology integrations.

3. Implementation and Configuration

* Oversee T24 environment setup, parameterisation, configuration, and development of standard and customised functionalities.
* Govern bank-specific configurations and Egypt-specific customisations, ensuring they are justified, documented, and upgrade-safe.
* Oversee DIT, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and Close of Business (COB) readiness.
* Drive cutover activities and ensure production readiness.

4. Integration and Middleware

* Own the T24 integration design with other system integrators and downstream applications, including DMS, Kafka, Camunda, Kong, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Oversee Kafka event streaming and real-time messaging of T24 customer, account, and transaction events to SAS systems.
* Govern Camunda workflow orchestration for non-STP case handling, ensuring case outcomes are appropriately posted back to T24.
* Oversee Kong API Gateway integration, including API security and traffic management for T24 APIs.
* Ensure CRM integration supports non-STP workflows and customer interactions.
* Govern SAS system integrations covering customer and account data feeds, transaction screening, fraud checks, and posting of approved outcomes, including restrictions, blocks, and status changes, into T24 following Risk and Compliance clearance.

5. Regulatory and Compliance Alignment

* Ensure T24 configuration, General Ledger, and regulatory reporting meet Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations.
* Ensure compliance with Egyptian AML/CFT requirements, data residency, and information security expectations.
* Apply relevant GCC and international banking compliance practices, including FATF recommendations and OFAC/EU sanctions requirements, while adapting them to the Egyptian regulatory context.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and technology-related evidence requests.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Engage and align senior business and technology stakeholders as required.
* Present project status, risks, dependencies, and action points clearly to executive leadership and steering committees.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, including at least one complete implementation from design to production go-live.
* Strong technical knowledge of T24 modules, architecture, configuration, customisation, Chart of Accounts, General Ledger, multi-currency processing, and core banking operations.
* Hands-on experience with T24 development tools and frameworks, including OFS, IRIS, REST/SOAP APIs, event and message frameworks, MQ, local routines, enquiries, COB configuration, and TAFJ.
* Strong understanding of core banking processes covering customers, accounts, deposits, payments, accounting, and day-end operations.
* Knowledge of banking integrations involving Kafka, Camunda, Kong, DMS, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Understanding of AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, customer risk assessment, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, and fraud management.
* Familiarity with Egyptian banking regulations, CBE reporting requirements, and data residency expectations.
* Experience in technical delivery governance, system integrator coordination, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in large-scale core banking transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Egyptian banking implementations and CBE regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of GCC banking compliance frameworks and regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. **Senior Operations Support Officer**
=====================================

Req ID: 129076

Department: GO - Insto Operations Lending

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will play a critical role in partnering with key business stakeholders, including Relationship Credit and Relationship Management teams, to deliver timely, efficient, and customer-focused lending and collateral management solutions.

  

The role is responsible for the setup, maintenance, and ongoing management of lending facilities across core banking platforms such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor, ensuring accurate processing, data integrity, and operational excellence. Additionally, you will support the delivery of optimized customer outcomes by effectively managing facility administration and collateral-related activities throughout the lending lifecycle.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bangalore  
**Work Schedule:**  
Early morning shift(5 AM login)

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will be responsible for :

  

* Managing lending facilities end-to-end, including the accurate setup, maintenance, renewal, and processing of loan drawdowns, repayments, and related documentation across core systems such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor.
* Ensuring operational excellence by processing transactions with a high degree of accuracy, performing thorough validations, and consistently meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and quality standards.
* Monitoring and maintaining loan documentation, following up on outstanding requirements, and ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance throughout the lending lifecycle.
* Driving the timely collection of fees and interest while maintaining accurate records and ensuring all activities are appropriately reflected in workflow management tools and operational systems.
* Partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Credit teams, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer outcomes and provide proactive support on lending and collateral management matters.
* Acting as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders by responding to queries promptly, providing status updates, and escalating risks, issues, or customer concerns where necessary.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvement and risk mitigation, and recommending practical solutions to enhance operational efficiency, controls, and the overall customer experience.
* Contributing to a collaborative and compliant work environment by supporting projects, adhering to established policies and procedures, maintaining required accreditations, and ensuring business continuity readiness.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 8+ years of experience in Banking Operations, Lending Services, or Institutional Banking, with strong hands-on expertise in Loan IQ and lending operations, along with exposure to platforms such as Orion, Razor, and CACHE, or the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems and processes.
* Demonstrated high attention to detail and accuracy, ensuring quality outcomes and end-to-end ownership of tasks through successful resolution.
* Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, effectively managing multiple priorities while consistently meeting deadlines and service level agreements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building collaborative relationships across internal teams, business partners, and external clients.
* Excellent organizational, coordination, and analytical problem-solving capabilities, supported by a proactive, self-driven approach to operational excellence.
* Resilient and adaptable team player, capable of working independently and collaboratively, navigating challenges effectively, embracing change, and contributing to a high-performance culture.

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can
