jobs.description:
**Organisational Development Consultant**
=========================================

Req ID: 128597

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementationin Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.

  

The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.

  

The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru  
**Work Hours:**  
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

  

**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Supporting the delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Owning or contributing to defined project workstreams, ensuring activities are delivered to a high standard and aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Conducting organisational and workforce analysis to support insights and recommendations, including structure, spans and layers, role design, capability, governance and implementation considerations.
* Preparing high-quality project deliverables, including analysis, options, recommendations, stakeholder packs, governance materials, implementation plans and progress updates.
* Supporting the development of evidence-based recommendations that balance business outcomes, customer impacts, workforce experience, financial objectives and enterprise design principles.
* Working with business leaders, T&C Business Partners, T&C teams and cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, test insights and support delivery.
* Supporting governance activities, including project planning, status reporting, issue and risk management, dependency tracking and action management.
* Supporting the translation of organisation design recommendations into practical implementation activities, including role mapping, consultation support, transition planning or implementation tracking.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise workforce, organisational and business information.
* Strong project delivery skills, including planning, coordination, governance support, action tracking, status reporting, risk and issue management, and dependency tracking.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure issues, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity and deliver quality outcomes in a complex environment.
* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can

jobs.description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Nov 23, 2026

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

jobs.description:
**At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

  

**We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy**

  

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.  

Key Working Relationships

* Customers and business partners across the assigned region/country.
* Senior Process Associates, Operational Managers, and Team Leads.
* Collections, Credit, Billing, Customer Service, Banking, Treasury, and Master Data teams.
* Internal Controls and Audit teams.
Process Experts and other cross-functional teams.  

Key Performance Indicators

* Cash application timeliness and accuracy.
* Unapplied and unidentified cash ageing.
* AMR processing rate.
* Query resolution time and SLA adherence.
* Productivity and quality.
* Control and audit compliance.
Accuracy and completeness of assigned activities.  

**VACC Behaviours**

* **Visionary:** Focuses on delivering measurable outcomes and high-quality customer service.
* **Architect:** Understands customer and business requirements and follows processes that support effective service delivery.
* **Catalyst:** Collaborates with colleagues, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement.
* **Coach:** Takes accountability for own learning and supports knowledge sharing within the team.

To own the end-to-end solution architecture for the daily banking modules of the new Core Banking platform, covering customer and account onboarding, current and savings accounts, term deposits, payments and transfers, fees and charges, interest, limits, statements and general ledger postings, together with the associated data architecture, data migration and downstream data flows.

*The role ensures that solution designs are fit for purpose, scalable, secure, compliant with UAE regulatory requirements and aligned with the Bank's enterprise architecture, data and operational standards.*

**Key Reponsibilites:**

**Solution Architecture - Daily Banking Modules**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for daily banking modules, including customer onboarding, CASA, term deposits, payments and transfers, standing instructions, cheques, fees and charges, interest, limits, statements and accounting.
* Produce high-level and detailed solution designs, architecture decision records and target-state blueprints, and secure approval through the Bank's architecture governance forums.
* Ensure designs maximise use of the core banking product's standard capability and minimise customisation and technical debt.

**Business Requirements, Fit-Gap and Product Configuration**

* Lead fit-gap analysis of business, product and regulatory requirements against the core banking platform, and define solution options for each gap.
* Ensure end-to-end processes across channels, branches, back office and operations are designed consistently and with the required controls.

**Data Architecture and Data Management**

* Define the core banking data architecture, covering customer, account, product, transaction, reference and general ledger data, and its alignment with the Bank's enterprise data model.
* Design data flows from the core platform to the data warehouse, data lake, finance, risk, AML and regulatory reporting systems, including CBUAE reporting requirements.
* Establish data quality, data ownership, lineage, retention, privacy and data classification controls in line with the Bank's data governance standards and UAE data protection requirements.

**Data Migration and Reconciliation**

* Define the data migration architecture and strategy from legacy systems, including data mapping, transformation rules, cleansing, extraction and load approach.
* Oversee mock migrations and dress rehearsals, and ensure financial, balance and record-level reconciliation is complete, auditable and signed off by business owners.
* Identify data risks and dependencies early, and drive remediation of data quality issues with business and technology teams.

**Integration, APIs and Non-Functional Design**

* Design integration between the core banking platform and surrounding systems, including digital and branch channels, payment systems (UAEFTS, IPP/Aani, SWIFT), cards, CRM, AML, AECB and the enterprise service bus.
* Define API, event-streaming and batch patterns, and ensure end-of-day, intraday and real-time processing meet performance, availability and scalability requirements.
* Ensure solution designs meet security, resilience, audit and regulatory requirements in coordination with Infrastructure, Information Security and Risk teams.

**Testing, Cutover and Go-Live Assurance**

* Support test strategy and test scenario design for functional, end-to-end, data migration and non-functional testing, and resolve solution defects with vendors.
* Provide design assurance for migration rehearsals, cutover plans and go-live readiness, including rollback and contingency arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based solution readiness assessment for go-live approval and support hypercare and handover to production support.

**Required:**

* Minimum 12 years of experience in banking technology, including a Solution Architect on core banking implementations or transformation programmes.
* With deep knowledge of daily banking modules such as customer, CASA, term deposits, payments, fees, interest and accounting.
* Proven experience designing core banking data architecture and leading data migration from legacy platforms, with strong exposure to multi-vendor delivery, end-to-end testing, cutover and production readiness.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture (TOGAF or equivalent), core banking products (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle or Thought Machine), data management (DAMA CDMP or equivalent), cloud architecture (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Oracle Cloud) or project/programme management are preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Core banking functional and technical architecture, with strong knowledge of daily banking modules, product parameterisation and accounting.
* Retail and corporate banking processes, including account opening, deposits, payments, charges, interest accrual, end-of-day processing and general ledger.
* Data architecture and data modelling, including customer and account master data, reference data, data warehousing, data lakes and regulatory reporting.
* Data migration methods, data quality management, reconciliation and data governance practices.
* Integration architecture, including REST APIs, event streaming (for example Kafka), ESB/middleware, batch interfaces and UAE payment systems.
* Non-functional design, including performance, availability, security, resilience and cloud-native or containerised deployment of banking platforms.
* Core transformation delivery, vendor governance, risk management, executive communication and stakeholder influencing.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

Resource management associate will operate as the day-to-day staffing and workforce planning coordinator for Life Sciences. The role requires strong verbal and written communication, self-direction, comfort working with stakeholders from consultants through Partners/Directors, strong data-analysis skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent requests with accuracy and follow-through. The individual should be technology proficient, able to learn new systems quickly, and able to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings and, when needed, UK stakeholders.

The Resource Management associate will help maintain an accurate, forward-looking view of staff availability and project demand, coordinate staffing changes, and support practice leadership with the data and follow-through needed to make timely staffing decisions. The role works closely with project managers, service-line leads, people managers, and practice leadership to balance project needs, employee skills and availability, utilization, and project economics.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Own day-to-day staffing coordination and serve as a central point of contact for project staffing requests, extensions, releases, holds, and schedule changes.
* Maintain accurate staffing plans and workplans in ProjectHub and related resource-management systems, including start/end dates, allocations, extensions, and temporary availability.
* Proactively follow up with project managers to confirm staffing plans, close outstanding requests, and ensure requested changes are completed and communicated.
* Monitor current and near-term staff availability, including partial availability and upcoming roll-offs, and identify potential staffing conflicts, over-allocation, underutilization, and opportunities to redeploy capacity.
* Match staffing needs with available resources based on skills, experience, availability, development interests, and project requirements; coordinate with project and service-line leaders when tradeoffs or conflicts require decisions.
* Support weekly staffing discussions by preparing the underlying data, tracking open needs and decisions, maintaining notes/action items, and following through on agreed staffing updates.
* Analyze staffing, utilization, scheduled hours, project budgets, and related financial data to identify exceptions and actionable insights for leadership.
* Support project financial and capacity-management activities, including monitoring scheduled versus budgeted hours, identifying excess or remaining hours, flagging potential over/under-budget conditions, and helping ensure staffing changes are reflected accurately in systems.
* Coordinate with project teams on special project setup and revenue/staffing requirements where standard scheduling does not fully capture the engagement model.
* Maintain high data quality across staffing tools and reports by cross-checking requests against current project and availability information before making changes.
* Adapt to evolving staffing processes and tools, including changes to ProjectHub, Engagement Hub, forecasting, and other firm resource-management systems.

jobs.title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

**Job Title:** Financial Accountant  
**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

**Office Timing:**  
10:30 AM to 7:30 PM / Flexible timing (Second and Fourth Saturday Off)

**Office Location:**  
Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013

**Kindly share your updated cv at hr@airotherms.com or what's app on 8291570650**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Director, Head of M&A Advisory
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
- Responsible for originating, winning and executing M&A and private capital advisory mandates
  
- Focus on converting Mashreq’s existing financing relationships into broader trusted-advisor relationships.
  
- Combine strong transaction execution capabilities with a highly commercial and proactive approach to origination and client development.
  
  
Key Results Area
  
- Origination & Franchise Building: Proactively identify M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across Mashreq’s client base and originate new mandates in partnership with relationship managers and sector teams.
  
- Trusted Advisor: Develop senior-level relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, positioning Mashreq beyond its traditional financing role as a trusted adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and broader strategic matters.
  
- M&A Execution: Lead transactions end-to-end across both sell-side and buy-side mandates, including transaction strategy, valuation, process design, preparation of marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and transaction closing.
  
- Equity Story & Positioning: Develop compelling equity and investment narratives around clients and assets, combining strong financial analysis with a clear articulation of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation opportunities.
  
- Buyer / Investor Access: Identify, approach and develop credibility with relevant strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors across the region and internationally.
  
- Private Capital: Originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
- Approximately 15+ years of high-quality M&A / investment banking advisory experience, ideally gained at a leading investment bank or advisory platform, with a demonstrable track record of executing complex transactions.
  
- The individual should have strong M&A technical and execution capabilities, excellent valuation and financial analysis skills, and the ability to independently develop a credible equity story and lead senior client discussions.
  
- Importantly, this is not intended to be a purely execution-focused role. The successful candidate should be entrepreneurial, proactive and commercially driven, with the ability to identify opportunities, originate mandates and build a business.
  
- The candidate should bring strong judgement, executive presence and credibility with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs and sophisticated investors, together with the ability to leverage Mashreq’s existing relationships to establish a leading regional M&A advisory franchise.

* Personally originate high-quality trade finance deals with mid-market corporates.
* Leverage your existing network to bring in new business quickly.
* Identify, engage, and build consensus with decision-makers in the prospect organisations.
* Prioritise speed-to-mandate with a strong commercial close rate.
* Own your numbers and KPIs.

**Close and Collaborate**

* Own the deals all the way through to the funding stage, including speaking to relevant funders in the Finverity ecosystem when appropriate.
* Collaborate with other members of the Finverity Capital team and cross-functionally with risk, legal, marketing and operations teams to ensure frictionless execution.
* Work directly with the CEO & Co-founder with associated access and accountability.

**Shape the Go-To-Market Strategy**

* Help refine Finverity’s go-to-market approach for the MENA region & beyond.
* Identify new industries, products, and market segments to accelerate growth.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships that feed the pipeline.
* Work with the marketing team to build out and execute marketing campaigns.
* Represent Finverity in client meetings and relevant conferences.

Requirements
  
  

**What We’re Looking for**

We’re looking for someone who knows how to bring in deals and who truly understands the dynamics of working capital and trade finance in the MENA region, especially in the UAE. This isn’t just about theory or strategy; it’s about knowing the clients, the structures, and how to get things done in the real world.

Here’s what would make you a great fit:

* You’ve spent
  **5+ years**
  in and around trade finance or working capital solutions, and you know the space inside and out. Fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You’ve
  **excelled in customer-facing roles selling to CFOs and Treasurers,**
  whether at a bank or fintech, or you have held a senior corporate finance role yourself.
* You have a
  **deep understanding of the working capital challenges**
  mid-market corporates face, because you’ve seen them first hand.
* Your
  **network in the MENA region is strong**
  , especially in the UAE. You know who the decision-makers are, and they know you. Global network is a plus.
* You’ve
  **personally originated and closed significant deals**
  , not as a supporting player, but as the one leading the charge.
* You
  **understand how to structure trade and supply chain finance transactions and programmes**
  , and can spot a strong opportunity from the first conversation, or quickly let go of one that doesn’t fit.
* You’re
  **comfortable assessing risk**
  and thinking like a credit officer, even if you're not one, enough to pre-qualify deals and ask the right questions.
* You’re
  **commercially sharp**
  , strategic when needed, and hands-on when it counts.
* You’re
  **confident in high-stakes conversations**
  and know how to build trust at C-level.
* Most importantly, you’re someone who
  **takes ownership, moves quickly,**
  and genuinely enjoys building relationships that last.

Benefits
  
  

**Why Join Us?**

* Help reshape how capital flows into real economies and make a difference.
* Take a leadership role in a high-growth fintech with global ambition.
* Work alongside a passionate, diverse, caring and execution-focused team.
* Be part of a company with strong momentum, clear market fit, and backing.
* Competitive compensation, flexible working environment and generous performance-based upside, plus UAE residence visa sponsorship and medical insurance.

* 10+ years of experience within Risk & Regulatory Affairs, Financial Services Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, Compliance, or Enterprise Risk Management .

* Strong experience serving Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking, Investment Management, Capital Markets, or Sovereign Wealth Fund clients.
* Deep knowledge of:
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
* Regulatory Compliance
* Governance Frameworks
* Operational Risk
* Conduct Risk
* Internal Controls
* Operational Resilience
* Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)
* Compliance Monitoring Programs
* Regulatory Change Management
* Experience interacting with regional regulators and working knowledge of ADGM, DIFC, SCA, CMA, QCB, CBB, and related regulatory frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale risk transformation and regulatory remediation programs.

Preferred / Advantageous
  
  

* Experience leading or supporting practice-building or market-entry initiatives in the region.
* Prior exposure to sovereign wealth fund advisory or Ultra-High-Net-Worth client segments.
* Familiarity with key regional WAM technology platforms and fintech landscape.
* Experience in a dual-hat role (industry leadership + external advisory) or within a captive consulting unit of a financial institution.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Commercial**
**Technical & Domain**
▸ Client relationship management & influence ▸ WAM operating models & value chain
  
  
▸ Business development & pipeline ownership ▸ Investment products & portfolio management principles

This role represents a significant opportunity for a senior consultant or experienced industry professional to shape the growth of a high-priority practice at a critical moment in the development of the Middle East's wealth management ecosystem.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.

+ Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
+ Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.

+ Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* Transition solution design & execution assurance

+ Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
+ Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
+ Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
+ Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
+ Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* Functional authority and innovation

+ Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
+ Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
+ Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
+ Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities

+ Evaluate finance-specific trade-offs involving control effectiveness, close stability, reporting accuracy, working-capital impact, service cost, standardisation and regulatory exposure.
+ Determine whether process, data and control readiness is sufficient to proceed with migration, parallel run, cutover and operational acceptance.
+ Solve novel, ambiguous and enterprise-scale transition problems for which established precedents may not exist.
+ Make or recommend high-consequence decisions on transition design, sequencing, risk treatment, governance and readiness within delegated authority.
+ Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.

* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.

* Formulate propositions and solutions that meet client requirements in addition to managing and directing pursuit activity.
* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A work culture focused on innovation and building lasting value for our clients and employees
* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise
