**Job Summary**

Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.

**Responsibilities**

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Drive cluster portfolio quality through regular review of X-bucket and early-delinquency trends, allocation and monitoring of follow-up actions, root-cause identification and coordinated resolution with Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations.
* Translate business plans into cluster execution priorities.
* Review team productivity, sourcing quality, controls and capability.
* Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks and escalate structural issues with evidence.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix. Key interactions Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE. External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.

**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

Graduate or postgraduate with demonstrated experience managing a sales team, geography or lending portfolio.

**Critical skills and knowledge**

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Do you want to shape the future of fintech and healthtech? Energized by challenges and inspired by bold goals? Ready to elevate your career alongside driven and talented colleagues? If that sounds like you, explore a career at Alegeus today.

**Opportunity Happens Here**.

**Responsibilities**

Alegeus is modernizing into an API first, open integration platform that powers partners, employers, and participants across consumer-directed-healthcare. You will own the Integrations product surface so that partners can integrate faster with higher reliability, enabling new experiences and AI/agentic workflows. Integration

**Ownership Scope**

You will own all external integration modalities at Alegeus, including:

* Data integrations: Public APIs, webhooks, event streams, real-time interfaces, and asynchronous messaging patterns
* File-based integrations: EDI, CSV, batch processing, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
* Experience integrations: front-end microservices, embeddable widgets, and partner-facing UI extensions
* This role ensures that the above is designed, delivered, and evolved as one cohesive platform, not disconnected channels, with shared standards for security, versioning, observability, reliability, and partner experience.

**Outcomes you'll own**

* Reduce partner time to first value and increase adoption across key use cases.
* Ship a coherent v2 API set with clear versioning, deprecation, and a reliable release cadence.
* Launch a webhook/event framework (subscribe, replay, DLQ, idempotency) with partnergrade SLAs.
* Deliver a developer experience that delights: dev portal, docs, SDKs, samples, error taxonomy, sandbox, chatbot, etc.
* Establish product analytics KPIs (adoption, latency, reliability, errors, partner NPS) with dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for Data, File and Experience integrations; define problem statements, success metrics, and crisp PRDs.
* Partner with design/engineering/Product owners to deliver secure, scalable interfaces and reference implementations.
* Work directly with marquee partners to map JTBD and translate into stable contracts/schemas.
* Drive packaging, auth models (OAuth/OIDC), rate limits, quotas, SLAs, and change management.
* Orchestrate launches: docs, changelogs, guides, enablement, and internal readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years in PM with SaaS integrations as your product (not just "has APIs").
* Hands-on track record shipping public REST APIs and webhooks at scale; familiarity with async patterns, retries, backoff, and event semantics.
* Strong grasp of DX: information architecture for docs, quickstarts, SDK stewardship, error design.
* Data exchange expertise: realtime + bulk, schema evolution, validation, and observability for integrations.
* Excellent partner-facing skills: discovery, solutioning, negotiating tradeoffs, clear communication.

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare, claims/eligibility, fintech/payments, or benefits ecosystem experience.
* API monetization/packaging, partner marketplaces, or appecosystem playbooks.
* Observability for integrations (schema drift detection, tracing, deadlettering, replay tools).

**How we'll measure success**

* Adoption of v2 endpoints webhook subscriptions; reduction in partner integration time.
* Reliability (SLO attainment), latency improvements, and error rate reductions for integration flows.

jobs.title: Tracxn - Senior Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TRACXN**

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As an Associate Product Manager at Tracxn, youll support the product team in defining requirements, analyzing performance, and executing product initiatives across the lifecycle. Youll collaborate with design, engineering, and senior PMs to translate ideas into impactful product features.

This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn product fundamentals, work on a global B2B SaaS platform, and grow into a full-fledged Product Manager.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Feature Specification:** Assist Product Managers in defining feature specifications and writing detailed product requirement documents (PRDs).
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution across the product lifecycle.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review and analyze key product metrics to track performance and identify improvement areas.
* **Design Support:** Collaborate with the UX team to create wireframes, mockups, and design documentation.
* **Data & Insights:** Use data and API tools (like Postman) to extract insights and validate product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Documentation Management:** Maintain reports, knowledge repositories, and other operational resources for effective tracking and learning.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify workflow bottlenecks and suggest enhancements to improve efficiency and product quality.

  

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **2–5 years of work experience who have graduated from a Tier 1 college.**
* An engineering background is a must.
* Strong interest in B2B SaaS products and technology, with empathy for users and a problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to structure and analyze ambiguous problems effectively.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly convey ideas through workflows, feature descriptions, and documentation.
* A long-term desire to build a career in Product Management and grow into a full-fledged PM role.
* Preferred: prior exposure to SQL, Postman, or other data/API tools.
* Preferred: internship or project experience in product management, UX, or a related field.

  

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT TRACXN**

* Fixed work timings — 9 hrs 5 days. Respect for personal time; no taking work home.
* A transparent, meritocratic culture where everyone explains the “why” behind their decisions.
* A candid and collaborative environment that values learning, curiosity, and open discussions.
* Managers and mentors who invest in your growth with timely, actionable feedback.
* Continuous learning through real-time projects and cross-functional exposure.

**About Wego**

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We dont just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, whats next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are** **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

**Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

**This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **Youd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

jobs.title: Sr Product manager
jobs.description:
Role purpose: Lead strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of Smart Factory / Industry 4.0 products, converting manufacturing needs into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions that improve productivity, quality, asset reliability, safety, energy efficiency and business performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 Define product vision, strategy, portfolio roadmap and priorities aligned with business goals; lead product innovation and foster an entrepreneurial, customer-centric culture.

 Conduct market research, customer discovery and competitive analysis; understand global customer needs, define value propositions and translate insights into product requirements, user stories and release plans.

 Manage end-to-end product lifecycle from concept and business case through PoC/MVP, product development, launch, market positioning, post-launch analysis, adoption and continuous enhancement.

 Collaborate with engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, plant operations and delivery teams to ensure successful product launches, customer outcomes and technology integration.

 Develop Smart Factory capabilities across production, OEE, downtime, quality, traceability, maintenance, asset performance, materials, utilities, energy, safety and sustainability.

 Drive Industrial IoT and OT/IT integration across PLC/DCS, SCADA, MES/MOM, historians, ERP, CMMS/EAM and enterprise systems using OPC UA, MQTT, APIs, edge gateways and industrial data platforms.

 Leverage manufacturing data, Google Data Analytics / BI, IoT and Machine Learning for operational insights, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, process optimization, computer vision and quality analytics.

 Define Industrial GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities for manufacturing: natural-language factory assistants, RAG over industrial knowledge, multi-agent workflows for maintenance, production and quality, decision support and human-approved actions.

 Explore Physical AI use cases connecting AI to machines and the physical environment, including robotics, cobots, AGVs/AMRs, autonomous inspection, machine vision, intelligent material movement and human–robot collaboration.

 Shape digital twins and simulation for assets, production lines and factories; integrate 3D/engineering context with real-time operational data and assess AR/VR and connected-worker solutions.

 Guide SaaS/cloud product capabilities including modular architecture, reusable APIs/connectors/SDKs, scalability, multi-site deployment, cybersecurity, reliability and integration with customer ecosystems.

 Apply business and commercial acumen to business cases, ROI/TCO, pricing/licensing inputs, build-buy-partner decisions, product positioning and go-to-market plans; track adoption, KPIs and business value.

 Lead and develop product professionals; build collaboration, people excellence and a global mindset; drive change management, stakeholder alignment and critical thinking to resolve complex product and delivery challenges.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

 12–15 years of experience in manufacturing technology, digital transformation, industrial automation, Industrial IoT, enterprise platforms or product development, with meaningful product/platform lifecycle responsibilities.

 Strong manufacturing and Industry 4.0 knowledge, including MES, SCADA, PLC/DCS, OEE, historians, industrial data, OT/IT integration and SaaS / manufacturing technology.

 Experience translating business/customer problems into product capabilities and collaborating with cross-functional teams through requirements, architecture, MVP, validation, deployment and enhancement.

 Exposure to Industrial AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Physical AI/robotics, digital twins, analytics, cloud/edge computing and enterprise integration.

 Strong product strategy, roadmap prioritization, commercial awareness, communication, team management, collaboration, change management and critical-thinking skills; Bachelor’s/Master’s in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field. MBA is an advantage.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
*Airties is an established SaaS company that provides AI-based Connectivity Experience Management solutions to internet service providers around the globe. Airties designs and develops software that enables exceptional Wi-Fi experiences for residential subscribers and small businesses. The comprehensive solution portfolio includes network analytics and optimization software, customer support and business intelligence tools, mobile apps, cyber security and motion sensing applications, embedded software for Wi-Fi routers and extenders, Wi-Fi test and measurement solutions, and engineering services. Airties software is licensed and integrated in hundreds of third-party hardware products and service provider IT systems. Airties has been active in the telecommunications field for over 20 years and is well positioned to continue to innovate in this field and grow the business.*

  

*Airties is seeking an experienced Product Manager to strengthen the Product Management team. As a Product Manager you will be responsible for all aspects of products and solutions including developing propositions and business cases, product definition, user experience design, overseeing product development, deciding on product releases, conducting beta, launch, demand creation and end-of-life processes. In collaboration with the Marketing and Sales teams, you will introduce new products and solutions to the market and communicate features and benefits to both internal and external audiences. You will have significant contact with customers and partners at a strategic level, to ensure that requirements and changing market demands are incorporated into product design and development.*

  

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent is required, Masters degree and MBA degree are a plus
* Minimum 8 years of experience in product management or related roles with product aspects and customer facing elements such as product marketing, strategy, business development, or solution architecture
* Know-how of the telecommunications market and related technologies, big data and AI applications; experience in Wi-Fi, Mobile, and Cyber Security domains is a plus
* Customer oriented, business sense, able to work with marketing and sales proactively to develop new value propositions and drive business growth
* Experience with lean product processes and agile SW/SaaS development life cycles
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to communicate and convey messages clearly
* Passionate about the products and technology, self-motivated and independent, with the ability to plan work effectively in a dynamic multi-project environment
* Data driven and result-oriented, proven ability to take initiative and generate results needed to reach goals and monitor progress
* Ability to bond and collaborate with stakeholders and partners, manage conflicting priorities, and negotiate features and requests from customers and turn them into requirements for R&D
* Comfortable to travel internationally to visit customers and partners
* Team player who interacts easily with the different layers of the companys management

  

**Responsibilities**

* The responsibility offered comprises assisting in defining the strategy for Airties Connectivity Experience Management solutions and adjacent products
* You follow relevant market trends, technology evolutions, standard evolutions and partner supplier roadmaps based on market reports, technology announcements, meetings and customer visits
* You perform regular benchmarking, competitive analysis, technology evaluations and stakeholder interviews
* You identify the market needs and define end-to-end solutions that address them in a differentiating way
* You present internal reviews comprising technology evaluation, competitive positioning, business model canvas and related business case and go-to-market
* You participate in user testing activities
* You deliver use case definitions and user experience designs towards R&D
* You drive as business owner the virtual feature team of the features/solutions/modules you are working on until they are ready for planning, and you participate in driving the content in upcoming phases
* You identify gaps in the solution and give recommendations how to fill them
* You work together with Marketing teams and use data from customers and internal data, to ensure clear positioning and benefits of the features/solutions
* You ensure the right proof of value, price and cost of the features/modules/solutions you are responsible for
* You produce necessary sales trainings and associated documents (datasheets, roadmaps, launch kits, white papers, commercial and marketing pitches) in collaboration with Marketing teams
* You generate externally usable material such as white papers, presentations, data sheets and competitive positioning clearly demonstrating and enhancing Airties leading position
* You promote your product to the internal and external stakeholders
* You work in close cooperation with sales, customers and partners, and support the sales team in pre-sales efforts together with solution architects
* You ensure proper alignment with sales to maintain a positive business plan for your technologies and find champions to introduce your product to customers
* You conduct quarterly strategy reviews to assess the success of your features/solution/module choices and advise and recommend the strategy to be followed and decisions to be taken
* You represent the vision of Airties towards customers and the vision of its customers towards the organization

  

*Airties has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.*

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**    

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle-from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement-for one or more solutions within CDW's Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  
   
  **Key Areas of Responsibility**    
   
  **Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**    

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

  
   
  **Solution Strategy & Roadmap**    

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

  
   
  **Solution Development & Delivery**    

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

  
   
  **AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**    

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

  
   
  **Working Model**    

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

  
   
  **Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**    

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

  
   
  **Qualifications**    
   
  **Education and/or Experience Qualifications**    

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  
   
  **Preferred Qualifications**    

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure Modernization
* Experience with Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

  
   
  **Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**    

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW's commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect / Departments / Resources / ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.
* Communicate improvement ideas that you have regarding CDW service quality or client satisfaction per established means.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders to shape a dynamic product strategy that solves for user problems, business and partner objectives. This role will require you to define the commerce experience on JioHotstar across multiple categories that enables users to get inspired and transact without disrupting their content watching experience. Come join this rocketship!

JioHotstar is embarking on a journey to grow Content Commerce on the platform. We believe that there is true value to be unlocked for our large user base by building inspiration, consideration and transactions all while watching their favourite content. We have traditionally had 2 monetisation channels: Advertising and Subscriptions. This team intends to work with our partners and build commerce as the third monetisation channel.

* Conduct thorough research and analysis to generate actionable insights and determine ROI
* Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing market trends and shifts
* Influence roadmaps within and outside the functional area to enhance the overall ecosystem
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritization beyond the immediate domain
* Show agility in responding to external signals, enabling swift roadmap adjustments, and ensuring transparent communication of impacts
* Take ownership of at least one key KPI that directly aligns with Product Objectives and Key Results
* Develop deep expertise in at least one functional area, driving strategic advancements through innovation and transformation
* Actively participate in team-building initiatives, including contributing to hiring processes

* Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas
* Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex problems, asking the right questions for deeper understanding
* Demonstrate a diverse range of ideas and prioritize effectively, focusing on the end outcomes
* Leverage a data-driven mindset to derive insights from metrics and make well-informed product decisions
* Show strong user empathy, using structured problem-solving to address pain points through hypothesis-building and solution development

* Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization
* Foster a collaborative, respectful work environment, open to feedback, while mentoring junior PMs to success and effectively influencing without formal authority

* Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Overall 4-6 years of experience in building scalable consumer products

jobs.description:
### Job Summary

Are you driven to shape innovative AI-powered product experiences, and looking to join a team where open collaboration, customer focus, and a commitment to excellence are core values? At Ivanti, we work passionately and authentically, striving to win together and make a real impact for our customers and each other. Join us to elevate your career and help shape the future of Enterprise Service Management through innovative conversational and collaboration experiences.

The Senior Product Manager role combines customer engagement, product strategy, innovation, and close partnership with design and engineering. The ideal candidate has strong product management experience, particularly within AI, chatbots, conversational interfaces, or Enterprise Service Management. You will work regularly with customers to understand how they operate, identify the problems and jobs to be done, and act as the voice of the customer throughout the design and development process.

You will also support the ideation, design, technical development, and launch of innovative products and capabilities, helping drive the continued evolution of Ivanti's Enterprise Service Management portfolio.

### Responsibilities

**What Will You Be Doing:**

As part of the role, the ideal candidate understands the mechanics of the enterprise software market, understand requirements to deliver successful SaaS products and services, and needs to have business acumen to make smart decisions to optimize return on investment for the Ivanti ESM product line. Key to the success of the position is to be able to develop and maintain good business relationships with cross-functional teams, which are essential to the successful adoption of new capabilities.

If you are looking for an opportunity to deliver meaningful innovations to enable our target customers to manage their IT or non-IT services better and thus improve their business success and work experience, and if you are looking for an opportunity to help lead Ivanti's ESM business to financial success and to participate in it, then join our team!

**Product Strategy and Roadmap:**

* Develop and execute the product vision and strategy for virtual assistants, chatbots, and other collaborative capabilities.
* Create and manage a product roadmap, aligning with business objectives and market demands.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

**Product Development:**

* Lead cross-functional teams, including engineering, UX, and data science, to deliver high-quality products.
* Define detailed product requirements and specifications, ensuring clarity and alignment with business goals.
* Prioritize features and enhancements based on customer feedback, market trends, and business impact.

**Customer Focus:**

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to gather insights, understand their needs, and validate product concepts.
* Advocate for the customer by ensuring their needs are at the forefront of product development efforts.
* Develop user personas and journey maps to guide the design and development process.

**Performance and Metrics:**

* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics to measure adoption and performance.
* Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Report on progress to senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Collaboration and Communication:**

* Collaborate with marketing, sales, services, and customer support teams to ensure successful product launches and customer adoption.
* Communicate product vision, strategy, and updates effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the product team.

**Innovation and Trends:**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI, chatbots, and collaboration.
* Identify and evaluate new technologies and solutions to enhance product offerings.
* Drive innovation by exploring new use cases and applications for virtual assistants and chatbots.

**What Will You Bring**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI, virtual assistants, or chatbots.
* Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams.
* Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with AI technologies, natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and chatbot frameworks.
* Customer Orientation: Deep understanding of customer needs and a passion for creating user-centric products.
* Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex projects and delivering products on time and within budget.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authentication - India
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

About the Role: Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud's Access Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you'll define how millions of users prove who they are. You'll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you'll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren't a tradeoff, join us.

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.

If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let's have a conversation.

### Responsibilities

* Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.
* Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.
* Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

### Requirements

* 5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.
* Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.
* A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.
* Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

### Bonus Points for

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

### Location / Language

**Location:** JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

**Language:** JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

### Notes

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded **AI Product Owner** to help shape, build and scale Sandhata's AI products and solutions.

  

This role sits at the intersection of **customer needs, business strategy, AI technology and engineering delivery**. You will take ownership of the product lifecycle, from identifying market and customer problems through product definition, prioritisation, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

You will work closely with the **Principal Enterprise AI Architect and AI engineering teams** to translate product vision and customer requirements into clear, prioritised and achievable product capabilities.

This is not simply a backlog-management role. We are looking for someone who can **understand customers, challenge requirements, define compelling AI propositions, make prioritisation decisions and take accountability for product outcomes**.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Own product vision and roadmap**, translating Sandhata's AI strategy into clear product priorities, capabilities, releases and measurable outcomes.
* **Understand customer and market problems** through discovery sessions, stakeholder engagement, competitor analysis and continuous customer feedback.
* **Define product requirements** including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows and non-functional requirements.
* **Own and prioritise the product backlog**, balancing customer value, strategic objectives, technical dependencies, delivery effort and commercial opportunity.
* **Work closely with AI Architecture and Engineering**, ensuring business requirements are translated into viable, scalable and secure product capabilities.
* **Lead product discovery and validation**, turning ideas into prototypes, MVPs, PoCs/PoVs and ultimately production-ready products.
* **Define product success measures**, including adoption, customer value, usage, quality, commercial impact and other relevant KPIs/OKRs.
* **Own release priorities and product readiness**, ensuring capabilities meet agreed acceptance criteria and deliver the intended customer outcome.
* **Drive product adoption**, working with Sales/GTM, Marketing, Delivery and customer teams on positioning, demonstrations, onboarding and feedback.
* **Engage directly with customers and senior stakeholders**, presenting product capabilities, capturing requirements and helping shape strategic product direction.
* **Monitor the AI and competitive landscape**, identifying opportunities created by Generative AI, Agentic AI and emerging enterprise technologies.
* **Balance innovation with practicality**, making informed decisions across customer value, technical complexity, cost, risk and time-to-market.
* **Maintain strong product governance**, ensuring decisions, priorities, requirements, dependencies and outcomes are clearly documented and communicated.
* **Champion continuous improvement**, using customer feedback, usage data and delivery learnings to evolve the product roadmap.

  

**Core Experience & Expertise**

* **7+ years of overall technology/product experience**, including at least **3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or equivalent**.
* Demonstrable experience owning **B2B enterprise software, SaaS, digital platforms or technology products** from concept through delivery and adoption.
* Strong understanding of **Agile product development**, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog prioritisation, sprint planning and release management.

* Strong analytical ability with experience defining and monitoring **product KPIs, adoption metrics and business outcomes**.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage **customers, engineers, senior stakeholders and commercial teams**.
* Commercial & Product Mindset

  

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **enterprise AI, Generative AI or Agentic AI products**.
* Experience with **B2B SaaS or enterprise platform products**.
* Experience taking products from **idea/MVP through launch, adoption and scale**.
* Exposure to **Responsible AI, AI governance, security and data privacy**.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as **Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud**.
* Experience working with enterprise customers in **Telecommunications, Financial Services, Insurance or Healthcare**.
* Product Owner/Product Management certification such as **PSPO, CSPO or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager**.
* Experience supporting **product demonstrations, proposals, client workshops and pre-sales activities**.
* Experience defining **pricing, packaging or commercial propositions** for technology products would be advantageous

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager**

Product Team | Pune, India | In Campus

  
 **The Role**

We are seeking a high-ownership Product Manager to own the complete software surface of our robotics platform - spanning the core robot software stack, fleet management across the sorting systems, AMRs, customer integration pipelines, and the operator-facing UI applications used on the warehouse floor every day. You will be the single owner of the software experience, from intelligence running on each robot to the dashboard a warehouse manager opens every morning.

**The opportunity**

Own the product direction and business outcomes of assigned product lines, from customer discovery and new product development through launch, adoption and improvement of systems already operating at customer sites. Turn market needs and field evidence into a clear strategy, measurable product requirements and a prioritised roadmap.

You will work across robots, induction and discharge systems, embedded controls, batteries and fleet software. Bring the technical judgment to challenge engineering assumptions, the commercial discipline to choose valuable opportunities, and the ownership to verify that customers realise the promised value. Expect to spend time in warehouses, engineering labs and the factory.

**How the role works with other teams**

You own customer problems, product strategy, priorities, product requirements and acceptance criteria. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated delivery plan and dependencies.

Engineering leaders own architecture, technical decisions and validation; Engineering Managers own people and capacity. Operations and Service own manufacturing, deployment and support execution. You drive scope and priority decisions, challenge commitments and escalate gaps.

Release decisions follow assigned authority, with the required technical, safety, quality and operational approvals.

**Key responsibilities**

Customer insight and product definition

**Customer discovery and market choices**

1. Observe warehouse workflows and speak directly with operators, supervisors, maintenance teams, buyers and integration partners. Combine site visits, customer interviews, usage data and win/loss analysis to identify unmet needs and validate demand.
2. Define target segments, priority use cases, competitive positioning and the conditions in which the product is a strong fit. Evaluate alternatives, including existing manual processes and other automation, and recommend opportunities to pursue, defer or stop.

**Strategy and product economics**

1. Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap, balancing new capabilities, reliability improvements, customer commitments and platform reuse. Prioritise investments using customer value, market potential, evidence, cost, risk and engineering capacity.
2. Build business cases covering addressable demand, customer payback, pricing and packaging, product cost, deployment effort and lifetime service costs. Set cost and margin objectives with Finance, Engineering and Operations; track commercial results with Sales and refine the investment case as evidence changes.

**Requirements and customer experience**

1. Own business and product requirements (BRDs and PRDs), use cases, operating assumptions and measurable acceptance criteria. Work with Systems and domain Engineering to derive traceable system and subsystem requirements and assess changes.
2. Define sustained throughput, accuracy, availability, parcel and payload ranges, footprint, scalability and operator productivity targets under representative workloads. Specify installation, recovery, diagnostics and serviceability needs so performance claims reflect real operating conditions.
3. Define operator and supervisor workflows, exception handling, reporting and warehouse software integration needs. Work with design and engineering teams to make systems practical to learn, operate, recover and maintain.

**Technical judgment and commitments**

1. Challenge estimates, dependencies, capacity assumptions and validation evidence with the TPM and engineering leaders. Make explicit scope and priority decisions when performance, cost, reliability or timing changes, and drive timely resolution of decisions affecting customer commitments.
2. Assess technical alternatives for their customer value and lifecycle implications. Ensure intended use, safety and compliance requirements inform product decisions from the start, with engineering and functional safety owners retaining technical approval.

**Key responsibilities**

New products, commercial launch and the installed base

**New Product development and pilots**

1. Define customer hypotheses, target outcomes and evidence for concept, prototype, pilot and production gates. Use representative workload sand, where appropriate, simulation with Engineering to test assumptions, assess capacity and validate sizing claims before scaling.
2. Agree pilot baselines, supported configurations, acceptance criteria and rollout conditions with customers, Solutioning, Engineering and Delivery. Own the product acceptance assessment and launch recommendation; use results to decide whether to scale, iterate or stop.

**Launch and repeatable growth**

1. Lead product launch planning with Sales, Marketing, Solutioning, Operations and Service. Equip teams with clear positioning, validated capabilities, sizing limits,pricing guidance, demonstrations, documentation and training requirements; measure adoption and realised value after deployment.
2. Define standard capabilities and configurable options.Evaluate customer-specific requests against strategic value, repeatability, engineering effort and support cost. Keep proposals and commitments within validated productlimits, with exceptions explicitly assessed and approved.

**Deployed products and lifecycle decisions**

1. Own the improvement backlog. Define product metrics and instrumentation requirements with Engineering, establish reliable baselines, and prioritise work using telemetry, customer feedback and recurring field issues. Verify with Engineering and Service that releases improve customer outcomes.
2. Own product policies and requirements for supported variants, compatibility, upgrades, migration, component obsolescence and end of life. Align lifecycle decisions with Engineering, Supply Chain and Service, including the cost and operational impact on installed systems.

**What you will deliver**

An evidence-backed product strategy and business case; a prioritised roadmap and backlog; clear product requirements and acceptance criteria; launch and lifecycle plans; and a product scorecard linking customer outcomes to commercial performance.

**First 90 days**

Review customer workflows, installed systems and economics. Agree product metrics, reliable baselines and priority gaps. Prioritise the roadmap and backlog. Define the next pilot or release scope, supported configurations, acceptance evidence and decision owners.

**Experience and capabilities**

The background and results we are looking for

1. Typically 10-15 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years owning hardware and software products. Product decisions, technical judgment and results matter more than tenure alone.
2. Evidence of taking a complex product from discovery through production and customer deployment, with measurable outcomes after launch.
3. Engineering grounding across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded software, controls, power and software architecture, sufficient to challenge assumptions and assess system trade-offs.
4. Experience with structured NPD, pilot builds, change control and software releases. Understand how design risk reviews, DFMEA and validation evidence inform product decisions.
5. Strong commercial and analytical skills: assess customer ROI, product economics and pricing, analyse operational data, and defend investment and priority decisions.
6. A record of influencing multidisciplinary team

This individual will act as a senior leader responsible for shaping the overarching strategy, driving execution, and ensuring alignment across multiple high-impact healthcare domains (such as core administrative processing, clinical data exchange, and member-centric platforms). You will connect the dots between disparate enterprise initiatives, drive cohesive data and platform strategies, and mentor product managers to deliver solutions that meet the strategic goals of enGen and our health plan partners.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner

One role Contract-to-hire India

Role summary

You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill.

What you will do

* Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases.
* Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them.
* Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on.
* Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain.
* Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off.
* Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers.
* Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed.
* Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks.
* Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next.
* Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners.

What we are looking for Critical (must have)

* **Communication.** You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up.
* **Business understanding.** You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact.
* **Technical skill.** You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analysts work. Snowflake experience is preferred.

Also required

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role.
* Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders.
* Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules.
* **Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific.**

Nice to have

* Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience.
* Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service).
* Experience with data catalog or governance tools.
* Power BI or another BI tool.
* Agile and Azure DevOps.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains.
* The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners.
* A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

Required Skills

Business Process Modeling Presentation and Communication skills Power BI Snowflake Stakeholder Communication ADO SQL Agile Methodologies

jobs.title: Chartered Accountant
jobs.description:
**Role Objective**

To drive financial planning, analysis, business performance monitoring and financial governance across Bhima Group's businesses. The role will provide actionable financial insights to management, support strategic decision-making, identify profitability improvement opportunities and ensure effective financial controls across business units, retail operations and international entities.

**1. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process across business units and functions.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial forecasts.
* Analyse actual financial performance against budgets, forecasts and previous periods.
* Identify revenue variances, cost deviations, margin leakages and profitability trends.
* Prepare financial models to assess business scenarios, investments and expansion plans.
* Develop financial dashboards and management reports for the MD and senior leadership.
* Provide insights into revenue growth, operating margins, EBITDA and working capital.
* Recommend corrective actions based on financial performance and emerging business trends.

**2. Business Performance & Profitability Analysis**

* Monitor financial performance across Bhima's retail branches and business operations.
* Conduct branch-wise profitability analysis and identify high- and low-performing locations.
* Analyse sales performance, gross margins, operating expenses and contribution margins.
* Evaluate jewellery category-wise profitability across gold, diamond, platinum and other product segments.
* Monitor key financial metrics such as:

+ Revenue per store.
+ Gross profit margin.
+ EBITDA and EBITDA margin.
+ Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue.
+ Inventory turnover.
+ Working capital cycle.
+ Return on investment (ROI).

* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic business performance reviews highlighting risks, opportunities and improvement areas.

**3. Management Reporting & MIS**

* Develop and maintain standardised financial MIS across all business units.
* Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, profitability and cash flow.
* Present financial performance and key business insights to the MD and management team.
* Establish standard reporting formats and timelines across locations.
* Develop dashboards to provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
* Highlight deviations from budgets and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely submission of financial information.

**4. Financial Strategy & Business Advisory**

* Support management in evaluating new business opportunities and expansion proposals.
* Prepare financial feasibility studies for new stores, business units and international operations.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals and projected returns.
* Conduct investment appraisal using ROI, payback period, NPV and IRR.
* Assess financial implications of new initiatives and business strategies.
* Provide financial inputs for pricing strategies, discounting and promotional campaigns.
* Support management in strategic planning and long-term financial sustainability.

**5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Monitor cash flow and liquidity positions across the organisation.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and identify funding requirements.
* Monitor receivables, payables and working capital utilisation.
* Analyse inventory holding costs and capital blocked in jewellery stock.
* Review cash management practices across retail branches.
* Coordinate with banking partners on funding, credit facilities and treasury requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimise working capital.

**6. Financial Controls & Governance**

* Establish and monitor financial control mechanisms across corporate and branch operations.
* Review financial processes, expenditure approvals and internal control systems.
* Monitor adherence to financial policies and delegation of authority.
* Identify financial risks, process gaps and potential control weaknesses.
* Coordinate internal and statutory audits.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and financial reporting standards.
* Review branch-level financial transactions and exception reports.

**7. Corporate Finance & International Operations**

* Monitor financial performance of domestic and international business entities.
* Support financial planning and reporting for Bhima Singapore and future international operations.
* Analyse foreign exchange exposure and its impact on business performance.
* Monitor intercompany transactions, reconciliations and fund movements.
* Review international operating costs, profitability and cash flow.
* Coordinate with local finance teams and external accounting partners.
* Support consolidation of financial information across group entities.

**8. Cost Optimisation & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to rationalise operational and administrative expenses.
* Analyse manpower costs, rental expenses, marketing expenditure and other overheads.
* Review cost structures across branches and corporate functions.
* Develop cost benchmarks and monitor expenditure against approved budgets.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen financial efficiency.
* Evaluate the financial impact of automation and technology investments.

**9. Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with HR, Retail Operations, Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain and other corporate functions.
* Provide financial inputs for departmental budgets and business plans.
* Partner with functional heads to monitor costs and improve financial outcomes.
* Guide finance teams on financial reporting standards and analytical practices.
* Drive accountability for financial performance across business units.

jobs.title: ERP Functional Consultant (Manufacturing Module)
jobs.description:
**1. Requirement Gathering & Solution Design**

* Conduct AS-IS process discovery across procurement, planning, production, stores, inventory, warehousing, quality and dispatch at plant and corporate level.
* Translate business processes into TO-BE designs on D365 F&O author Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), Functional Design Documents (FDD) and fit-gap analyses.
* Drive design decisions on item master and product taxonomy, BOM and route structures, costing methods, warehouse and site hierarchies, and inventory dimensions.
* Evaluate gaps for standard configuration vs. workflow vs. customisation, and defend the standard-first position where a customisation is not justified.

**2. Configuration & Delivery**

* Configure and test core SCM modules: Procurement & Sourcing, Inventory Management, Warehouse Management (WMS), Production Control, Master Planning, Product Information Management, Cost Management, Sales & Distribution.
* Own integration touchpoints with Finance (GL/AP/AR, sub-ledger postings), Quality, Asset Management, and third-party systems (barcode/RFID scanners, weighbridge, MES, e-invoicing and e-way bill, vendor portals).
* Define and govern data migration for master and open transactional data vendors, items, BOMs, routes, warehouses, open POs, inventory balances, WIP including cleansing rules, templates, cut-over sequencing and reconciliation.
* Manage the implementation partner / SI on scope, sprint delivery, defect closure and quality of deliverables.

**3. Testing, Cutover & Go-Live**

* Build and execute the test strategy: unit testing (SIT), Conference Room Pilots (CRP1/CRP2), User Acceptance Testing and regression testing across releases.
* Prepare the cutover plan and run the go-live dress rehearsals, cutover checklist, stock freeze and count, opening balance reconciliation, and Day-1 command centre.
* Lead hypercare: triage and resolve post-go-live issues, drive down defect backlog, and confirm transaction volumes and month-end close run cleanly on the new system.

**4. Governance, Controls & Change Management**

* Establish process controls and reconciliation checks across procurement, production, inventory and asset transactions; define segregation-of-duties and role-based security for SCM users.
* Maintain the program RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and report status, milestones and escalations to the steering committee.
* Own the change-request process — impact assessment, approval, effort estimation and release planning.
* Drive user adoption: training plans, plant-wise train-the-trainer, SOPs and job aids, and post-go-live adoption metrics.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the single point of contact between plant operations, central procurement, finance, IT and the implementation partner.
* Run design authority forums to close cross-functional disagreements with a documented decision rather than an open loop.
* Support multi-plant / multi-entity template rollouts — protect the core template while accommodating genuine local statutory and process variations.

  

MUST HAVE:

* **Implementation depth:** 8–12 years total experience, with a minimum of 4–6 years on Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX 2012) Supply Chain Management. At least two end-to-end implementation cycles from discovery through hypercare.
* **Manufacturing domain:** Demonstrated experience in a discrete, process or engineered-to-order manufacturing setup — strong command of production planning, BOM/routing, sub-contracting and job work, shop-floor execution, inventory valuation and material costing.
* **Module ownership:** Hands-on configuration ability (not just requirement writing) across Procurement & Sourcing, Inventory & Warehouse Management, Production Control, Master Planning and Product Information Management.
* **Process fluency:** End-to-end command of Procure-to-Pay, Plan-to-Produce, Order-to-Cash and Record-to-Report as they interact with SCM.
* **Data & analysis:** Comfortable with data migration templates (DMF), Excel-based reconciliation at volume, and Power BI / SSRS reporting for SCM KPIs.
* **Program discipline:** Proven ability to run structured project governance — workplans, RAID logs, steering-committee reporting, partner and vendor management.
* **Communication:** Able to hold a credible conversation with a plant supervisor and a CXO on the same day, and write documentation that survives an audit.

Deliver accurate product costing, inventory valuation, manufacturing cost analysis, and profitability insights, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Industrial Controlling, and Finance to drive operational efficiency, ensure a timely and compliant costing close, and support strategic decision-making across the organization.

production variances.

**Costing Close & Reporting:** Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities for

costing and inventory, and prepare cost reports, manufacturing KPI dashboards, and

management analysis.

  

**Audit, Compliance & Controls:** Ensure compliance with Group accounting policies and internal controls, and support internal and external audits related to costing and inventory processes.

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Team Development:** Work with global stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and the Americas, including operational teams, to resolve costing matters, and support the training of young team members
