jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Finance Controller

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Finance & Accounting  
**Role:** Finance / Accounts

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Controller to oversee the organisation's end-to-end finance and accounting operations, budgeting, financial reporting, fund utilisation and compliance activities.

  

The ideal candidate should have experience working in a corporate environment, CSR projects or CSR implementation organisations, with a strong understanding of financial management, project-based accounting, donor/client reporting and statutory compliance. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring financial accuracy, transparency, effective cost management and adherence to organisational and regulatory requirements.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Finance & Accounting Operations**

* Manage and oversee day-to-day finance and accounting operations.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts, financial records and supporting documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, fund movement, cost allocation and financial controls.
* Ensure timely processing of payments, expenses and financial transactions.

**2. Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Prepare, review and monitor organisational and project-wise budgets.
* Develop financial forecasts and track actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adherence to allocated budgets.
* Identify budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

**3. CSR & Project Finance Management**

* Manage financial operations related to CSR-funded projects and implementation programmes.
* Prepare Utilisation Certificates (UCs), expenditure statements and financial reports as per donor/client requirements.
* Track project-wise fund utilisation and ensure proper documentation of expenses.
* Coordinate with project teams to monitor financial performance and budget utilisation.

**4. MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports, financial dashboards and management reports.
* Generate monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Provide financial analysis, budget variance reports and insights to management.
* Ensure accuracy and timely submission of financial reports.

**5. Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Take ownership of internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, financial policies and accounting standards.
* Maintain audit documentation and financial records.
* Support compliance requirements related to GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable regulations.

**6. Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal departments, project teams, management, auditors and external stakeholders.
* Liaise with donors, CSR partners and clients for financial reporting and documentation requirements.
* Support leadership with financial analysis, risk assessment and strategic decision-making.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Prior experience in a corporate environment, CSR finance, NGO, Foundation or CSR implementation organisation is preferred.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, financial planning, MIS reporting and financial controls.
* Hands-on experience in preparing Utilisation Certificates (UCs), project-wise financial reports and expenditure statements.
* Knowledge of internal audits, statutory audits and financial compliance.
* Experience in stakeholder coordination and project finance management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, financial reporting tools and accounting software such as Tally or ERP systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and financial reporting requirements independently.

  

**Educational Qualification**

* CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.
* Additional certifications in Finance, Accounting or Financial Management will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Industry Exposure**

* Corporate Finance & Accounts
* CSR Finance & Project Management
* NGO / Non-Profit Organisations
* CSR Implementation Organisations
* Foundation / Social Impact Organisations
* Grant & Donor-funded Projects

jobs.title: Assistant Manager F&A
jobs.description:
**Key responsibilities**

**Review**

* Review journal entries, vouchers and supporting documents posted in the ERP
* Review reconciliations bank, GL to sub-ledger (vendors, customers, inventory, fixed assets), intercompany and statutory dues (GST, TDS, PF/ESI)
* Review month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing schedules and the trial balance pack before sign-off
* Review MIS, financial statements and audit schedules before they go to management or auditors
* Check compliance with accounting policies, US GAAP and internal controls, and report exceptions

**Closures and audits**

* Own the closing calendar and checklist; make sure books close on time with cut-off, accruals and provisions in place
* Plan and lead statutory, internal and donor/grant audit readiness – PBC lists, schedules and timelines
* Act as the main contact for auditors, handle queries and close open points and observations

**Identifying issues and solving them**

* Identify accounting errors, control gaps, unreconciled balances and process weaknesses during review
* Find the root cause, propose the fix (entries, process change, ERP configuration or master data correction) and get it implemented
* Track issues to closure and make sure they do not repeat in the next close
* Take a view on technical accounting and tax matters and escalate significant points to the partner with a recommendation

**Managing the team**

* Plan and allocate work to associates / article assistants and set clear deadlines
* Review their work, give feedback and train them on the ERP, reconciliations and audit documentation
* Monitor progress, workload and quality, and step in when deliverables are at risk

**Managing the client**

* Be the day-to-day point of contact for the client's finance team and management
* Hold regular status meetings; report progress, open issues and risks clearly
* Manage expectations on scope, timelines and information needed from the client
* Build a working relationship that lets issues be raised and resolved early

**Analysis and reporting**

* Oversee monthly MIS – P&L, balance sheet and cash flow with variance analysis
* Budget vs actual analysis by programme, cost centre and project, with clear explanations for management
* Analyse unusual movements, ageing and trends, and suggest action points
* Handle ad hoc analysis requested by the client or Fintegrity

jobs.title: Sales & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
JOB ROLE:

  

**Sales & Support Specialist**

  

***Location:** Refyne HQ, Bengaluru (On-site) | **Team:** Growth | **Reports To:** General Manager*

  

**About Refyne**

  

**Refyne is building the financial infrastructure of Bharat's workforce.**

What began as an earned wage access solution for India's largest employers has grown into a full-spectrum financial platform spanning lending, insurance, savings and wealth. Refyne is trusted by some of the country's most valuable companies to power the financial lives of their people.

  

Today, Refyne has partnered with over 600+ top enterprises to bring fair, timely and responsible financial services to more than 10 million employees across India, helping employers drive a 90%+ employee retention rate.

  

***One platform. Every employer. Bharat's entire workforce.***

As India's economy scales, Refyne is building the foundational layer that lets every employee, across every workplace, access financial security with ease, convenience and dignity.

  

**About the Role**

  

At Refyne, sales and customer support aren't separate functionsthey are about building trust at every interaction.

Sitting at the intersection of business expansion and user satisfaction, you will drive customer acquisition while ensuring post-onboarding success. As a Sales & Support Specialist, you will manage outbound sales campaigns, walk users through KYC setups, and resolve account-related inquiries. Joining us means delivering fast, empathetic, and solution-driven experiences that convert leads and maximize long-term retention.

  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

  

* Qualify incoming leads and execute targeted outbound phone campaigns to convert new users and achieve sales targets.
* Manage the end-to-end sales pipeline within CRM tools, tracking customer interactions and negotiating contract terms.
* Guide new customers through account setup, document submissions, and KYC verification for seamless onboarding.
* Provide fast, accurate omnichannel support across phone, email, live chat, and ticketing systems (Zendesk/Freshdesk).
* Troubleshoot payment, settlement, transaction, or UI issues, escalating bugs to Product and Engineering teams.
* Conduct proactive check-ins with existing accounts to minimize churn and identify cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

  

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

  

* 13 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Sales-Support roles within FinTech, Digital Payments, or Banking.
* Sound understanding of digital financial services, payment flows, and digital onboarding frameworks.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer support software (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a consultative selling approach and strong empathy.
* High problem-solving ability with a track record of resolving technical or account inquiries under tight SLAs

  

**What You'll Be Part Of**

  

**The Team**

  

Youll be part of a dynamic Growth team that seamlessly balances sales acquisition with high-touch user engagement.

  

**The Platform**

  

You will serve as a frontline touchpoint for Refyne's financial platform—ensuring every new user moves from sales conversion to active platform usage effortlessly.

  

**Perks at Refyne**

  

* Meaningful ownership from day one. Work in a flat organization where your ideas are heard and your contributions have real impact.
* An exceptional team, Collaborate with ambitious, high-performing teams that challenge and support you to do your best work.
* Experience a collaborative culture where every customer insight helps shape better products.
* Fuel for your best work. Enjoy complimentary breakfast, lunch, and snacks at the office.

  

**Why Join Refyne?**

  

The companies driving India's growth understand that financially secure employees build stronger organisations and stronger economies. Refyne exists at that intersection: a single, trusted infrastructure that employers plug into and employees rely on, without friction or fragmentation.

  

Our solution helps workers cleanly bypass predatory debt traps to build real financial resilience, rather than simply pointing them toward financial products and stepping back. It's the financial backbone behind India Inc, built with the same permanence and scale as the roads and utilities that move the country forward.

  

That ambition is backed by results: Refyne is growing at a rapid 4x year-on-year pace, is already profitable and ranks globally as the second-largest player by revenue in our space. The company is also backed by **$106 million from top global investors including Tiger Global, DST Global and ICICI Bank.** For employers, that means a partner with the credibility, scale and staying power to be trusted at the infrastructure level. For employees, it means one platform that grows with every stage of their financial life.

  

More about us- Our website

Our Story - Refyne in news

See us in action - Ad Campaign

We are seeking a highly experienced **Client-Facing Technical Architect** to join our team of experts delivering scalable, microservices-based enterprise solutions across a variety of customers, especially in regulated and complex environments like banking and financial services.

In this role, you will act as a **technical leader, trusted advisor, and architecture expert**, working closely with customer stakeholders (CIO, Infrastructure Heads, Security, and DevOps teams) to drive successful implementations of our productized microservice solutions.

Youll bring a deep understanding of enterprise systems, infrastructure, DevOps, security, and application architecture. You should be able to **translate customer requirements into robust architectures**, aligning with their identity, observability, integration, and deployment landscapes.

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture design for client implementations, based on our core microservice-based platform.

* Guide customers through containerized deployments (Docker/K8s), CI/CD workflows, and DevSecOps best practices.

* Drive architectural governance, technical workshops, and solution reviews.
* Collaborate with internal engineering and delivery teams to ensure implementations are robust and aligned with client needs.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Deep hands-on and architectural knowledge of:

**Microservice architectures** and Spring-based frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, etc.).

**Messaging systems** like Apache Kafka and ActiveMQ.

**RDBMS platforms** like PostgreSQL and Oracle Database.

* Proven experience integrating with **enterprise IAM systems** (OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, etc.).
* Solid understanding of **DevOps practices**, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD workflows (Jenkins, GitOps, etc.).
* Experience navigating **enterprise observability tooling** (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Splunk).

jobs.title: SAP IS-U FICA Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Title : SAP IS-U FICA Specialist   
   
 Key Responsibilities :   
   
 SAP IS-U FICA Implementation & Support :   
   
 - Lead or contribute to the implementation of SAP IS-U FICA (Financial Contract Accounting) modules for utilities industry projects, ensuring alignment with business processes.   
   
 - Provide support for FICA processes including invoicing, receivables, payment processing, and dunning.   
   
 Integration with Other SAP Modules :   
   
 - Ensure smooth integration of IS-U FICA with other SAP modules such as FI-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable), FI-GL (General Ledger), CRM, Billing, and DM (Device Management).   
   
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data flow and business process requirements.   
   
 Customer Financial Management :   
   
 - Manage and configure customer payment processing, installment plans, security deposits, and interest calculation functionalities.   
   
 - Handle credit checks, dunning, and collections processes, ensuring effective customer account management.   
   
 Clearing and Reconciliation :   
   
 - Design and configure automatic clearing rules for incoming payments and open items.   
   
 - Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies between customer receivables and payments.   
   
 Business Process Design :   
   
 - Work with business users to gather requirements, perform gap analysis, and design business processes in IS-U FICA to meet organizational needs.   
   
 - Ensure business processes for financial transactions are accurately mapped and configured in the system.   
   
 Configuration of FICA Functions :   
   
 - Configure payment processing, dunning, interest calculation, security deposits, and refund processes within SAP IS-U FICA.   
   
 - Customize incoming/outgoing payments, integration with banking interfaces, and automatic payment programs.   
   
 Reporting and Analysis :   
   
 - Develop and configure FICA-related reports to track customer accounts, billing history, payment status, and dunning history.   
   
 - Ensure transparency and accuracy in reporting financial transactions related to customer accounts.   
   
 Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting :   
   
 - Identify and resolve issues in SAP IS-U FICA through debugging and providing solutions for system errors, discrepancies, and user challenges.   
   
 - Handle end-user tickets related to financial contract accounting processes.   
   
 Testing and Validation :   
   
 - Participate in or lead functional testing (unit, integration, and user acceptance testing) for SAP IS-U FICA configurations and customizations.   
   
 - Validate that FICA processes meet the business requirements and perform according to system specifications.   
   
 End-User Training & Documentation :   
   
 - Develop training materials and provide end-user training on SAP IS-U FICA functionalities.   
   
 - Maintain system and process documentation for configurations, business process flows, and system enhancements.   
   
 Technical Knowledge and Skills Required :   
   
 - In-depth knowledge of SAP IS-U FICA (Financial Contract Accounting), specifically within the utilities sector.   
   
 - Strong experience in configuring payment processing, dunning, security deposits, interest calculation, and installment plans.   
   
 - Expertise in contract accounting and integration with FI-CA, FI-GL, and IS-U Billing.   
   
 - Proficiency in handling reconciliation, open items, automatic clearing, and integration with banking interfaces.   
   
 - Strong understanding of business process mapping and gap analysis for utilities-specific financial requirements.   
   
 - Knowledge of dunning procedures, customer credit management, and collections processes.   
   
 - Ability to create and run reports for financial transactions and customer account management in SAP IS-U.   
   
 - ABAP debugging knowledge to troubleshoot issues in FICA modules.   
   
 Soft Skills Required :   
   
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities to address financial discrepancies and system configuration issues.   
   
 - Excellent communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.   
   
 - Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects in a dynamic environment.   
   
 - Strong documentation and training skills to ensure effective knowledge transfer to users.

**Job Summary**

* Drive change for colleagues by leading the evolution of the India Benefits Wellbeing proposition, within the framework of the enterprise Benefit and Wellbeing strategy using data, market insight, and stakeholder engagement to shape benefits programmes, policies, and wellbeing initiatives
* Help shape a benefits offering that attracts and retains top talent by strengthening competitiveness, sustainability, and employer differentiation
* Influence strategic decision-making by developing recommendations that support colleague needs and business priorities while enabling effective delivery and colleague experience
* We're offering this role at vice president level

**What you'll do**

As a Benefits Wellbeing Manager, you'll lead the review and evolution of the India benefits and wellbeing policy, proposition design, standards, and roadmap, identifying opportunities to enhance colleague value, support talent attraction and retention, and align with business priorities and long-term sustainability. Using colleague insight, data, market practice, supplier input, and external trends, you'll also identify emerging needs, risks, and opportunities, as well as assess current effectiveness, and shape strategic priorities for the India benefits Jand wellbeing agenda.

Moreover, you'll lead the development of analysis, proposals, business cases, and recommendations to inform decisions on India benefits and wellbeing priorities, proposition changes, policy development, and future investment working within enterprise governance and decision-making frameworks. Working closely with Colleague Experience Delivery (CED), local People teams, enterprise Reward colleagues and external partners, you'll also support in translating strategy into action, delivering meaningful colleague and business outcomes.

In addition, youll be:

* Owning the India benefits and wellbeing agenda, including priorities, policies, proposition design, standards, and roadmap delivery, within the framework set by the Benefits Wellbeing Strategy Lead
* Using insight, feedback, and market information to assess effectiveness, identify strategic opportunities and risks, and inform prioritisation and roadmap decisions across India
* Bring an India perspective to the development of the bankwide benefits and wellbeing strategy, using local insight, colleague feedback, market practice and business context to inform emerging priorities.
* Overseeing governance, risk, and control activities relating to India benefits and wellbeing policy and proposition changes, ensuring proposals are developed within the agreed framework
* Building strong relationships with CED, Talent Acquisition, Risk and Control, Finance, HR Business Partners, and other key stakeholders to shape and evolve the India offer and support effective delivery

**The skills you'll need**

We're looking for someone with deep subject matter expertise in benefits and wellbeing policy, proposition design, market practice, supplier, and product landscapes, and relevant local regulatory considerations. You should also have strong knowledge of colleague benefits and all pillars of wellbeing in India, alongside a clear understanding of how benefits and wellbeing support colleague experience and organisational performance.

To succeed in this role, you must be able to use data, colleague insight, market practice, and external trends to exercise sound judgement and shape strategic recommendations, priorities, roadmap choices, and proposition development.

In addition, youll need:

* Experience leading or owning policy, proposition development, projects, or strategic activity in a reward, benefits, wellbeing, people or related environment
* Experience developing papers, business cases, and proposals to support decisions on priorities, policy changes, and investment
* An understanding of governance, risk, and control requirements relevant to benefits and wellbeing policy and proposition activity

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Join us as a Solution Architect

* Well look to you to lead the solution architecture definition for your assigned change programme, in addition to delivering business outcomes for both customers and colleagues
* You'll be driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* If youre ready for a new challenge and want to make a far-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity youre looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level

**What you'll do**

As a Solution Architect, youll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the banks strategic target architecture.

Youll be actively contributing to the growth of architecting capability and the community across the bank by sharing knowledge including best practices, proven solutions and key learnings, contributing to the community of practice, and building capability in others through coaching, mentoring and teaching.

As well as this, youll be:

* Supporting the realisation of the Enterprise and Solution Architecture, working as part of development teams throughout the engineering development lifecycle
* Providing technical guidance, resolving architectural impediments, and championing the adoption of architecture patterns and practices
* Proactively influencing stakeholders to embed the reuse of digital capabilities, contributing to simplification and the realisation of the banks strategic target architecture
* Partnering and engaging with programme stakeholders and following the banks data driven architecture method and framework to define and evolve the minimum viable solution architectures that deliver the programme objectives and business value
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Undertaking design reviews of delivery programmes of high architectural significance or high architectural risk

**The skills you'll need**

To take on this role, youll need extensive knowledge of solution architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success.

Youll bring experience of defining and developing strategic solution architectures that align with organisational objectives. This will include experience of engaging with partners across the organisation to define architectures that deliver tangible business outcomes. You'll need an experience of 15+ years for this role.

Youll also demonstrate experience of:

* Collaborative decision-making processes, partnering with business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Creating business cases to influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Participating in architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* Proven people capability development, including mentoring, supporting professional development, encouraging knowledge sharing across architecture teams and promoting best practices

jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic **Account Manager - Life Sciences** to drive client success, growth and satisfaction across key accounts, with a strong emphasis on Pharma, Biotech and MedTech clients. Acting as a trusted advisor and engagement architect, you will partner with clients, internal teams and senior leadership to shape account strategies, oversee delivery excellence and ensure long-term business growth. This role demands a strong blend of business acumen, delivery oversight, domain expertise in Life Sciences and leadership — ideal for a results-driven professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, business and customer experience.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary Account Manager, collaborating closely with clients, internal teams, BU Heads and Sales Leads
* Align with senior Account Management leadership to co-develop and execute account plans for growth, delivery excellence and client satisfaction
* Serve as the engagement architect, defining account strategies and positioning EPAM for success across the Life Sciences value chain (R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Commercial and Patient Engagement)
* Build and nurture trusted relationships with senior-level client stakeholders and internal executives
* Support clients as a product owner, helping shape product vision, roadmaps and compelling customer value propositions
* Drive revenue growth across assigned accounts and support company financial objectives by achieving revenue and profit targets
* Expand EPAM's footprint within Life Sciences accounts, driving opportunities across digital transformation, data & analytics, clinical platforms, regulatory systems and commercial solutions
* Lead sales/pre-sales activities including opportunity assessments, RFP responses, proposal creation and client presentations
* Demonstrate services through in-person or virtual client sessions and maintain a monthly pipeline, tracking progress and reporting key metrics to leadership
* Partner with program/project management to ensure successful delivery through an integrated delivery model
* Shape and scope engagement models, pricing and delivery strategies aligned to Life Sciences compliance and regulatory requirements
* Ensure smooth transitions from sales to delivery, maintaining accountability for client outcomes and satisfaction
* Monitor performance metrics across large-scale accounts and ensure alignment with business goals
* Stay abreast of market trends, emerging technologies and industry challenges across Life Sciences such as digital health, real-world evidence and pharmacovigilance
* Serve as an expert consultant guiding business transformation, product strategy and innovation initiatives for Life Sciences clients

**Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience in account management with large enterprise accounts
* Proven record of achieving and exceeding sales and revenue goals
* Expertise in the Pharma, Biotech and MedTech ecosystem including clinical trials, regulatory compliance and pharmacovigilance
* Knowledge of commercial operations and patient-centric solutions
* Understanding of technology platforms, digital transformation and IT services within Life Sciences and healthcare ecosystems
* Capability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels to deliver client and business success
* Skills in team leadership, performance management and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in presentation, negotiation and relationship-building with senior stakeholders
* Competency in problem-solving, critical thinking and solution design

jobs.title: Manager Business Development
jobs.description:
**1. Job Purpose**

**To manage, develop, and strengthen relationships with key customers of Holoflex Limited by ensuring customer satisfaction, business growth, account retention, and long-term strategic partnerships.**

**The Key Accounts Manager will be responsible for understanding customer requirements and providing appropriate solutions across Holoflex's product portfolio, including holographic products, security labels, authentication solutions, anti-counterfeiting products, and flexographic printing solutions.**

**The role will act as the primary interface between key customers and internal departments to ensure seamless coordination from enquiry and order confirmation through production, quality assurance, dispatch, and payment collection.**

  

**2. Key Responsibilities / KRAs**

**A. Key Account Management & Customer Relationship**

1. **Manage and develop relationships with existing key accounts, strategic customers, and large corporate clients.**
2. **Act as the single point of contact for all commercial, technical, operational, and service-related requirements of assigned customers.**
3. **Understand customer business requirements, purchasing patterns, future plans, and emerging needs.**
4. **Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, and relationship-building meetings.**
5. **Develop customer retention strategies and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.**
6. **Identify opportunities to increase business share within existing accounts through cross-selling and up-selling.**

**B. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

1. **Develop and execute account-specific business development plans to achieve assigned sales targets.**
2. **Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and explore opportunities for new product introductions.**
3. **Generate enquiries and convert them into profitable business orders.**
4. **Promote Holoflex's holographic, security printing, authentication, and flexographic printing solutions.**
5. **Develop long-term business relationships with procurement heads, brand managers, quality teams, technical teams, and senior management of customers.**
6. **Monitor competitor activities, market trends, pricing strategies, and customer preferences.**

**C. Order Management & Execution**

1. **Monitor order status, production schedules, and delivery commitments.**
2. **Ensure timely submission of quotations, order confirmations, samples, and other customer documentation.**
3. **Proactively communicate any delays if any or challenges affecting customer deliveries.**
4. **Ensure accuracy of customer purchase orders, pricing, specifications, and delivery terms.**
5. **Track order fulfilment and ensure adherence to agreed service levels.**

**D. Commercial Management & Payment Collection**

1. **Prepare and submit quotations, commercial proposals, and price revisions in coordination with management.**
2. **Ensure profitability and contribution margins are maintained in assigned accounts.**
3. **Monitor customer-wise sales, profitability, outstanding receivables, and business performance.**

**E. Customer Complaint & Service Management**

1. **Act as the primary escalation point for customer complaints and service-related issues.**
2. **Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and maintain proper closure records.**

**F. MIS, Reporting & Business Review**

1. **Maintain updated customer-wise sales, enquiry, order, and collection records.**
2. **Prepare monthly and quarterly account performance reports.**
3. **Submit sales forecasts, order pipelines, and business development reports to management.**

**G. Market Intelligence & Strategic Account Development**

**About Flatworld Solutions**

Flatworld Solutions is a global business solutions company that has evolved over two decades from BPO to technology, business process automation, and now GenAI. Serving 50+ countries, we offer diverse services, including IT, finance, healthcare, engineering, design, and data science.

Fund Accounting Private Equity & Real Estate

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead fund accounting operations for Private Equity and Real Estate fund structures. The successful candidate will oversee NAV production, financial reporting, investor reporting, team management, and client relationship activities while ensuring adherence to regulatory, accounting, and internal control requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

  

* Review and approve monthly, quarterly, and annual Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations.
* Oversee capital call, distribution, carried interest, management fee, equalization, and waterfall calculations.
* Ensure accurate accounting for investments, portfolio valuations, accruals, foreign exchange transactions, and partnership allocations.
* Review fund performance metrics and investor allocations.

Financial Reporting

  

* Review annual and interim financial statements prepared under IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP, or local reporting standards.
* Coordinate with auditors and support year-end audit processes.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory and regulatory reporting requirements.

Private Equity & Real Estate Operations

  

* Monitor investment transactions, including acquisitions, disposals, and restructuring activities.
* Review property and investment-level accounting records.
* Ensure accurate tracking of portfolio investments and commitment schedules.
* Manage complex fund structures including LPs, GP entities, SPVs, and holding companies.

Client Relationship Management

  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for key clients.
* Conduct regular governance and service review meetings.
* Ensure adherence to SLA/KPI commitments.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and value-added services.

Leadership & Team Management

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop Fund Accounting Managers and Analysts.
* Manage resource planning, workload allocation, and performance reviews.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and training activities.

Risk, Compliance & Controls

  

* Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Review and strengthen operational risk frameworks.
* Support implementation of new regulatory and accounting requirements.
* Participate in internal and external audits.

Process Improvement & Projects

  

* Lead automation, system enhancement, and transition projects.
* Drive efficiency utilizing fund accounting platforms and reporting tools.
* Participate in migrations, client onboarding, and change management initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or related discipline.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 8-12+ years of experience in Fund Accounting with substantial exposure to Private Equity and Real Estate funds.
* Strong experience in NAV preparation and review.
* Proven people management and stakeholder management experience.
* Experience handling global clients across multiple jurisdictions.

Technical Skills

  

* Strong understanding of:

+ Private Equity Fund Accounting
+ Real Estate Fund Accounting
+ NAV Calculations
+ Capital Calls & Distributions
+ Waterfall Calculations
+ Carried Interest
+ Partnership Accounting
+ Financial Statement Preparation
+ Investor Reporting
+ IFRS / US GAAP

* Working knowledge of platforms such as Investran, Yardi, eFront, Allvue, Geneva, or equivalent systems.

Core Competencies

  

* Leadership & Team Development
* Client Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Risk Awareness
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

Preferred Experience

  

* Experience managing large fund accounting teams (10+ members).
* Exposure to complex PE and Real Estate structures.
* Experience in fund administration organizations such as Apex Group, SS&C GlobeOp, IQ-EQ, CSC, Alter Domus, TMF Group, Vistra, Citco, or Gen II Fund Services.

**Fund Accounting Lead / Associate Vice President - 15+ Years - Pune**

  

Are you an experienced Fund Accounting / Fund Administration professional with strong expertise in private equity, hedge funds, financial reporting and team leadership? We are looking for a senior professional to lead Fund Accounting operations and drive governance, controls and process excellence.

  

**Location** Pune

  

**Your Future Employer** A leading global organization offering opportunities across Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Private Equity, Financial Reporting and Operations.

  

**Responsibilities**  
 • Lead and manage a high-performing Fund Accounting team, providing guidance, training and performance feedback.  
 • Oversee NAV calculations, financial statements, capital activities and financial reporting for assigned funds.  
 • Manage fund administrator relationships, audits, SLAs, KPIs and governance requirements.  
 • Act as an escalation point for complex accounting and reporting issues.  
 • Drive process improvements, SOP governance, operational efficiency and transition/offshoring initiatives.  
 • Ensure compliance with fund prospectuses, contractual requirements and applicable accounting standards.  
 • Support annual financial statement preparation and audit processes across designated funds.  
 • Collaborate with Fund Governance & Control, Strategy, Operations, Finance, Auditors and Fund Administrators.

jobs.description:
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

  

**What we offer -**

  

**Impact:** Your work will directly contribute to the success of our global operations.

**Opportunity:** Maersk provides ample opportunities for growth and development, both professionally and personally.

**Innovation:** Join a forward-thinking team that embraces innovation and cutting-edge technologies.

**Global Exposure:** Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and gain exposure to international business practices.

**Work-Life Balance:** We value work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements to support our employees

  

**Job Description Summary -**

  

* Accounting Manager will be part of the General Ledger Controlling organization and will work with wide range of stakeholders within and outside the finance and operations organization.
* Accounting Manager will be responsible to ensure that the global accounting processes, IFRS and group guidelines are followed. He/ She need to ensure the accounting and reporting is completed in timely and accurate manner.
* He / She will also be responsible to liaise with auditors. He/she is expected to act proactively to search for and implement continuous improvements in areas of General Ledger accounting, controlling and reporting across NAM entities.
* So if you are looking for challenges with a strong urge to take your capabilities further, operating with a global perspective and working with motivated colleagues.

  

**Key activities/responsibilities would be:**

  

1) Entity Control (LnS) BS and PnL accounts.

2) Perform month end accounting and reporting activities, handling of special or one-off issues related to entity and liaise with FBPs, Controller and consolidation team.

3) Review, validate and update the accounting records, reporting and ensure those are as per in compliant.

4) Liaise and provide timely updates to all the stakeholders especially management.

5) Audit of NAM geography.

6) Suggest recommendations for development and implement changes to processes and systems -

a) Considering latest development in accounting.

b) Which will minimise risk, improve control environment and productivity.

  

**Required Skill and Experience:**

  

**1)Ready to work in NAM shift time from Evening 4 pm to 1 am.**

2) Chartered Accountant. IFRS Diploma from ICAI/ ACCA or good working knowledge is preferred

3) Minimum 7 to 14 years of post-qualification experience within reporting and controlling, accounting or in business finance

4) Good understanding of S4 Hana/Workday/PACE accounting systems and global accounting.

5) Proactive, Self-motivated and continuously looks for opportunities to improve financial reporting and processes by exploring new approaches and ideas

6) Excellent analytical and structured working method

7) High competency in written and verbal English

8) Adapts easily to a fast-changing environment and ability to handle phases with high workload and unplanned activities

9) Team player - works together with others to achieve results and fosters teamwork

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven **Sales Manager** to join our team at **Ethiqual Global Pvt. Ltd.** The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of facility management services, including cleaning, maintenance, security, and housekeeping management.

As  **Sales Manager**, your primary responsibility will be driving the growth of our business by identifying new opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and selling our comprehensive facility management services to businesses across various sectors.  
   
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Core Selling:** Promote and sell our wide range of facility management services (cleaning, maintenance, security, waste management, HVAC, etc.) to new and existing clients.
* **Business Development:** Identify and target potential clients in different sectors (commercial, residential, industrial, healthcare, etc.) and build strong client relationships.
* **Lead Generation:** Proactively generate leads through networking, market research, cold calling, and attending industry events or conferences.
* **Client Consultation:** Conduct needs assessments and site visits to understand client requirements and tailor solutions that meet their specific facility management needs.

* **Negotiation & Closing:** Lead negotiations with prospective clients and close deals to meet and exceed sales targets.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Maintain strong ongoing relationships with clients to ensure high levels of satisfaction and retention.
* **Market Research:** Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and client feedback to adapt strategies and ensure service offerings remain competitive.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with other departments such as Operations, Marketing, and Finance to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Track and report on sales activities, pipeline status, and key performance metrics to senior management.

* Proven experience in sales, preferably within facility management, property management, or related service industries.
* Strong knowledge of facility management services, including cleaning, maintenance, security, and other associated services.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong ability to build relationships and network effectively.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Previous experience in a leadership role (for Sales Manager position).
* A solid network of industry contacts and leads.
* Knowledge of local market dynamics and trends in facility management services.

**Why Join Us?**

* Competitive salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity for career growth and development within a fast-paced and evolving industry.
* Comprehensive benefits package.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

**How to Apply:**  
If you are a driven, customer-focused sales professional with a passion for the facility management industry, we would love to hear from you.

  

Please submit your resume to **recruiter03@ethiqual.co.in**

jobs.description:
We are seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role is located in Pune

  

**In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of scalable full-stack applications across architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and implement enterprise-grade software solutions using modern frameworks, APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions in partnership with product, architecture, design, and engineering stakeholders.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, test automation, CI/CD pipelines, secure coding, and software quality best practices.
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience across applications and services.
* Own production stability through monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous performance optimization.
* Contribute to technical strategy, roadmap planning, and architecture decisions, including build/buy evaluations and solution patterns.
* Leverage AI and emerging technologies responsibly to enhance engineering productivity and improve client and employee experiences.

**To be successful in this role, were seeking the following:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.
* 9+ years of software development experience with strong full-stack expertise across backend and frontend technologies.
* Deep backend expertise in Java 11+, Spring Boot 3+, with proven experience building microservices and designing/implementing RESTful APIs.
* Frontend development experience with Angular 14+ and JavaScript, including modern UI patterns, state management, and reusable component design.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Windsurf, Codex, or Devin, including effective prompt writing for code generation, refactoring, and test creation.
* Familiarity with MCP servers and emerging agentic frameworks to extend AI capabilities in developer workflows.
* Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms, preferably Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of testing and quality engineering, including JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber/Gherkin, unit/integration testing, and experience with TDD and BDD practices.
* Proficiency with code quality and security tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, or Fortify.
* Strong DevOps and CI/CD experience, including Git/GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern release strategies such as blue-green and feature-flag deployments.
* Familiarity with observability and logging practices, including SLF4J/Log4j, log aggregation, metrics, tracing, and tools such as Splunk.
* Experience with MongoDB, Snowflake, or other NoSQL/data platforms, with a solid understanding of data modeling for microservices.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and pair programming skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and collaboration platforms like Slack.
* Experience with workflow and rules engines such as Camunda 7/8 and Drools 7/8.
* Knowledge of distributed caching and cloud-native patterns, including Hazelcast 5 and Spring Cloud.

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales – Sanitary Ware, Tiles & Hey Concrete

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive business growth and expand market presence across the sanitary ware, tiles and Hey Concrete segments. jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Manager Business Development**  
Intelligent Business Solutions | vSplash  
Base Location: Hyderabad  
Role: Sales and Business Development, Individual Contributor  
Experience: 15+ years of experience, combining B2B software solutions sales with a strong understanding of business processes and workflows.

**Why This Role Matters**

Businesses often have software in place, yet people still spend their day chasing updates, reconciling reports, checking documents and moving work between systems.  
vSplash builds intelligent business operations, operational intelligence and AI systems tailored to each business to solve their operational challenges.  
Your responsibility includes identifying and prospecting the right businesses, understanding their business problems and turning qualified conversations into paying engagements. You will work directly with senior leadership on discovery, demonstrations, proposals and closing. Your first responsibility is to create opportunities through your own prospecting.

**What You Will Do**

* Build opportunities by identifying relevant businesses, mapping decision makers and prospecting them.
* Create conversations through industry associations, events and referral partners. Build relationships with people who already advise or serve our prospective customers.
* Lead initial discovery. Understand the current workflow, recurring problems, business impact, existing systems, buying process, budget and urgency before recommending a solution.
* Coordinate relevant demos and solution discussions with technical leaders. Develop proposals with clear scope, commercials, responsibilities and next steps; own follow-up, negotiation and contract progression.
* Coordinate the handover to delivery, follow through on agreed commercial milestones and identify expansion opportunities after customer value is established.
* Bring market learning back to the team. Explain which problems recur, what buyers value, which alternatives they consider and why opportunities move forward or stall.
* Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasts, track key performance metrics (KPIs), and regularly report pipeline progress to executive leadership.

**Who You Are**

You are proactive and have zeal to succeed. You have the knack of getting into conversations without a warm introduction. You listen closely, ask practical questions and earn the attention of senior business leaders. You can work through ambiguity, seek technical help when needed and keep an opportunity moving without overstating what a solution can do.

**Skills and Experience to Have**

Must have

* A demonstrated record of prospecting for new B2B customers and progressing opportunities through discovery, proposal, negotiation and closure.
* Experience selling technology services, enterprise software, ERP or CRM solutions, business automation, analytics or comparable consultative solutions where requirements vary by customer.
* Ability to discuss operating problems and business value with owners, finance leaders and operations teams, and translate those conversations into a useful brief for technical colleagues.
* Experience understanding and mapping business workflows, identifying operating problems and connecting them to suitable software solutions.
* Strong written and spoken communication, proposal presentation and disciplined follow-up. Explain complex solutions in clear business language.
* Independently manage accounts, meetings and follow-through.

Nice to have

* Experience with distributors or C&F businesses, retail chains, independent hospitals, specialist manufacturers, poultry or seed businesses.
* Familiarity with the Hyderabad and Telangana business environment, industry associations or relevant technology partners. Telugu communication skills would be useful.
* Exposure to dashboards, integrations, document processing or AI-enabled workflows.

**What Good Performance Looks Like**

You create and own a qualified pipeline and convert opportunities into paying engagements. Your forecasts reflect evidence, and your feedback sharpens customer selection, offers and messaging. Consistently achieve milestones and targets for qualified opportunities, conversions, revenue and commercial follow-through.

**Why Join vSplash**

Build a new business alongside senior leaders. Earn satisfaction of overcoming market dynamics and be part of building something from scratch. You will have working solutions to demonstrate, room to shape the market approach and a visible contribution to customer outcomes.

**Ready to Apply**

Share your resume and two examples of B2B opportunities you originated and helped close. Describe your approach, the customers problem, approximate deal value and your contribution. Anonymize confidential details. Show us how you create business and earn trust.

\*\***Only candidates currently residing in Hyderabad may apply.**

**Locations:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 5+ Years Minimum in Business Development & Client Servicing within the Events, Exhibitions & Experiential Marketing industry (or related field)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** 100,000 per month (In-Hand)  
**Company Website:** https://festivaevents.co.in  
**About Festiva Exhibition & Events Pvt. Ltd.**  
Festiva Exhibition & Events delivers large-scale events and exhibitions where the stakes are high and the margin for error is zero. Recognized by DPIIT and backed by a leadership and technical team with over 100 years of collective industry experience, our firm handles the full arc of turnkey executions from concept and custom spatial fabrication to AV engineering, protocol coordination, hospitality, and on-ground delivery across India, with operations spanning **Delhi,** **Gurgaon,** **Noida, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Lucknow**.  
Having delivered 250+ events and 70+ large-scale exhibitions (including 100+ events in the last three years), our portfolio spans G20 India 2023 across 30+ locations, BRICS Summit India 2026 summits, 250 Years of US Independence, GS1 General Assembly 2025, Telangana Rising Global Summit, Khelo India, Legends League Cricket, and World Para Athletics 2026. We serve marquee government, institutional, and corporate clients including the Ministry of External Affairs, DPIIT, MeitY, Ministry of Tourism, Government of Telangana, U.S. Embassy in India, Government of Maharashtra, Godrej Properties, Thomas Cook, Mercer, Marsh, Cloudflare, and CEAT.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Business Development**

* **New Client Acquisition:** Identify, prospect, and onboard fresh enterprise corporate accounts, diplomatic missions, industry associations, and institutional bodies across **Hyderabad**, for conferences, trade exhibitions, product launches, brand activations, and mega-events.
* **Existing Client Expansion:** Work closely with existing clients to generate repeat mandates, upsell additional event and exhibition scope, and drive sustained account revenue.
* **Pipeline, RFPs & Deal Closure:** Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, lead corporate RFP and tender submissions within deadlines, negotiate commercials while protecting margins, and close deals through to Purchase Order (PO) sign-off.

**Client Servicing**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Track Record:** Demonstrated ability to acquire and onboard new clients, grow existing accounts, and manage end-to-end client relationships across corporate events, exhibitions, or institutional mandates.
* **Regional Network:** Strong existing decision-maker network across corporate, agency, and/or institutional ecosystems in **Hyderabad**.
* **Core Skills:** Persuasive pitch presentation, brief decoding, BOQ/cost-sheet oversight, commercial negotiation, and structured handover to operations teams.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel as required for client meetings, pitches, and key engagements.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Quality Assurance Team Lead**

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana (On-site / Hybrid)

  

**Job Type:** Full-Time

  

**Notice Period:** **Immediate Joiners to 7 Days Max**

  

**Target Audience:** **Open to current QA Team Leads OR Senior Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) ready to step into leadership**

  

**Department:** Quality Assurance / Operations

  

**Role Overview**

  

We are looking for a **Quality Assurance Team Lead** to maintain, evaluate, and elevate our performance standards. **This position is ideal for experienced Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional communication skills looking to take the next step into leadership**, as well as current QA Leads seeking a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you will act as a benchmark for quality and communication. You will leverage **strong MS Excel skills** to evaluate metrics, uncover trends, facilitate calibration sessions, and deliver high-impact developmental coaching to team members.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **SME Leadership & Coaching:** Leverage deep process knowledge and **exceptional verbal and written communication** to mentor, train, and coach team members toward meeting performance targets.
* **Performance & Data Analytics:** Track, review, and evaluate operational quality metrics using **strong MS Excel capabilities** (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and dashboards) to map operational trends.
* **Calibration & Consistency:** Drive and maintain calibration scores across the QA team to guarantee fair, accurate, and consistent scoring across customer interactions.
* **Stakeholder & Client Collaboration:** Partner with Operations, Training, and client-partners to share actionable data insights, resolve scripting issues or caller trends, and support Business Development efforts.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Supervise and verify daily accounting entries in Tally Prime / ERPincluding sales, purchases, cash/bank vouchers, journal entries, expense bookings, and inter-branch transfers.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations, petty cash audits, and ledger scrutiny across HQ, and factories across all the branches.
* Maintain clean, error-free books of accounts ready for internal and statutory audits at all times.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation**

* Manage timely calculation, filing, and reconciliation of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, and Annual Returns) and e-way bill compliance.
* Handle monthly TDS deductions, challan payments, and quarterly TDS returns, along with PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax (PT) statutory filings.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants (CAs) and auditors for tax audits, balance sheet finalization, and regulatory notices.

**3. Accounts Receivable (A/R), Payable (A/P) & Cash Flow Control**

* Monitor customer outstanding balances, receivables reports, and credit limits; coordinate with the Sales and Operations teams to ensure timely payment collections.
* Verify vendor bills against Purchase Orders (POs) and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) before scheduling supplier payments.
* Prepare weekly cash-flow forecasts, fund-requirement statements, and working capital reports for management.

**4. Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting**

* Coordinate closely with the factory and Store team to reconcile physical inventory against book stock, track raw material consumption, and monitor work-in-progress (WIP) valuations.
* Support management in product costing, margin analysis, and wastage/variance tracking across rigid box and display manufacturing lines.

**5. Payroll Processing & MIS Reporting**

* Process monthly payroll across office, branch, and factory staffverifying attendance, leaves, overtime, advances, and statutory deductions.
* Deliver structured monthly MIS reports to management, including Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, branch-wise profitability, expense variance analyses, and debtor/creditor summaries.

**6. Team Supervision & Internal Controls**

* Guide, train, and review the work of junior accounting staff (such as Accounts Executives / Sr. Accountants), enforcing strict documentation discipline and maker-checker controls.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

**Experience:** 7-12 years of hands-on accounting and finance experience, preferably in an SME manufacturing, packaging, or multi-branch trading/industrial setup.

**Technical Skills:**

a. Expert working knowledge of Tally Prime and Microsoft Excel

b. Strong practical command over GST portals, TDS compliance, e-invoicing, and e-way bills.

**Key Traits:** High integrity, strong punctuality and ownership, sharp attention to detail, and ability to meet strict statutory and monthly closing deadlines.

**Should be able to independently perform payment follow-ups**

jobs.description:

**Location:** India

The CONNECT Platform Specialist is a high-impact, revenue-driving role at the forefront of AVEVA's most strategic growth initiative: the CONNECT Platform. Youll be responsible for building and executing a winning sales strategy that delivers measurable customer value and drives ARR growth.

This is a role for a results-oriented enterprise seller who thrives in fast-moving environments. You bring the full spectrum of enterprise sales skillsstrategic prospecting, value-based selling, and deal closingpaired with a strong ability to grow accounts through stakeholder enablement and platform adoption. * Good understanding of **Git**.

* Strong **hands-on automation mindset**, beyond test execution.
* Ability to **write, debug, fix, execute, and maintain automation independently**.

jobs.title: Alteryx
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities:

* Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
* Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
* Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
* Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
* Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
* Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

  

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
* 2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
* Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
* Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
* Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
* Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
* Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
* Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.

Good to have skills:

SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

jobs.title: Generative AI 5- 9yrs
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Generative AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in **Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI Agent Frameworks**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and advanced retrieval systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop AI-powered applications using **Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)**.
* Build and deploy **Agentic AI solutions** capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
* Implement **RAG architectures** using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Develop integrations using **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** for AI tool and data connectivity.
* Build multi-agent systems using modern **Agent Frameworks**.
* Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
* Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
* Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
* Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.

Required Skills

* 2-6 years of software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in **Python**.
* Hands-on experience with **Generative AI** and Large Language Models.
* Experience building **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** pipelines.
* Knowledge of **Agentic AI** architectures and autonomous AI agents.
* Experience with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** integration and AI tooling.
* Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:

+ LangGraph
+ LangChain
+ CrewAI
+ AutoGen
+ Semantic Kernel
+ LlamaIndex

* Experience with Vector Databases:

+ Pinecone
+ ChromaDB
+ Weaviate
+ Milvus
+ FAISS

* Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
* Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
* Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
* Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
* Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
* Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
* Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Position:** AI Engineer

  

**Location:** Nagpur/Pune/Bangalore/Chennai

  

**Type of Employment:** Full-time

  

**Key Result Areas and Activities:**

* **End-to-End OCR & Document AI Delivery** Build and deploy high-performance OCR + Document Understanding pipelines (LayoutLM/Donut/TrOCR) with measurable accuracy and throughput SLAs.
* **Knowledge Graph Construction & Utilization** Model entities, relationships, and table structures in Neo4j/AWS Neptune; transform OCR output into robust knowledge graphs supporting business queries.
* **Entity Extraction, Linking & Disambiguation** Implement NER/REL to resolve entities and link to graph nodes; maintain high precision/recall and reduce ambiguity rates.
* **Scalable System Architecture & Operations** Design cloud-native microservices (Python, Docker, Kubernetes) with robust APIs (FastAPI/Flask), CI/CD, monitoring, and autoscaling for document workloads.
* **Performance Optimization & Team Enablement** Optimize inference latency and graph query performance; mentor junior engineers, drive code reviews, and set engineering standards.

**Work and Technical Experience:**

* ***Must Have:***
* Application Engineering & DevOps: 7+ years in application development with CI/CD, containerization, and production support.
* Python + DL Frameworks: 5+ years hands-on with Python and PyTorch/TensorFlow for training/inference.
* OCR & Document AI: Experience with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, Azure Form Recognizer, AWS Textract, Google Document AI; transformers for document understanding (Hugging Face).
* Graph Databases: Strong in Neo4j/TigerGraph/AWS Neptune; proficient in Cypher or Gremlin; solid graph data modeling.
* NLP for Information Extraction: NER, Relation Extraction, Semantic Search, and evaluation methodology.
* Backend & APIs: Building production-grade APIs with FastAPI/Flask; containerization with Docker.
* Cloud-Native Microservices: Designing scalable, fault-tolerant services on Kubernetes (batch & streaming document pipelines).
* ***Good to Have:***
* **Vector Databases & RAG:** Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate; retrieval pipelines for hybrid search.
* **LLMs & Agentic AI:** Prompt engineering, tool use, and agent workflows for generative extraction.
* **Knowledge Graph Standards:** RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, schema governance.
* **Hugging Face Ecosystem:** Transformers, Datasets, Accelerate, model optimization/export (ONNX/TensorRT).
* **Performance Tuning:** GPU inference optimization, quantization/pruning, and graph query tuning.

**Qualifications:**

* **Overall:** 7+ years in application development and DevOps.
* **AI/ML:** 5+ years in Python with production DL (PyTorch/TensorFlow).
* **Document AI:** Proven track record building OCR and document understanding systems at scale.
* **Graph Systems:** Hands-on with graph modeling and query languages (Cypher/Gremlin).
* **Systems:** Designing and operating microservices/APIs in containerized/cloud-native environments.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in **Computer Science**, **Data Science**, **AI/ML**, or related engineering discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Qualities:**

* Systems Thinking: Ability to translate messy, unstructured inputs into robust, queryable knowledge systems.
* Ownership & Bias for Action: Drives features from design to production with measurable outcomes.
* Pragmatic Problem-Solving: Balances model accuracy, latency, and cost for real-world constraints.
* Mentorship & Collaboration: Elevates team through reviews, guidance, and technical leadership.
* Quality & Reliability Mindset: Strong focus on testing, observability, and operational excellence.
* Clear Communicator: Explains complex AI/graph concepts to technical and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on AI Lead with strong expertise in **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**. You will lead the AI/ML team and still contribute technically every day, including owning Jira tickets and delivery. You will build GenAI solutions, deploy them to production, evaluate them and keep them running at scale. We strongly prefer candidates who have worked as experienced Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs). You should be a strong problem solver and be able to communicate clearly, concisely and confidently with stakeholders.

  

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

* Lead, mentor and guide a team of ML Engineers, GenAI Engineers and Data Scientists.
* Set the architecture and best practices for GenAI, LLM and RAG solutions.
* Run design and code reviews to make sure GenAI solutions are secure, scalable and maintainable.
* Make key technical decisions, such as model selection, build vs. buy, fine-tuning vs. RAG, and cost vs. performance.

  

Hands-on GenAI Development

* Actively pick up and deliver Jira tickets: features, bugs, POCs and technical debt.
* Design and build **RAG pipelines**: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, re-ranking and context optimization.
* Build LLM applications using **LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph** or similar frameworks.
* Do prompt engineering, prompt versioning, function/tool calling and structured outputs.
* Fine-tune LLMs where needed, using LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT or instruction tuning.
* Build **Agentic AI** workflows such as multi-agent orchestration and tool-using agents.
* Write clean, production-grade Python code and contribute directly to the codebase.

  

GenAI Deployment & Production (LLMOps)

* Deploy GenAI/LLM applications to production on **Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI** or self-hosted open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral and similar).
* Serve models at scale using **vLLM, TGI, Triton, Ollama** or managed endpoints.
* Build GenAI APIs and microservices using **FastAPI**, containerized with **Docker/Kubernetes**.
* Set up CI/CD for GenAI: prompt, model and index versioning, automated evaluation gates and safe rollouts.
* Optimize production for **latency, throughput, token cost, caching and rate limits**.
* Monitor production GenAI systems for hallucinations, response quality, drift, latency, cost and failures, using tools such as **LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix** or Azure AI monitoring.
* Implement **guardrails and security**: PII masking, prompt-injection protection, content filtering and access control.

  

GenAI Model Evaluation & Quality

* Define evaluation frameworks, metrics and acceptance criteria for LLM and RAG systems.
* Evaluate RAG quality on:

**Retrieval:** Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR, NDCG

**Generation:** faithfulness, groundedness, answer relevance, context precision and recall, hallucination rate

* Use evaluation tools such as **RAGAS, DeepEval, TruLens, Promptfoo** and the LLM-as-a-judge approach.
* Build golden datasets, run regression tests for prompts and models, run A/B tests and do human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* Ensure Responsible AI: bias, toxicity, safety, explainability and compliance.

  

Stakeholder Communication

* Explain GenAI concepts, progress, risks, costs and trade-offs clearly and concisely to business and technical stakeholders.
* Turn business problems into GenAI use cases with measurable outcomes and ROI.
* Provide regular status updates, demos and delivery reports to leadership and clients.

Own the discipline that keeps predictive models accurate and safe in production: drift monitoring, retraining and validation, deployment and rollback, lineage, and cost. Lead a team of two engineers and report to the Lead of AI & Agent Operations in Singapore, coordinating on change, incidents and standards. This role is classical MLOps.

jobs.title: Data Engineer

**Data Engineer**  
**Data Vault , Oracle  •  ODI 12c  •  Snowflake**  
**Contract -1 Years**  
**Shift -2pm IST -11 pm IST**  
**Experience: 7 Years   •**  
**Role type: Individual contributor, hands-on**

  

**Apply - nidhi@intersourcesinc.com, sarang@intersourcesinc.com**

**The Role**  
We run a complex, Data Vault 2.0based data warehouse on Oracle, orchestrated end-to-end in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) 12c with our own batch-control framework. We are looking for a senior, self-driven engineer who can own this environment: design and extend the Data Vault model, write and tune heavy SQL on Oracle, and triage production ODI issues quickly and independently.  
Genuine Data Vault depth is rare, so we value a sharp engineer who can pick up Data Vault concepts fast and apply them to a real, intricate ODI implementation — as much as someone who already has deep DV experience.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
•Design, build and maintain Data Vault 2.0 structures (Hubs, Links, Satellites) and the loads that feed them on Oracle.  
•Write high-performance SQL and tune it on Oracle — execution plans, indexing/partitioning, MERGE/bulk patterns, and diagnosing long-running or unstable jobs.  
•Own batch execution through our ODI batch-control tables: scheduling, dependencies, restart/recovery, and keeping nightly/incremental loads reliable.  
•Triage and resolve ODI 12c issues end-to-end — from Operator errors and session logs down to the generated SQL and knowledge modules.  
•Extend and optimize ODI mappings, packages, load plans and knowledge modules using advanced ODI features.  
•Contribute to replication/streaming into Snowflake and support downstream consumption.  
•Document designs and work independently against delivery timelines.  
**What We're Looking For**  
**Must have**  
•SQL & Oracle performance tuning: Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on Oracle performance tuning (reading explain plans, indexing, partitioning, statistics, set-based/bulk processing).  
•ODI 12c — issue triaging: Proven ability to triage and fix ODI 12c problems quickly: Operator, session logs, scenarios, agents, generated code.  
•ODI 12c — advanced & navigation: Very strong, fluent ODI navigation and advanced concepts — knowledge modules, load plans, variables, scenarios, reusable mappings, topology.  
•Batch execution: Hands-on experience running data loads via batch-control tables (batch IDs, dependencies, restart/recovery), as we use in our Data Vault executions.  
•Snowflake: Hands-on Snowflake experience (SQL, loading, warehouse/query basics).  
•Data Vault aptitude: Either solid Data Vault 2.0 knowledge, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex modeling concepts fast and apply them in a demanding ODI environment.  
•Mindset: Self-driven, independent problem-solver comfortable owning a complex system with limited hand-holding.  
**Good to have**  
•Working knowledge of Kafka (streaming/CDC into the warehouse).  
•Prior exposure to a Data Vault implementation in production.  
•Experience with CDC, data replication, or GoldenGate-style pipelines.
