jobs.title: Walk-In - 5th Dec - OIC- Baner Pune
jobs.description:
**Face to Face Walk-In Drive - 5th Dec - Jade Global**

  

**Exp -4+ Years**

**Skill - OIC (Must Have)**

  
  

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud Technical Developer with deep expertise across Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher (BIP), and Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) - Nice to have.

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain cloud integrations, custom responsive web/mobile user interfaces, and enterprise operational reporting across Oracle Cloud SaaS applications (ERP, HCM, SCM) and third-party systems. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, solution architects, and business stakeholders to translate operational needs into robust PaaS solutions.

  
  

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  

1. Integration Development (OIC)

  

Design, build, and deploy inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud SaaS and external applications using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

Implement REST/SOAP web services, file-based integrations (FBDI/HDL), and event-driven orchestration patterns.

Configure OIC adapters (Oracle SaaS, FTP, Database, REST/SOAP, Kafka/Messaging) and manage security policies.

Perform payload debugging, exception handling, error resubmission strategies, and integration performance tuning.

  

2. Reporting & Analytics (BIP / OTBI)

  

Build complex SQL-based Data Models, RTF/Excel templates, and XML layouts in Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) for operational documents (e.g., invoices, checks, purchase orders).

Develop OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence) reports and analysis objects.

Schedule processes, manage bursting definitions, and deliver automated report extracts to secure SFTP servers or downstream applications.

  

3. Custom Application Development (VBCS) - NICE TO HAVE

  

Build responsive web and mobile web applications using Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) to extend standard Oracle Fusion SaaS capabilities.

Consume Oracle SaaS REST APIs, custom OIC REST endpoints, and external web services within VBCS.

Apply Oracle Redwood design patterns and standards (using VBS/Visual Builder Studio) for consistent user experience.

  
  

4. Architecture & Technical Support

  

Create end-to-end technical documentation (MD50/TE040 or equivalent), code artifacts, and unit testing logs.

Conduct code reviews, resolve production incidents, perform performance optimization, and engage with Oracle Support for SR management.

Qualifications & Requirements

Must-Have Skills:

  

Core Technical Stack: Hands-on experience with OIC (App Integration, Process Automation), BI Publisher (BIP), and VBCS.

Oracle SaaS Knowledge: Functional understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, or SCM tables, data models, and REST/SOAP API structures.

Languages & Standards: Strong SQL/PL-SQL skills, JSON, XML, XSLT, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Web Services & Tools: Deep working knowledge of RESTful API architecture, HTTP methods, OAuth authentication, and testing tools like Postman/SoapUI.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred:

  

Experience with Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS) and Oracle Redwood UX framework.

Familiarity with Groovy Scripting (Application Composer) or Oracle JET.

Certification in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Developer.

jobs.title: Technical Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Summary :**   
  
The Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) is a high-stakes, strategic leadership position designed to act as the primary catalyst for predictable, disciplined, and high-velocity engineering output. While the role focuses on execution rather than direct code contribution, it requires a deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile Orchestration to bridge the gap between UK-based product strategy and India-based technical execution.

You will be the single point of accountability for the Engineering Roadmap, responsible for converting high-level vision into granular, data-driven execution plans. Your mission is to move beyond simple project tracking and instead instill a culture of professional accountability, automated reporting, and proactive risk mitigation, ensuring that the offshore delivery center operates as a seamless extension of the global product organization.  
  
****Responsibilities :****   
  
- Roadmap Architecture & Timeline Governance : Translate high-level strategic goals into a structured, technical roadmap, defining critical path milestones, multi-squad dependencies, and hardware/cloud resource requirements.  
  
- Agile Operational Excellence : Lead the implementation and continuous optimization of Scrum and Kanban frameworks, driving team velocity, improving sprint predictability, and maintaining less than 10% deviation from committed delivery schedules.  
  
- Infrastructure for Support & Maintenance : Design and implement robust ITSM-aligned support structures, including Tier 1-3 triage workflows, automated escalation triggers, and strict SLA/SLO enforcement for production incidents.  
  
- Advanced Resource & Capacity Planning : Utilize data-driven models to track team utilization and workload balance, identifying skill-gap bottlenecks and underutilization trends before they impact the critical path.  
  
- Automated Delivery Reporting : Establish a "source-of-truth" reporting engine leveraging Git metadata and project management APIs (Jira/Azure DevOps) to provide real-time visibility into burndown, cycle time, and lead time without manual overhead.  
  
- Strategic Risk & Dependency Management : Architect a proactive risk management framework that accounts for vendor API dependencies, third-party integrations, and human capital risks (Succession Planning/Absence Management).  
  
- Cross-Continental Stakeholder Alignment : Serve as the high-bandwidth communication bridge between India Engineering and UK Product/Executive teams, translating technical impediments into business risks and vice versa.  
  
- Non-Technical Engineering Mentorship : Coach and mentor engineering teams on professional discipline, effective peer-review habits, structured status reporting, and the "ownership" of end-to-end deliverables.  
  
- Vendor & API Governance : Act as the primary coordinator for external vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring that external dependencies are tracked and integrated into the primary roadmap.  
  
- Maintenance & Tech Debt Strategy : Partner with Engineering Managers to balance the backlog between high-value feature development, "Keep the Lights On" (KTLO) activities, and the systematic reduction of technical debt.  
  
**Technical **Requirements :****    
  
- Delivery Leadership : 8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management (TPM), Engineering Management, or as a Delivery Lead within high-scale software environments.  
  
- Metric-Driven Management : Proven expertise in defining and tracking DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, Time to Restore Service).  
  
- Agile Mastery : Deep proficiency in managing complex, multi-team dependencies using Scaled Agile or advanced Scrum/Kanban methodologies.  
  
- SDLC Governance : Strong understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows (GitFlow/Trunk-based), and automated testing impact on delivery timelines.  
  
- Tooling Expertise : Advanced proficiency in Jira/Confluence, Microsoft Project, or equivalent Enterprise PPM tools for roadmap visualization and reporting.  
  
- Operational Frameworks : Experience in building Incident Management and Problem Management workflows based on ITIL or SRE principles.  
  
**Preferred Skills :**   
  
- International Stakeholder Management : Previous experience working with UK, US, or European stakeholders, demonstrating exceptional cross-cultural communication and verbal English proficiency.  
  
- Strategic Problem Solving : Ability to deconstruct complex technical bottlenecks into logical, actionable workstreams for the engineering team.  
  
- Proactive Accountability : A track record of identifying delivery risks weeks in advance and presenting "solution-first" mitigation plans to executive leadership.  
  
- Process Engineering : A passion for continuous improvement, moving beyond "following the process" to "designing the process" that optimizes engineering flow.  
  
- Conflict Resolution : Strong interpersonal skills to manage competing priorities between Product (Features) and Engineering (Stability/Debt).
